### 表单布局

`edit-mode` 表示编辑模式：`direct` 始终显示控件；`click` / `dblclick` 保留当前在字段附近展开编辑浮层的行为。`readPretty` 是独立布尔属性。FormItem 和字段未设置时继承上层。

表单支持三种布局方式： horizontal - 水平排列（默认，标签在左、控件在右）， vertical - 垂直排列（标签在上、控件在下）， inline - 行内排列。

组合切换 `layout`、`content-align` 与 `direct / click / dblclick` 编辑方式及独立的 `readPretty` 阅读开关，观察标签、字段值和长文字换行的对齐效果。备注项可单独覆盖布局，已有输入数据在切换时保留。`click` 单击进入弹层，`dblclick` 双击进入弹层，`readPretty` 只展示已保存的文字。

Example source: src/form/__demos__/layout.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
import { computed, reactive, ref } from "vue";
import type {
  FieldEditMode,
  FormContentAlign,
  FormLayout,
} from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";

const copy = useDemoLocale("layout");
const layout = ref<FormLayout>("horizontal");
const itemLayout = ref<FormLayout | "inherit">("inherit");
const mode = ref<FieldEditMode>("direct");
const readPretty = ref(false);
const contentAlign = ref<FormContentAlign>("start");
const contentAlignOptions = ["start", "end", "left", "center", "right"].map(
  (value) => ({
    label: value,
    value,
  }),
);
const modeOptions = computed(() =>
  (["direct", "click", "dblclick"] as const).map((value) => ({
    label: copy.value.editModes[value],
    value,
  })),
);
const model = reactive({ ...copy.value.initialModel });
const layouts = ["vertical", "horizontal", "inline"] as const;
const layoutOptions = layouts.map((value) => ({ label: value, value }));

const itemLayoutOptions = computed(() => [
  { label: copy.value.labels.inherit, value: "inherit" },
  ...layoutOptions,
]);
</script>

<template>
  <c-space
    direction="column"
    align="stretch"
    :size="16"
    data-config-comparison="form-layout"
  >
    <c-form layout="vertical" edit-mode="direct">
      <c-form-item :label="copy.labels.layout">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="layout"
          :aria-label="copy.labels.layout"
          :options="layoutOptions"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item :label="copy.labels.itemLayout">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="itemLayout"
          :aria-label="copy.labels.itemLayout"
          :options="itemLayoutOptions"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item :label="copy.labels.mode">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="mode"
          :aria-label="copy.labels.mode"
          :options="modeOptions"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item :label="copy.labels.contentAlign">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="contentAlign"
          :aria-label="copy.labels.contentAlign"
          :options="contentAlignOptions"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item :label="copy.labels.readPretty">
        <c-checkbox v-model="readPretty" data-read-pretty-toggle
          >readPretty</c-checkbox
        >
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p>
      {{ copy.labels.hint }}<br />{{ copy.labels.description[layout] }}<br />{{
        copy.labels.modeDescription[readPretty ? "readPretty" : mode]
      }}
    </p>
    <c-form
      class="layout-comparison-form"
      :model="model"
      :layout="layout"
      :content-align="contentAlign"
      :edit-mode="mode"
      :read-pretty="readPretty"
      label-align="left"
      label-col-flex="6rem"
    >
      <c-form-item field="name" :label="copy.labels.name" required>
        <c-input v-model="model.name" :placeholder="copy.labels.placeholder" />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="department" :label="copy.labels.department">
        <c-input
          v-model="model.department"
          :placeholder="copy.labels.placeholder"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item
        field="notes"
        :label="copy.labels.notes"
        :layout="itemLayout === 'inherit' ? undefined : itemLayout"
        :help="copy.labels.help"
      >
        <c-input v-model="model.notes" :placeholder="copy.labels.placeholder" />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p role="status">{{ copy.labels.model }}：{{ JSON.stringify(model) }}</p>
  </c-space>
</template>

<style scoped>
.layout-comparison-form :deep(.c-form-item-layout-inline) {
  width: min(100%, 22rem);
  margin-inline-end: 0;
}
p {
  margin: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>
```

### 局部表单分区

仅将现场处置 SOP、安全须知和处置要点放入分区，底部结束线区分后续未分组字段。 在表单上方切换分隔线、仅标题、边框卡片三种风格，已填内容保持不变；也可切换标题标记和底部结束线。卡片以外框表示范围，不重复显示结束线。CSection 自动适配父 Form 的布局。组内字段直接从父 Form 获取标签宽度、禁用状态和校验规则；布局通过 Form / FormItem 的既有属性设置。请提供 title 或 title 插槽。当前不提供折叠与分区级布局覆盖。

Example source: src/form/__demos__/section.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { SectionVariant } from "../../section/props";
import { useDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
import { computed, reactive, ref } from "vue";
const copy = useDemoLocale("section");

const variant = ref<SectionVariant>("line");
const showMarker = ref(true);
const showEndDivider = ref(true);
const variantOptions = computed(() =>
  (["line", "plain", "card"] as const).map((value) => ({
    value,
    label: copy.value.variants[value],
  })),
);

const model = reactive({
  event: "abnormal",
  level: "3",
  tags: [],
  remote: ["review"],
  onsite: ["review"],
  safety: "1",
  points: "1",
  skill: "L3",
  certificates: ["electric", "entry", "height", "high"],
});
const certificateOptions = computed(() => [
  { value: "electric", label: copy.value.lowVoltage },
  { value: "entry", label: copy.value.entryPermit },
  { value: "height", label: copy.value.workAtHeight },
  { value: "high", label: copy.value.highVoltage },
]);
</script>

<template>
  <div data-form-section-demo="variants">
    <c-form layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item :label="copy.variantLabel">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="variant"
          :options="variantOptions"
          :aria-label="copy.variantLabel"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item :label="copy.optionsLabel">
        <c-space wrap>
          <c-checkbox v-model="showMarker">{{ copy.markerLabel }}</c-checkbox>
          <c-checkbox v-model="showEndDivider" :disabled="variant === 'card'">{{
            copy.endLabel
          }}</c-checkbox>
        </c-space>
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p>{{ copy.styleHint }}</p>

    <c-form
      :model="model"
      layout="horizontal"
      label-col-flex="7rem"
      edit-mode="direct"
    >
      <c-form-item field="event" :label="copy.text.event" required>
        <c-select
          v-model="model.event"
          :options="[{ value: 'abnormal', label: copy.text.abnormal }]"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="level" :label="copy.text.level" required>
        <c-select
          v-model="model.level"
          :options="[{ value: '3', label: copy.levelThree }]"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="tags" :label="copy.text.tags">
        <c-select
          v-model="model.tags"
          multiple
          :options="[{ value: 'review', label: copy.text.review }]"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="remote" :label="copy.text.remote">
        <c-select
          v-model="model.remote"
          multiple
          :options="[{ value: 'review', label: copy.text.review }]"
        />
      </c-form-item>

      <c-section
        :title="copy.text.section"
        :variant="variant"
        :show-marker="showMarker"
        :show-end-divider="showEndDivider"
      >
        <c-form-item field="onsite" :label="copy.text.onsite">
          <c-select
            v-model="model.onsite"
            multiple
            :options="[{ value: 'review', label: copy.text.review }]"
          />
        </c-form-item>
        <c-form-item field="safety" :label="copy.text.safety">
          <c-textarea
            v-model="model.safety"
            :max-length="200"
            show-word-limit
          />
        </c-form-item>
        <c-form-item field="points" :label="copy.text.points">
          <c-textarea
            v-model="model.points"
            :max-length="200"
            show-word-limit
          />
        </c-form-item>
      </c-section>

      <c-form-item field="skill" :label="copy.text.skill">
        <c-select
          v-model="model.skill"
          :options="[{ value: 'L3', label: 'L3' }]"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="certificates" :label="copy.text.certificates">
        <c-select
          v-model="model.certificates"
          multiple
          :options="certificateOptions"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
  </div>
</template>
```

### 分区标题操作

通过 extra 插槽在标题右侧放置操作。“引用模板”填充现场处置字段，“清空”只清空当前分区。可先修改分区外的技能等级，再点击操作，观察该值保持不变。

Example source: src/form/__demos__/section-actions.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from "vue";
import { useDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const copy = useDemoLocale("section");
const model = reactive({ sop: "", safety: "", points: "", skill: "L3" });
const feedback = ref<"applied" | "cleared" | "">("");
function applyTemplate() {
  Object.assign(model, {
    sop: copy.value.templateSop,
    safety: copy.value.templateSafety,
    points: copy.value.templatePoints,
  });
  feedback.value = "applied";
}
function clearSection() {
  Object.assign(model, { sop: "", safety: "", points: "" });
  feedback.value = "cleared";
}
</script>
<template>
  <div data-form-section-demo="actions">
    <c-form
      :model="model"
      layout="horizontal"
      label-col-flex="7rem"
      edit-mode="direct"
    >
      <c-section
        :title="copy.text.section"
        :description="copy.actionsDescription"
        show-end-divider
      >
        <template #extra>
          <c-space size="sm" wrap>
            <c-button variant="text" size="sm" @click="applyTemplate">{{
              copy.applyTemplate
            }}</c-button>
            <c-button variant="text" size="sm" @click="clearSection">{{
              copy.clearSection
            }}</c-button>
          </c-space>
        </template>
        <c-form-item field="sop" :label="copy.text.onsite"
          ><c-input v-model="model.sop"
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-form-item field="safety" :label="copy.text.safety"
          ><c-textarea v-model="model.safety" :max-length="200" show-word-limit
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-form-item field="points" :label="copy.text.points"
          ><c-textarea v-model="model.points" :max-length="200" show-word-limit
        /></c-form-item>
      </c-section>
      <c-form-item field="skill" :label="copy.text.skill"
        ><c-input v-model="model.skill"
      /></c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p v-if="feedback" role="status">{{ copy[feedback] }}</p>
  </div>
</template>
```

### 标签宽度方案对比

先输入数据，再切换自动测量、响应式栅格和固定宽度，三种方案使用同一份表单数据。修改最长标签或隐藏联系方式，观察自动测量更新。响应式方案在 576px 以下上下排列；固定宽度默认 6rem，联系方式单项覆盖为 8rem。

<details>
<summary>配置说明与使用限制</summary>

#### 自动标签宽度

设置 `auto-label-width` 开启自动标签宽度。仅在 `layout="horizontal"` 布局下生效。

自动宽度随标签修改、字段增删更新，各个表单独立计算。

#### 标签栅格与局部覆盖

两端默认横向比例为标签 5/24、内容 19/24；Cedar 默认 horizontal，Maple 默认 vertical。仅 horizontal 消费栅格比例与自动宽度；vertical/inline 不套用 Col 百分比。响应式 xs/sm 等按视口宽度生效。

#### 固定标签宽度

FormItem 显式配置优先于 Form。Col 参数与 style 对象整项覆盖，不做深层合并。label-col-flex 优先于 auto-label-width；带单位字符串指定宽度，数字沿用 Col 的伸缩比例（并非 px），内容列自动填满剩余空间。隐藏标签时内容占满。

自动宽度只测量未指定 label-col-flex 的横向标签；标签文字变化、动态增删会重新对齐。多个 Form 各自计算，标签为空或移除全部字段时不会产生 Infinity/NaN。使用很长的标签时建议在窄屏切换 vertical 或设置固定宽度。

</details>

Example source: src/form/__demos__/label-width-comparison.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
import { computed, reactive, ref } from "vue";
const copy = useDemoLocale("labelWidthComparison");
const mode = ref<"auto" | "columns" | "fixed">("auto");
const showExtra = ref(true);
const customLabel = ref("");
const model = reactive({ name: "", department: "", contact: "" });

const choices = computed(() =>
  (["auto", "columns", "fixed"] as const).map((value) => ({
    label: copy.value.labels[value],
    value,
  })),
);
</script>
<template>
  <div class="label-width-comparison" data-config-comparison="form-label-width">
    <c-radio-group
      v-model="mode"
      :options="choices"
      :aria-label="copy.labels.strategy"
    />
    <p>{{ copy.labels.hint }}</p>
    <c-checkbox v-model="showExtra">{{ copy.labels.extra }}</c-checkbox>
    <label
      >{{ copy.labels.edit
      }}<c-input v-model="customLabel" :placeholder="copy.labels.contact"
    /></label>
    <c-form
      :model="model"
      layout="horizontal"
      label-align="left"
      :auto-label-width="mode === 'auto'"
      :label-col-flex="mode === 'fixed' ? '6rem' : undefined"
      :label-col-props="
        mode === 'columns' ? { span: 6, xs: 24, sm: 6 } : undefined
      "
      :wrapper-col-props="
        mode === 'columns' ? { span: 18, xs: 24, sm: 18 } : undefined
      "
    >
      <c-form-item field="name" :label="copy.labels.name"
        ><c-input v-model="model.name"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="department" :label="copy.labels.department"
        ><c-input v-model="model.department"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item
        v-if="showExtra"
        field="contact"
        :label="customLabel || copy.labels.contact"
        :label-col-flex="mode === 'fixed' ? '8rem' : undefined"
        ><c-input v-model="model.contact"
      /></c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p role="status">{{ copy.labels.model }}: {{ JSON.stringify(model) }}</p>
  </div>
</template>
<style scoped>
.label-width-comparison {
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
}
p {
  margin: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>
```

## 字段与数据模型

### 嵌套数据

展示了多种表单项嵌套的方式。
表单控件通过 FormItem 注入的上下文继承状态和事件，无需绑定到第一子组件。
如果使用 Grid 组件进行布局，请设置 :content-flex="false" 关闭表单项内容的 flex 布局。

Example source: src/form/__demos__/nested-data.vue


### 跨字段校验与原生提交

Pause cross-field validation holds the local confirmation rule until Resolve cross-field result. Completion compares its confirmation value with the current source. Native reset settles pending tasks, clears the model and submitted snapshot, retains the history count and prevents late submission. This is not remote cancellation or exhaustive dependency-race coverage.

“暂停跨字段校验”示例通过手动返回结果模拟异步校验。提交等待期间修改依赖字段、重置表单或卸载组件，会使该次提交失效；确认当前输入后可重新提交。

未暂停时确认规则立即比较当前源代码。先匹配通过，再修改源代码，主动只校验确认值或重新提交会显示依赖错误；改正确认值后可按 Enter 或提交按钮提交。原生重置清空模型、反馈和上次提交值，提交次数累计不清零。依赖由业务主动复验，单纯编辑不保证已有成功态仍有效；本地示例不等于任意异步提交竞争或外部持久化。

Example source: src/form/__demos__/cross-field.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import ModelOutput from "../__demo-utils__/ModelOutput.vue";

import {
  onBeforeUnmount,
  onDeactivated,
  reactive,
  ref,
  shallowRef,
  useId,
} from "vue";

const formRef = ref();
const id = useId();
const model = reactive({ source: "", confirmation: "" });
const result = ref("尚未提交");
const submissions = ref(0);
const snapshot = ref("");
const message = "两次代码须相同且不能为空";
const sourceRules = [{ required: true, message: "请输入源代码" }];
const paused = ref(false);
const pending = shallowRef([]);
let epoch = 0;
function complete() {
  const [resolve, ...rest] = pending.value;
  pending.value = rest;
  resolve?.();
}
function cleanup() {
  epoch++;
  const tasks = pending.value;
  pending.value = [];
  tasks.forEach((resolve) => resolve());
}
onBeforeUnmount(cleanup);
onDeactivated(cleanup);
const confirmationRules = [
  {
    validator: async (value, callback) => {
      if (paused.value)
        await new Promise((resolve) => {
          pending.value = [...pending.value, resolve];
        });
      if (!value || value !== model.source) callback(message);
    },
  },
];
function submitted({ errors, values }) {
  submissions.value++;
  result.value = errors ? "未通过" : "通过";
  snapshot.value = JSON.stringify(values);
}
async function validateConfirmation() {
  const current = ++epoch;
  const errors = await formRef.value?.validateField("confirmation");
  if (current === epoch) result.value = errors ? "确认值未通过" : "确认值通过";
}
function reset() {
  cleanup();
  result.value = "已重置";
  snapshot.value = "";
}
</script>

<template>
  <section class="cross-field-form-demo">
    <p>
      仅使用本地合成代码。校验时确认值比较当前源代码；修改源代码不自动复验依赖字段。
    </p>
    <c-form ref="formRef" :model="model" @submit="submitted" @reset="reset">
      <c-form-item
        field="source"
        label="源代码"
        :label-attrs="{ for: id + '-source' }"
        :rules="sourceRules"
        :validate-trigger="[]"
        feedback
      >
        <c-input :id="id + '-source'" v-model="model.source" />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item
        field="confirmation"
        label="确认代码"
        :label-attrs="{ for: id + '-confirmation' }"
        :rules="confirmationRules"
        :validate-trigger="[]"
        feedback
      >
        <c-input :id="id + '-confirmation'" v-model="model.confirmation" />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-space wrap>
        <c-button html-type="submit">提交代码</c-button>
        <c-button @click="validateConfirmation">只校验确认值</c-button>
        <c-button html-type="reset">重置代码</c-button>
      </c-space>
    </c-form>
    <p role="status">结果：{{ result }}；提交次数：{{ submissions }}</p>
    <c-button
      html-type="button"
      :aria-pressed="paused"
      @click="paused = !paused"
      >暂停跨字段校验</c-button
    >
    <c-button html-type="button" :disabled="!pending.length" @click="complete"
      >返回跨字段结果</c-button
    >
    <p class="cross-field-pending">等待：{{ pending.length }}</p>
    <ModelOutput>模型：{{ model }}</ModelOutput>
    <ModelOutput>上次提交值：{{ snapshot || "-" }}</ModelOutput>
  </section>
</template>
```

### 清空时校验

`validate-trigger="clear"` 只在用户点击控件的清空按钮时校验；普通输入不会触发。本例清空后显示必填错误；重新输入不会自动清除该错误，可主动校验或重置表单。

Example source: src/form/__demos__/clear-trigger.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">

const model = reactive({ keyword: 'Cedar' })
const formRef = ref()
</script>

<template>
  <c-form ref="formRef" :model="model" layout="vertical" style="max-width: 360px">
    <c-form-item field="keyword" label="关键词" :rules="[{ required: true, message: '请输入关键词' }]" validate-trigger="clear">
      <c-input v-model="model.keyword" clearable placeholder="清空后立即校验" />
    </c-form-item>
    <c-button @click="formRef?.resetFields()">重置</c-button>
  </c-form>

```

### 空值标记与必填校验

接口用 -1 表示未选择。点击“校验”会显示必填错误；选择部门后再次校验通过。点击清空返回 -1，再次校验失败。Form 统一提供识别列表，字段单独指定清空输出；自定义校验仍收到原值。

Example source: src/form/__demos__/empty-values-validation.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from "vue";
const model = reactive({ department: -1 as number | null | undefined });
const form = ref();
const result = ref("尚未校验");
const options = [
  { value: 1, label: "研发" },
  { value: 2, label: "产品" },
];
async function validate() {
  const errors = await form.value.validate();
  result.value = errors ? "存在必填错误" : "校验通过";
}
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <p>先校验初始 -1，再选择部门并校验；点击清空后会回到 -1。</p>
    <c-form
      ref="form"
      :model="model"
      layout="vertical"
      :empty-values="[null, undefined, -1]"
    >
      <c-form-item field="department" label="部门" required>
        <c-select
          v-model="model.department"
          :options="options"
          edit-mode="direct"
          clearable
          :empty-value="-1"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <c-button @click="validate">校验</c-button>
    <p role="status">{{ result }}</p>
    <p>
      当前模型: <output>{{ String(model.department) }}</output>
    </p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## 字段呈现与交互

### 交互状态切换

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### 本组配置对照

| 配置              | 作用                                                                                 | 相关示例                                                       |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `layout`          | 表单的布局方式，包括水平、垂直、多列                                                 | 交互状态切换、校验展示状态、桌面与移动的同场景展示             |
| `model`           | 表单数据对象                                                                         | 字段展示与确认提交、桌面与移动的同场景展示、滚动到指定表单字段 |
| `disabled`        | 是否禁用表单                                                                         | 交互状态切换                                                   |
| `readonly`        | 是否将表单控件设为只读                                                               | 交互状态切换                                                   |
| `scroll-to-error` | 验证失败后滚动到页面顺序的第一个（start）或最后一个（end）错误字段；不是视口对齐方式 | 滚动到指定表单字段                                             |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

适用于整张表单的状态继承。调整禁用、只读，用相同数据观察变化。控制区始终可用，可以随时恢复编辑；错误外观本身不会触发表单校验。

### 字段展示与确认提交

Form、FormItem、Input 和 Select 支持 edit-mode 继承，优先级为字段 > FormItem > Form。默认 direct；Cedar 支持 click/dblclick。普通 v-model 不变，选择字段单选默认即选即提交，多选默认确认；其他字段保留各自确认方式。readPretty 不显示编辑器和搜索。direct 即时更新，确认模式在确认后更新；搜索框按展示位置自动排列。

Example source: src/form/__demos__/field-presentation.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import ModelOutput from "../__demo-utils__/ModelOutput.vue";

import { computed, ref } from "vue";

const editMode = ref("direct");
const readPretty = ref(false);

const options = ref([
  { value: 1, label: "研发设备" },
  { value: 2, label: "设计设备" },
  { value: 3, label: "运营设备" },
]);
const form = ref({
  name: "默认可直接编辑",
  deviceIds: [2],
  note: "此项始终直接编辑",
  summary: "只读展示",
});
const status = ref("");

const modeOptions = ["direct", "click", "dblclick"].map((value) => ({
  label: value,
  value,
}));
const committed = computed(() => JSON.stringify(form.value));
const presentationHint = computed(() =>
  readPretty.value
    ? "只展示已保存的值；下方“单项覆盖 direct”通过 readPretty=false 保持可编辑。"
    : editMode.value === "direct"
      ? "直接编辑，即时更新下方模型；选择设备无需额外确认。"
      : "按展示方式进入编辑；确认才更新下方模型，取消不保存本次修改。",
);
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" align="stretch" :size="16">
    <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="Form 展示方式">
      <c-radio-group
        aria-label="Form 展示方式"
        v-model="editMode"
        :options="modeOptions"
        variant="button"
        size="sm"
      />
    </c-form-item>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-checkbox v-model="readPretty">纯阅读 readPretty</c-checkbox>
    </c-space>
    <p>
      {{ presentationHint }}<br />设备 4 已停用，最多选择 3
      个设备；可切换本地搜索与模拟远程搜索。
    </p>
    <c-form
      :model="form"
      :edit-mode="editMode"
      :read-pretty="readPretty"
      @submit-success="status = '表单已提交'"
      @submit-failed="status = '请完成当前编辑或修正校验错误'"
    >
      <c-form-item
        field="name"
        label="名称"
        :rules="[{ required: true, message: '名称不能为空' }]"
      >
        <c-input v-model="form.name" placeholder="请输入名称" clearable />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item
        field="deviceIds"
        label="设备"
        :rules="[{ type: 'array', required: true, message: '请选择设备' }]"
      >
        <c-select
          v-model="form.deviceIds"
          :options="options"
          multiple
          filterable
          :limit="3"
          placeholder="搜索设备"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item
        field="note"
        label="单项覆盖 direct"
        edit-mode="direct"
        :read-pretty="false"
      >
        <c-input v-model="form.note" />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="summary" label="固定 readPretty" read-pretty>
        <c-input v-model="form.summary" />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-button html-type="submit">提交表单</c-button>
    </c-form>
    <ModelOutput role="status">当前模型：{{ committed }}</ModelOutput>
    <p v-if="status" role="status">{{ status }}</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### 原位编辑的提交与切换

`click` / `dblclick` 共用事务逻辑：点击外部、Tab 离开或切换字段时先尝试保存，成功后关闭；校验失败或 `beforeCommit` 拒绝时保留草稿和错误，并阻止打开其他字段。同一文档同时只打开一个原位编辑器，包括不同 Form 和独立字段。字段自身传送到 body 的选项、日期和时间面板属于内部区域，选值不会触发外部保存。

内层面板打开时，Enter 优先选值，Esc 只关闭最上层面板并回到控件、保留字段草稿；面板关闭后，Enter 保存，Esc 取消并恢复原值。悬浮或键盘聚焦时显示编辑图标，并通过提示区分单击/双击；点击图标始终直接进入编辑。

多行文本保留 Enter 换行，Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 保存。输入法组词期间的 Enter 不提交。日期、时间面板内的单元格和列选项也只更新草稿，不误触外层保存。异步确认期间禁止重复确认、取消和切换；重置会终止保存及等待中的切换，迟到的结果不会写回。保存失败后可修改并重试。

### 阅读空文案与配置继承

初始为阅读模式，姓名继承 Form 的默认“-”，编号使用 FormItem 的“未分配”，昵称使用字段的“匿名”，数量 0 保持可见。切换空文案只影响继承的字段；切换阅读/编辑不改模型。优先级为字段 > FormItem > Form；自定义 read 插槽优先。

Example source: src/form/__demos__/empty-text.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from "vue";
const reading = ref(true);
const emptyText = ref("-");
const model = reactive({
  name: null as string | null,
  code: null as string | null,
  nickname: null as string | null,
  quantity: 0 as number | null | undefined,
});
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <p>初始阅读模式：姓名显示“-”，编号和昵称使用各自覆盖；数量 0 仍显示 0。</p>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="reading = !reading">切换阅读/编辑</c-button>
      <c-button @click="emptyText = '暂无'">使用“暂无”</c-button>
      <c-button @click="emptyText = '-'">使用默认“-”</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <c-form
      :model="model"
      layout="vertical"
      :read-pretty="reading"
      :empty-text="emptyText"
    >
      <c-form-item field="name" label="姓名：继承 Form"
        ><c-input v-model="model.name"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="code" label="编号：覆盖 FormItem" empty-text="未分配"
        ><c-input v-model="model.code"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="nickname" label="昵称：覆盖字段" empty-text="未分配"
        ><c-input v-model="model.nickname" empty-text="匿名"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="quantity" label="数量"
        ><c-input-number v-model="model.quantity"
      /></c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p>
      当前模型: <output>{{ JSON.stringify(model) }}</output>
    </p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### 校验展示状态

显式 validate-status 优先于自动状态；error 才显示错误信息，其他状态显示 help。它只控制展示，不改变 validate 的真实结果。自动校验经历 validating → success/error；clearValidate 恢复未校验状态。setFields 仅传 message 会设为 error；显式 status='' 和 message='' 可清空。

Example source: src/form/__demos__/presentation-status.vue

```vue
<template>
```

### 确认事件来源

## 动态与异步字段

### 动态表单

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### 本组配置对照

| 配置       | 作用                   | 相关示例                                 |
| ---------- | ---------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `model`    | 表单数据对象           | 动态表单、表单异步校验、多字段异步聚合   |
| `disabled` | 是否禁用表单           | 禁用、只读与异步确认、异步校验的返回顺序 |
| `readonly` | 是否将表单控件设为只读 | 禁用、只读与异步确认、异步校验的返回顺序 |
| `rules`    | 表单项校验规则         | 禁用、只读与异步确认                     |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

通过数据动态控制表单内容。

Example source: src/form/__demos__/dynamic-form.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-form :model="form" :style="{ width: '600px' }">
    <c-form-item field="name" label="Username">
      <c-input v-model="form.name" placeholder="please enter your username..." />
    </c-form-item>
    <c-form-item
      v-for="(post, index) of form.posts"
      :field="`posts[${index}].value`"
      :label="`Post-${index}`"
      :key="index"
    >
      <c-input v-model="post.value" placeholder="please enter your post..." />
      <c-button @click="handleDelete(index)" :style="{ marginLeft: '10px' }">Delete</c-button>
    </c-form-item>
  </c-form>
  <div>
    <c-button @click="handleAdd">Add Post</c-button>
  </div>
  {{ form }}
</template>
<script lang="ts">
import { reactive, defineComponent } from 'vue'
export default defineComponent({
  setup() {
    const form = reactive({
      name: '',
      posts: [{ value: '' }],
    })
    const handleAdd = () => {
      form.posts.push({
        value: '',
      })
    }
    const handleDelete = (index) => {
      form.posts.splice(index, 1)
    }

    return {
      form,
      handleAdd,
      handleDelete,
    }
  },
})
</script>
```

### 表单异步校验

本地模拟异步校验，用户名输入 `admin` 后提交通过，其他值显示错误；不访问外部接口。原生提交/重置按钮使用 `html-type`。重置会取消本例的模拟校验并忽略旧提交结果，卸载或停用也会清理计时器。

外层标签通过 `label-attrs.for` 对应 Input 的 `id`；多个示例实例使用独立 ID，便于点击标签聚焦和辅助技术识别。

Example source: src/form/__demos__/async-validate-form.vue

```vue
<template>
  <section class="async-form-demo" @submit.capture="beginSubmit">
    <p>本地模拟异步校验：用户名只能是 admin，延迟 600ms，不访问外部接口。</p>
    <c-form
      ref="formRef"
      :model="form"
      @submit="handleSubmit"
      @reset="handleReset"
    >
      <c-form-item
        field="name"
        label="用户名"
        :label-attrs="{ for: `${demoId}-name` }"
        :rules="rules"
        feedback
      >
        <c-input
          :id="`${demoId}-name`"
          v-model="form.name"
          placeholder="请输入 admin"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item
        field="post"
        label="岗位"
        :label-attrs="{ for: `${demoId}-post` }"
      >
        <c-input
          :id="`${demoId}-post`"
          v-model="form.post"
          placeholder="请输入岗位"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="isRead">
        <c-checkbox v-model="form.isRead">已阅读说明</c-checkbox>
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item>
        <c-space>
          <c-button html-type="submit" status="primary" :loading="submitting"
            >提交</c-button
          >
          <c-button html-type="reset">重置</c-button>
          <c-button @click="setStatus">模拟服务端错误</c-button>
        </c-space>
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p role="status">提交结果：{{ result }}；活动校验：{{ pendingCount }}</p>
    <ModelOutput>{{ form }}</ModelOutput>
  </section>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import ModelOutput from '../__demo-utils__/ModelOutput.vue'

import { onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, reactive, ref, useId } from "vue";
import type { FormInstance, FieldRule } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";

const formRef = ref<FormInstance>();
const demoId = useId();
const form = reactive({ name: "", post: "", isRead: false });
const result = ref("尚未提交");
const submitting = ref(false);
const pendingCount = ref(0);
const pending = new Map<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>, () => void>();
let generation = 0;
let submittedGeneration = -1;
const rules: FieldRule[] = [
  {
    validator: (value, callback) =>
      new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        const current = generation;
        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
          pending.delete(timer);
          pendingCount.value = pending.size;
          if (current === generation && value !== "admin")
            callback("用户名必须是 admin");
          resolve();
        }, 600);
        pending.set(timer, resolve);
        pendingCount.value = pending.size;
      }),
  },
];

function beginSubmit() {
  submittedGeneration = generation;
  submitting.value = true;
  result.value = "校验中";
}
function cancelPending() {
  generation++;
  pending.forEach((resolve, timer) => {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    resolve();
  });
  pending.clear();
  pendingCount.value = 0;
  submitting.value = false;
}
function handleSubmit({ errors }: { errors?: unknown }) {
  if (submittedGeneration !== generation) return;
  submitting.value = false;
  result.value = errors ? "未通过" : "通过";
}
function handleReset() {
  cancelPending();
  result.value = "已重置";
}
function setStatus() {
  formRef.value?.setFields({
    name: { status: "error", message: "模拟服务端用户名错误" },
    post: { status: "error", message: "模拟服务端岗位错误" },
  });
  result.value = "服务端错误已展示";
}
onBeforeUnmount(cancelPending);
onDeactivated(cancelPending);
</script>
```

### 多字段异步聚合

State-command addendum: public `clearValidate()` and `setFields()` also invalidate a pending native submission, including field-scoped calls. Old completion cannot append submit events after a clear or explicit error; a fresh native submission still validates normally. Editing model values or changing rules while waiting also invalidates the pending submission. The Demo keeps old tasks available for manual settlement; this does not cancel real requests.

显式调用validate()或validateField()会使等待中的旧原生submit失效：命令校验有自己的结果，不应让旧submit在完成后把旧错误或成功与当前模型混发。此后新的原生submit仍正常等待自己的字段校验并通知一次。该规则仅逻辑失效、不取消真实请求，不清空历史提交计数。等待中修改模型或规则也会使本次提交失效，需重新提交校验。

Explicit validate() or validateField() invalidates a pending older native submit. The imperative result is independent: an older submit must not later combine stale errors or success with the current model. A fresh native submit still waits for its own fields and notifies once. This is logical invalidation, not request cancellation, and retains submission history. Method signatures are unchanged; stale mixed notifications are not retained for compatibility. Changing model values or validation rules while waiting also invalidates that submission; submit again to validate the new inputs.

“返回最新用户名结果 / 返回最新代码结果”优先结清对应字段最新任务，可让新submit先完成、旧结果最后返回。新成功后旧失败不追加提交或恢复错误；新失败后旧成功不追加提交或清除新错误。仍须等最新提交的两个字段都返回，单个字段返回不提交；默认“返回用户名/代码结果”继续返回最早任务。

原生submit采用最新提交生效：旧提交仍等待时再次提交，使旧提交的submit/submit-success/submit-failed续体失效。用guest/bad提交后改为admin/1234再提交；先返回旧两个结果，原生提交计数应仍0，新提交仍等自己的两个结果。反向旧成功/新失败同理，旧成功不能提前报通过。这个规则不取消真实请求；等待中修改模型或规则同样使旧提交失效。

原生submit等待中调用resetFields（含原生reset）会使该提交失效；旧Promise结清后不得再发submit、submit-success或submit-failed。停用/卸载同样使旧提交失效，后续新提交仍正常校验。此为逻辑失效，不是取消远端请求；并发submit和跨字段异步依赖不在这个重置协议内。

“原生异步提交”是表单内的原生submit按钮，也可聚焦后按Enter。独立“原生提交”计数须等两个本地异步字段都返回才增加：用户名失败先返回时暂不提交，代码返回后记录失败；修正为admin再提交，反序返回代码/用户名后记录成功并清错。下方“结果”仍只表示命令式校验，两个计数/结果互不冒充。完成后重置清空字段、保留历史提交计数。此顺序重试不代表并发submit或跨字段异步依赖已覆盖。

同一示例可连续点击两次“校验两个字段”：先输入旧值并发起，再改值发起新一轮。“返回用户名结果 / 返回代码结果”各返回该字段最早任务。旧整表先完成时，新一轮仍须等它自己的两个字段；旧成功或失败都不应覆盖最新字段反馈。结果文案由示例序号单独保护，不是 Form 自动取消旧请求，也不是原生提交并发协议。

两个字段分别返回独立本地 Promise。先返回任一字段可更新该字段反馈，但整表须等两个字段都完成。重置使旧反馈和示例结果失效，旧任务仍可手动返回以观察迟到结果。这里演示命令式 validate()，不是原生提交事件并发或跨字段依赖。

也可在用户名结果已返回、代码仍等待时重置，立即输入新值并再次校验。此时返回最早代码只会结清旧任务，不能恢复旧错误或提前完成新整表；必须返回新一轮自己的两个结果。分别用旧失败/新成功、旧成功/新失败核对字段反馈；结果文案仍由示例版本号单独保护，不等于取消真实请求。

Example source: src/form/__demos__/async-fields.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import ModelOutput from "../__demo-utils__/ModelOutput.vue";

import {
  onBeforeUnmount,
  onDeactivated,
  reactive,
  ref,
  shallowRef,
  useId,
} from "vue";
const formRef = ref();
const id = useId();
const model = reactive({ name: "", code: "" });
const pending = shallowRef([]);
const submissions = ref(0);
const submittedResult = ref("-");
function submitted({ errors }) {
  submissions.value++;
  submittedResult.value = errors ? "未通过" : "通过";
}
const result = ref("尚未校验");
let run = 0;
function request(field, value) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    pending.value = [...pending.value, { field, value, resolve }];
  });
}
function rules(field) {
  return [
    {
      validator: async (value, callback) => {
        const answer = await request(field, value);
        if (answer !== true) callback(answer);
      },
    },
  ];
}
const nameRules = rules("name");
const codeRules = rules("code");
async function validate() {
  const current = ++run;
  result.value = "校验中";
  const errors = await formRef.value?.validate();
  if (current === run) result.value = errors ? "未通过" : "通过";
}
function complete(field, latest = false) {
  const tasks = pending.value.filter((item) => item.field === field);
  const task = latest ? tasks.at(-1) : tasks[0];
  if (!task) return;
  pending.value = pending.value.filter((item) => item !== task);
  task.resolve(
    task.value === (field === "name" ? "admin" : "1234")
      ? true
      : field === "name"
        ? "用户名必须是 admin"
        : "代码必须是 1234",
  );
}
function reset() {
  run++;
  formRef.value?.resetFields();
  result.value = "已重置";
}
function clear() {
  run++;
  formRef.value?.clearValidate();
  result.value = "已清空";
}
function serverError() {
  run++;
  formRef.value?.setFields({
    name: { status: "error", message: "模拟服务端拒绝" },
  });
  result.value = "服务端错误";
}
function cleanup() {
  run++;
  const tasks = pending.value;
  pending.value = [];
  tasks.forEach((task) => task.resolve(true));
}
onBeforeUnmount(cleanup);
onDeactivated(cleanup);
</script>
<template>
  <section class="async-fields-form-demo">
    <p>
      两个独立本地 Promise 规则分别接受 admin 和
      1234；手动返回各字段，不访问网络。
    </p>
    <c-form ref="formRef" :model="model" @submit="submitted">
      <c-form-item
        field="name"
        label="用户名"
        :label-attrs="{ for: id + '-name' }"
        :rules="nameRules"
        :validate-trigger="[]"
        feedback
      >
        <c-input :id="id + '-name'" v-model="model.name" />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item
        field="code"
        label="代码"
        :label-attrs="{ for: id + '-code' }"
        :rules="codeRules"
        :validate-trigger="[]"
        feedback
      >
        <c-input :id="id + '-code'" v-model="model.code" />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-button html-type="submit">原生异步提交</c-button>
    </c-form>
    <c-button html-type="button" @click="clear">清空校验</c-button>
    <c-button html-type="button" @click="serverError">写入服务端错误</c-button>
    <p class="async-submit-status">
      原生提交：{{ submissions }}；结果：{{ submittedResult }}
    </p>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="validate">校验两个字段</c-button>
      <c-button
        :disabled="!pending.some((item) => item.field === 'name')"
        @click="complete('name')"
        >返回用户名结果</c-button
      >
      <c-button
        :disabled="!pending.some((item) => item.field === 'code')"
        @click="complete('code')"
        >返回代码结果</c-button
      >
      <c-button
        :disabled="!pending.some((item) => item.field === 'name')"
        @click="complete('name', true)"
        >返回最新用户名结果</c-button
      >
      <c-button
        :disabled="!pending.some((item) => item.field === 'code')"
        @click="complete('code', true)"
        >返回最新代码结果</c-button
      >
      <c-button @click="reset">重置两个字段</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <p role="status">
      结果：{{ result }}；用户名等待：{{
        pending.filter((item) => item.field === "name").length
      }}；代码等待：{{ pending.filter((item) => item.field === "code").length }}
    </p>
    <ModelOutput>{{ model }}</ModelOutput>
  </section>
</template>
```

### 禁用、只读与异步确认

Example source: src/form/__demos__/presentation-state.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import ModelOutput from "../__demo-utils__/ModelOutput.vue";

import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, shallowRef } from "vue";

const form = ref();
const editMode = ref("dblclick");
const disabled = ref(false);
const readonly = ref(false);
const model = ref({ title: "原名称", note: "原备注", department: "dev" });

const choices = [
  { value: "dev", label: "研发" },
  { value: "design", label: "设计" },
];

const check = (predicate) => [
  {
    validator: (value, callback) => {
      const result = predicate(value);
      callback(result === true ? undefined : result);
    },
  },
];
const rules = { title: check((value) => Boolean(value) || "名称必填") };

const scenario = ref("success");
const scenarios = [
  { value: "success", label: "保存成功" },
  { value: "failure", label: "保存失败，保留草稿" },
  { value: "reset", label: "等待期间重置表单" },
  { value: "disabled", label: "等待期间设为禁用" },
  { value: "readonly", label: "等待期间设为只读" },
];
const pending = shallowRef();
const result = ref("尚未保存");
const current = computed(() => JSON.stringify(model.value));
function save(value, { signal }) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const timer = { id: undefined };
    let settled = false;
    const task = {
      value,
      finish(error, aborted = false) {
        if (settled) return;
        settled = true;
        clearTimeout(timer.id);
        signal.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
        if (pending.value === task) pending.value = undefined;
        result.value = aborted
          ? "保存已取消，旧结果不会提交"
          : error
            ? "保存失败，保留草稿"
            : "保存成功";
        if (error) reject(new Error("模拟保存失败，请重试"));
        else resolve(aborted ? false : undefined);
      },
    };
    const abort = () => task.finish(false, true);
    if (signal.aborted) {
      abort();
      return;
    }
    signal.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });
    pending.value = task;
    result.value = "模拟保存中（1.2 秒）";
    timer.id = setTimeout(() => {
      if (scenario.value === "reset") form.value.resetFields();
      else if (scenario.value === "disabled") disabled.value = true;
      else if (scenario.value === "readonly") readonly.value = true;
      else task.finish(scenario.value === "failure");
    }, 1200);
  });
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => pending.value?.finish(false, true));
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" align="stretch" :size="16">
    <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="异步保存场景">
      <c-radio-group
        v-model="scenario"
        aria-label="异步保存场景"
        :options="scenarios"
        variant="button"
        size="sm"
      />
    </c-form-item>
    <c-checkbox v-model="disabled">禁用状态示例</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="readonly">只读状态示例</c-checkbox>
    <p>
      编辑名称、备注或部门并保存，模拟等待 1.2
      秒。选择保存结果，或在等待时禁用、只读、重置，观察草稿是否提交。
    </p>
    <c-form
      ref="form"
      :model="model"
      :edit-mode="editMode"
      :disabled="disabled"
      :readonly="readonly"
      :rules="rules"
    >
      <c-form-item field="title" label="事务名称"
        ><c-input v-model="model.title" :before-commit="save"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="note" label="事务备注"
        ><c-textarea v-model="model.note" :before-commit="save"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="department" label="事务部门"
        ><c-select
          v-model="model.department"
          :options="choices"
          filterable
          :before-commit="save"
      /></c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <c-space>
      <c-button @click="form.resetFields()">重置状态示例</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <p role="status" aria-label="事务保存状态">{{ result }}</p>
    <ModelOutput aria-label="事务当前模型">{{ current }}</ModelOutput>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### 异步校验的返回顺序

主动调用 `validateField` 后可继续修改字段并发起新校验。示例关闭自动触发，只通过按钮发起，手动返回本地结果以比较新旧顺序。先校验 guest，再校验 admin，先返回最新结果再返回最早结果；旧错误不应覆盖最新字段状态。结果文案由示例的请求序号保护，“本次校验值”是校验快照，不是服务端提交。

清空校验或重置后，仍可返回等待中的旧结果，确认不会恢复旧错误；卸载和停用会结清本地等待。真实接口还应取消请求，并由业务保护提交快照和版本。

本例也可在等待中切换表单 disabled / readonly：它们限制控件交互，不自动取消已经发起的校验，也不清除已有错误。外部校验控制按钮不属于被禁用的 Form。需要使旧结果失效时主动清空校验或重置；解除限制后可再次输入并发起新校验。

关闭 Mount async field 会移除字段但保留业务模型和待返回任务。重新挂载后可发起新校验，再按新旧顺序返回结果，核对旧实例的错误不会污染新字段；这不是删除业务数据，也不是整表并发提交协议。

等待中可通过“写入服务端错误”调用 `setFields` 设置显式错误；之前的异步成功或失败不应覆盖它。示例仍保留旧任务供手动返回，结果文案单独做版本保护。清空校验可移除错误，重新发起校验后以新结果为准；不代表真实接口已取消。

“校验整表”调用 `validate()`，“校验字段”调用 `validateField('name')`。可交错发起并按不同顺序返回，分别观察字段反馈和示例最新结果；重置使旧结果失效，不等于取消真实服务。当前示例只有一个异步字段，不代表多字段聚合、跨字段依赖或原生 submit 事件并发均已覆盖。

Example source: src/form/__demos__/async-race.vue

```vue
<template>
  <section class="async-race-form-demo">
    <p>本地异步规则只接受 admin；手动返回最早或最新结果，不访问网络。</p>
    <c-form
      ref="formRef"
      :model="model"
      :disabled="disabled"
      :readonly="readonly"
    >
      <c-form-item
        v-if="mounted"
        field="name"
        label="用户名"
        :label-attrs="{ for: demoId }"
        :rules="rules"
        :validate-trigger="[]"
        feedback
      >
        <c-input :id="demoId" v-model="model.name" placeholder="请输入 admin" />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <div class="async-race-controls">
      <c-checkbox v-model="disabled"> Disable async form</c-checkbox>
      <c-checkbox v-model="readonly"> Readonly async form</c-checkbox>
      <c-checkbox v-model="mounted"> Mount async field</c-checkbox>
    </div>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button :disabled="!mounted" @click="validate">校验字段</c-button>
      <c-button :disabled="!mounted" @click="validateAll">校验整表</c-button>
      <c-button :disabled="!pending.length" @click="complete(false)"
        >返回最早结果</c-button
      >
      <c-button :disabled="!pending.length" @click="complete(true)"
        >返回最新结果</c-button
      >
      <c-button :disabled="!mounted" @click="serverError"
        >写入服务端错误</c-button
      >
      <c-button @click="clear">清空校验</c-button>
      <c-button @click="reset">重置</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <p role="status">校验结果：{{ result }}；等待结果：{{ pending.length }}</p>
    <p>本次校验值：{{ checkedValue || "空" }}</p>
    <ModelOutput>{{ model }}</ModelOutput>
  </section>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import ModelOutput from "../__demo-utils__/ModelOutput.vue";

import {
  onBeforeUnmount,
  onDeactivated,
  reactive,
  ref,
  shallowRef,
  useId,
} from "vue";
import type { FormInstance, FieldRule } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";

interface Pending {
  value: unknown;
  resolve: (result: true | string) => void;
}
const demoId = useId();
const disabled = ref(false);
const readonly = ref(false);
const mounted = ref(true);
const formRef = ref<FormInstance>();
const model = reactive({ name: "" });
const pending = shallowRef<Pending[]>([]);
const result = ref("尚未校验");
const checkedValue = ref("");
let run = 0;

function request(value: unknown) {
  return new Promise<true | string>((resolve) => {
    pending.value = [...pending.value, { value, resolve }];
  });
}
const rules: FieldRule[] = [
  {
    validator: async (value, callback) => {
      const answer = await request(value);
      if (answer !== true) callback(answer);
    },
  },
];

function validate() {
  return validateScope(false);
}
function validateAll() {
  return validateScope(true);
}
async function validateScope(all: boolean) {
  const current = ++run;
  checkedValue.value = model.name;
  result.value = "校验中";
  const errors = await (all
    ? formRef.value?.validate()
    : formRef.value?.validateField("name"));
  if (current === run) result.value = errors ? "未通过" : "通过";
}
function complete(latest: boolean) {
  const task = latest ? pending.value.at(-1) : pending.value[0];
  if (!task) return;
  pending.value = pending.value.filter((item) => item !== task);
  task.resolve(task.value === "admin" ? true : "用户名必须是 admin");
}
function clear() {
  run++;
  formRef.value?.clearValidate();
  result.value = "已清空";
}
function serverError() {
  run++;
  formRef.value?.setFields({
    name: { status: "error", message: "模拟服务端拒绝" },
  });
  result.value = "服务端错误";
}
function reset() {
  run++;
  formRef.value?.resetFields();
  checkedValue.value = "";
  result.value = "已重置";
}
function cleanup() {
  run++;
  result.value = "已取消";
  const tasks = pending.value;
  pending.value = [];
  tasks.forEach((task) => task.resolve(true));
}
onBeforeUnmount(cleanup);
onDeactivated(cleanup);
</script>

<style scoped>
.async-race-controls {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
}
.async-race-controls label {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}
</style>
```

### 日期范围的跨页边界

比较日期、月份、年份范围：禁用 2027-01-01、2026-12、2100 年。禁用项不能作为端点，范围可以跨过它们；翻页后检查禁用项仍保持灰态。

Example source: src/form/__demos__/field-range-boundaries.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import ModelOutput from "../__demo-utils__/ModelOutput.vue";
const model = ref<{
  days: [string, string];
  months: [string, string];
  years: [string, string];
}>({
  days: ["2026-12-29", "2027-01-03"],
  months: ["2026-11", "2027-02"],
  years: ["2098", "2102"],
});
const disabledDay = (date: Date) =>
  date.getFullYear() === 2027 && date.getMonth() === 0 && date.getDate() === 1;
const disabledMonth = (date: Date) =>
  date.getFullYear() === 2026 && date.getMonth() === 11;
const disabledYear = (date: Date) => date.getFullYear() === 2100;
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <c-form :model="model">
      <c-form-item field="days" label="跨月日期"
        ><c-date-range
          v-model="model.days"
          value-format="YYYY-MM-DD"
          :disabled-date="disabledDay"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="months" label="跨年月份"
        ><c-date-range
          v-model="model.months"
          type="month"
          value-format="YYYY-MM"
          :disabled-date="disabledMonth"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="years" label="跨页年份"
        ><c-date-range
          v-model="model.years"
          type="year"
          value-format="YYYY"
          :disabled-date="disabledYear"

    </c-form>
    <ModelOutput>{{ JSON.stringify(model, null, 2) }}</ModelOutput>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### 异步提交的输入归属

原生提交只接受本次校验期间保持有效的响应式模型和规则。等待中修改任意模型字段（包括其他字段或改后恢复）、替换模型/规则、修改 FormItem 的规则/required/field，或增删已注册字段，会使本次提交失效。旧校验成功或失败都不再触发 submit、submit-success、submit-failed，也不触发自动错误滚动；需重新提交校验最新输入。这是逻辑失效，不取消请求、不自动重试，也不改变命令式 validate 的返回约定；已有提交历史保留。业务模型应使用响应式状态，让 Vue 能观察到输入变化。普通事件监听器返回的 Promise 不被收集。

Example source: src/form/__demos__/submit-inputs.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("formSubmitInputsInline");

import {
  onBeforeUnmount,
  onDeactivated,
  reactive,
  ref,
  shallowRef,
  useId,
} from "vue";
const id = useId();
const model = reactive({ name: "allowed" });
const pending = shallowRef<
  { value: unknown; resolve: (result: boolean | string) => void }[]
>([]);
const submissions = ref(0);
const snapshot = ref("-");
function request(value: unknown) {
  return new Promise<boolean | string>((resolve) => {
    pending.value = [...pending.value, { value, resolve }];
  });
}
const rules = [
  {
    validator: async (value: unknown, callback: (message?: string) => void) => {
      const result = await request(value);
      if (result !== true) callback(String(result));
    },
  },
];
function complete() {
  const [task, ...rest] = pending.value;
  if (!task) return;
  pending.value = rest;
  task.resolve(task.value === "allowed" ? true : inlineCopy.value.enterAllowed);
}
function submitted(data: {
  values: Record<string, unknown>;
  errors?: unknown;
}) {
  submissions.value++;
  snapshot.value = JSON.stringify({ values: data.values, valid: !data.errors });
}
function cleanup() {
  const tasks = pending.value;
  pending.value = [];
  tasks.forEach((task) => task.resolve(false));
}
onBeforeUnmount(cleanup);
onDeactivated(cleanup);
</script>
<template>
  <section>
    <p>{{ inlineCopy.editWhileWaitingThenResolve }}</p>
    <c-form :model="model" edit-mode="direct" @submit="submitted">
      <c-form-item
        field="name"
        label="Name"
        :label-attrs="{ for: id }"
        :rules="rules"
        :validate-trigger="[]"
        feedback
      >
        <c-input :id="id" v-model="model.name" edit-mode="direct" />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-space>
        <c-button html-type="submit">{{ inlineCopy.submit }}</c-button>
        <c-button
          html-type="button"
          :disabled="!pending.length"
          @click="complete"
          >{{ inlineCopy.resolveOldest }}</c-button
        >
      </c-space>
    </c-form>
    <p role="status">
      Submissions: {{ submissions }}; pending: {{ pending.length }}
    </p>
    <pre class="submitted-values">{{ snapshot }}</pre>
  </section>
</template>
```

### 动态字段与重置初值

复用同一个 FormItem 时，field 变化会自动释放旧字段注册，并注册新的非空字段；清空 field 会取消注册。每个字段路径在该实例内保留首次可用初值，重访字段不会用当前编辑值覆盖初值。reset 按字段克隆初值，0、false、null 和缺失的 undefined 都保留。切换身份会取消旧编辑器、清理旧反馈，并使旧字段集合的校验回调失效；已经启动的命令式校验 Promise 仍独立结算，调用方管理自己的结果文案。

已有模型对象中的缺失属性会记录为 undefined；替换模型或规则不重新建立已缓存初值。异步数据若应作为初值，可在数据就绪后绑定 field 或渲染 FormItem；重新创建实例会建立新的初值基线。

Example source: src/form/__demos__/field-identity.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("formFieldIdentityInline");

import { reactive, ref, useId } from "vue";
const id = useId();
const form = ref();
const model = reactive({ a: "A initial", b: "B initial" });
const field = ref("a");
const submissions = ref(0);
const result = ref("-");
function reset() {
  if (field.value) form.value?.resetFields(field.value);
}
function submitted(data) {
  submissions.value++;
  result.value = data.errors ? "invalid" : "valid";
}
</script>
<template>
  <section>
    <p>{{ inlineCopy.theSameItemRetainsA }}</p>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button :disabled="field === 'a'" @click="field = 'a'">{{
        inlineCopy.bindA
      }}</c-button>
      <c-button :disabled="field === 'b'" @click="field = 'b'">{{
        inlineCopy.bindB
      }}</c-button>
      <c-button :disabled="!field" @click="field = ''">{{
        inlineCopy.unbind
      }}</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <c-form ref="form" :model="model" edit-mode="direct" @submit="submitted">
      <c-form-item
        :field="field"
        :label="field ? 'Field ' + field.toUpperCase() : 'Unbound'"
        :label-attrs="{ for: id }"
        required
        feedback
        :validate-trigger="[]"
      >
        <c-input
          v-if="field"
          :id="id"
          v-model="model[field]"
          edit-mode="direct"
        />
        <span v-else>{{ inlineCopy.noBoundField }}</span>
      </c-form-item>
      <c-space>
        <c-button html-type="button" :disabled="!field" @click="reset">{{
          inlineCopy.resetCurrent
        }}</c-button>
        <c-button html-type="submit" :disabled="!field">{{
          inlineCopy.validateAndSubmit
        }}</c-button>
      </c-space>
    </c-form>
    <p role="status">
      Field: {{ field || "-" }}; submissions: {{ submissions }}; result:
      {{ result }}
    </p>
    <pre class="field-model">{{ JSON.stringify(model) }}</pre>
  </section>
</template>
```

### 五档密度与项目间距

xs/sm/md/lg/xl 均通过 size 类选择对应几何；所有尺寸的项目下间距默认均为 16px，控件高度和标签字号仍随 size 变化。项目下间距和验证文案预留高度共同使用 size-*-item-margin-bottom；inline 使用独立 inline-item-margin-bottom，error/help 不重复添加项目下间距。

| 变量                                  | 默认值                      |
| ------------------------------------- | --------------------------- |
| `--c-form-size-xl-height`             | `var(--c-size-xl)`          |
| `--c-form-size-xl-label-font-size`    | `var(--c-sys-font-size-lg)` |
| `--c-form-size-xl-item-margin-bottom` | `var(--c-spacing-7)`        |

### edit-mode 继承规则

Form 支持 `direct / click / dblclick`；未设置时保留字段各自的默认值，FormItem 和字段继承上层显式设置的值，字段显式值优先。readPretty 是阅读属性，与 readonly/disabled 分开。确认编辑未结束时整表提交会失败并保留草稿；reset 取消编辑。原有默认插槽与 v-model 保持不变，不需要 editor 插槽。

`read-pretty` 为独立布尔属性，与 `readonly`、`disabled` 同级；字段 > FormItem > Form 继承，显式 `false` 覆盖父级。默认 `false`。纯阅读不显示编辑器。

## 业务流程

### 巡检任务完整流程

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### 本组配置对照

| 配置     | 作用                                 | 相关示例         |
| -------- | ------------------------------------ | ---------------- |
| `model`  | 表单数据对象                         | 巡检任务完整流程 |
| `layout` | 表单的布局方式，包括水平、垂直、多列 | 巡检任务完整流程 |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

填写、校验、确认、模拟失败与重试；返回修改不会覆盖已提交记录。

Example source: src/form/__demos__/task-workflow.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref } from "vue";
const fresh = () => ({ title: "", department: "ops", priority: "normal" });
const draft = ref(fresh());
const saved = ref(null);
const stage = ref("edit");
const message = ref("填写任务后进入确认；也可以直接提交空表单查看校验。");
const busy = ref(false);
const failNext = ref(false);
const formRef = ref();
const rules = [{ required: true, whitespace: true, message: "请输入任务名称" }];
const departments = [
  { value: "ops", label: "运营部" },
  { value: "dev", label: "研发部" },
  { value: "design", label: "设计部" },
];
const priorities = [
  { value: "normal", label: "普通" },
  { value: "urgent", label: "紧急" },
];
const departmentLabel = computed(
  () =>
    departments.find((item) => item.value === draft.value.department)?.label,
);
let timer;
let epoch = 0;
function cancelPending() {
  epoch++;
  clearTimeout(timer);
  busy.value = false;
}
onBeforeUnmount(cancelPending);
onDeactivated(cancelPending);
function review({ errors }) {
  if (errors) {
    message.value = "请补全必填项，任务尚未提交。";
    return;
  }
  stage.value = "review";
  message.value = "核对信息后确认提交；返回修改不会改变上次提交记录。";
}
function submit() {
  if (busy.value) return;
  const current = ++epoch;
  const snapshot = { ...draft.value };
  const shouldFail = failNext.value;
  failNext.value = false;
  busy.value = true;
  message.value = "正在本地模拟保存…";
  timer = setTimeout(() => {
    if (current !== epoch) return;
    busy.value = false;
    if (shouldFail) {
      message.value = "保存失败：草稿已保留，请点击“重试提交”。";
      return;
    }
    saved.value = snapshot;
    stage.value = "done";
    message.value = "提交成功，已生成任务记录。";
  }, 500);
}
function reset() {
  cancelPending();
  draft.value = fresh();
  saved.value = null;
  stage.value = "edit";
  failNext.value = false;
  message.value = "已重置，可以重新演示。";
  formRef.value?.clearValidate();
}
function fill() {
  draft.value = {
    title: "展厅设备巡检",
    department: "ops",
    priority: "urgent",
  };
  formRef.value?.clearValidate();
}
</script>
<template>
  <section class="workflow-demo" aria-label="巡检任务完整流程">
    <ol class="workflow-demo__steps" aria-label="任务流程">
      <li :aria-current="stage === 'edit' ? 'step' : undefined">
        01 填写与校验
      </li>
      <li :aria-current="stage === 'review' ? 'step' : undefined">
        02 核对与提交
      </li>
      <li :aria-current="stage === 'done' ? 'step' : undefined">
        03 结果与记录
      </li>
    </ol>
    <c-form
      v-if="stage === 'edit'"
      ref="formRef"
      :model="draft"
      layout="vertical"
      @submit="review"
    >
      <c-form-item label="任务名称" field="title" :rules="rules" feedback
        ><c-input
          v-model="draft.title"
          edit-mode="direct"
          placeholder="例如：展厅设备巡检"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item label="执行部门" field="department"
        ><c-select
          v-model="draft.department"
          :options="departments"
          edit-mode="direct"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item label="任务优先级" field="priority"
        ><c-select
          v-model="draft.priority"
          :options="priorities"
          edit-mode="direct"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-space wrap
        ><c-button html-type="submit" status="primary">校验并预览</c-button
        ><c-button @click="fill">填入演示数据</c-button></c-space
      >
    </c-form>
    <div v-else-if="stage === 'review'">
      <h4>确认巡检任务</h4>
      <dl>
        <dt>任务</dt>
        <dd>{{ draft.title }}</dd>
        <dt>部门</dt>
        <dd>{{ departmentLabel }}</dd>
        <dt>优先级</dt>
        <dd>{{ draft.priority === "urgent" ? "紧急" : "普通" }}</dd>
      </dl>
      <c-checkbox v-model="failNext" :disabled="busy"
        >模拟下一次保存失败（本地）</c-checkbox
      >
      <c-space wrap
        ><c-button
          status="primary"
          :loading="busy"
          :disabled="busy"
          @click="submit"
          >{{
            message.includes("保存失败") ? "重试提交" : "确认提交"
          }}</c-button
        ><c-button :disabled="busy" @click="stage = 'edit'"
          >返回修改</c-button
        ></c-space
      >
    </div>
    <div v-else>
      <h4>任务已创建</h4>
      <p>
        {{ saved.title }} ·
        {{ saved.priority === "urgent" ? "紧急处理" : "普通处理" }}
      </p>
      <c-button @click="stage = 'edit'">继续编辑</c-button>
    </div>
    <p role="status" aria-live="polite">{{ message }}</p>
    <c-collapse>
      <c-collapse-item title="查看已提交记录" name="saved">
        <pre>{{
          saved
            ? JSON.stringify(saved, null, 2)
            : "尚无记录；校验失败、返回修改或保存失败都不会创建记录。"
        }}</pre>
      </c-collapse-item>
    </c-collapse>
    <c-button @click="reset">重新演示</c-button>
    <small
      >本例使用本地模拟保存，不访问业务服务。校验、确认、保存与失败恢复由业务流程组合。</small
    >
  </section>
</template>
<style scoped>
.workflow-demo {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}
.workflow-demo__steps {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
}
.workflow-demo__steps li {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--c-color-fill-1);
}
.workflow-demo__steps [aria-current] {
  color: var(--c-color-primary);
  font-weight: 700;
}
.workflow-demo dl {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 80px 1fr;
  gap: 8px;
}
.workflow-demo dd {
  margin: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.workflow-demo pre {
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.workflow-demo small {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 12px;
  color: var(--c-color-text-2);
}
</style>
```

## API

通过 edit-mode 设置编辑方式，通过 read-pretty 设置阅读状态。内部描述符名称 fieldEditModeProp 不是 Form 或 FormItem 的公开属性。


### 空值识别与阅读空文案

Form / FormItem 通过 `empty-values` 提供空值识别策略；字段自己的 `empty-value` 决定清空输出。`empty-text` 仅在 `read-pretty` 空内容下展示，默认 `'-'`，字段 > FormItem > Form，自定义 read 插槽优先。显式配置 empty-values 后，内置 required 接入该策略，自定义校验仍收到原值。详见[统一说明](llms/zh-CN/guide/empty-values.md)。

| 参数         | 类型               | 缺省与范围                                            |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | 字段 > FormItem > Form > 组件族默认；完整覆盖，不合并 |
| empty-text   | string             | 字段 > FormItem > Form > '-'；显式 '' 有效            |

以上是字段展示层 API；纯面板不因此新增阅读模式。Form 与 FormItem 提供继承配置。empty-value 的现有类型与默认输出仍按该组件原 API 执行。

### Form Props

| 参数名            | 描述                                                                                                    | 类型                                       |        默认值         |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | :-------------------: |
| model             | 表单数据对象                                                                                            | `object`                                   |         `{}`          |
| layout            | 表单的布局方式，包括水平、垂直、多列                                                                    | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical' \| 'inline'`   |    `'horizontal'`     |
| size              | 表单控件的尺寸                                                                                          | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'`     |        `'md'`         |
| label-col-flex    | 标签列 flex；数字为伸缩比例，带单位字符串为宽度                                                         | `number \| string`                         |          `-`          |
| label-col-style   | 标签列逐实例样式                                                                                        | `CSSProperties`                            |          `-`          |
| wrapper-col-style | 内容列逐实例样式                                                                                        | `CSSProperties`                            |          `-`          |
| label-col-props   | 标签元素布局选项。参数同 `<col>` 组件一致                                                               | `object`                                   | `span: 5, offset: 0`  |
| wrapper-col-props | 表单控件布局选项。参数同 `<col>` 组件一致                                                               | `object`                                   | `span: 19, offset: 0` |
| label-align       | 标签的对齐方向                                                                                          | `'start' \| 'end' \| 'left' \| 'right'`                        |       `'end'`       |
| `content-align`   | 内容对齐，统一控制 direct 字段、弹出入口及 readPretty；与 label-align 独立                              | `'start' \| 'end' \| 'left' \| 'center' \| 'right'`            |       `'start'`        |
| `read-pretty`     | 独立的阅读开关；为 true 时展示已保存的值，关闭后恢复当前 edit-mode 的编辑方式；FormItem 未传时继承 Form | `boolean`                                  |          `-`          |
| `edit-mode`       | 表单内字段的统一编辑模式；未设置时保留各字段默认值                                                      | `'direct' \| 'click' \| 'dblclick'`        |          `-`          |
| disabled          | 是否禁用表单                                                                                            | `boolean`                                  |          `-`          |
| readonly          | 是否将表单控件设为只读                                                                                  | `boolean`                                  |          `-`          |
| rules             | 表单项校验规则                                                                                          | `Record<string, FieldRule \| FieldRule[]>` |          `-`          |
| auto-label-width  | 是否开启自动标签宽度，仅在 `layout="horizontal"` 下生效。                                               | `boolean`                                  |        `false`        |
| id                | 表单控件`id`的前缀                                                                                      | `string`                                   |          `-`          |
| scroll-to-error   | 验证失败后滚动到页面顺序的第一个（start）或最后一个（end）错误字段；不是视口对齐方式                    | `'start' \| 'end'`                         |        不滚动         |

### Form Events

| 事件名         | 描述                                   | 参数                                                                                                      |

| reset          | 原生重置时触发，并重置字段值与校验状态 | ev: `Event`                                                                                               |

### Cedar 规则协议

FieldRule 保留对象规则及 callback 错误通路：调用 callback(message) 表示业务不通过，异步规则必须返回 Promise，正常完成且没有错误回调才表示通过。仅稍后调用 callback 却不返回 Promise 不在等待合同内；返回 false 或错误字符串不会替代 callback。

意外 throw 或 Promise 拒绝会让公开 validate 拒绝，调用方用 try/catch 处理；最新任务释放 validating 并恢复之前的业务错误，不合成业务校验失败。旧任务异常不会清除新任务的等待状态。

```ts
import type { FieldRule } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'
const nameRule: FieldRule<string> = {
  validator: async (value, callback, context) => {
    await Promise.resolve()
    if (!value) callback(`${context?.field} is required`)
  },
}
```

### 公开校验与通知合同

Form 与 FormItem 的默认插槽没有作用域参数；FormItem 还提供 label、help、extra 插槽，均不通过参数操作模型。Form 使用 model 对象及字段路径管理状态，不以插槽参数替代业务模型。

`validate(callback?)` 和 `validateField(fields, callback?)` 等待对应规则，成功返回 undefined，业务失败返回按字段聚合的错误对象；回调只通知当前有效任务。错误记录包含 field、message、label、value、type、isRequiredError。value 保留原字段值，不先转换成显示文字。

submit-success 先于 submit 通知，业务校验失败时 submit-failed 先于 submit。编辑会话未完成的阻止分支只通知 submit-failed，其 errors.editing 只有 field="editing" 与 message，不伪造字段校验信息；公开类型 FormSubmitError 区分该提示与完整 ValidatedError。

这些事件是通知，不等待监听器 Promise，也不自动执行请求或切换 loading。业务异步保存自行控制 loading。原生 reset 会阻止默认行为、执行 resetFields 后通知 reset；Form 的 resetFields 会写回 model，与 FilterForm 内部 Form 的职责不同。

`beforeCommit` 属于支持编辑事务的字段组件，签名为 `(payload, done, context) => void | boolean | Promise<void | boolean>`；payload 含 value、previousValue，context 含 signal 和可选 event。返回 undefined 表示等待 done；返回布尔或 Promise 按结果结算。它不是 Form 的 submit 事件或通用加载入口。

```ts
import type {
  FormProps, FormItemProps, FormInstance, FormItemInstance,
  ValidatedError, FormValidateErrors, FieldData,
  FormEmits, FormSlots, FormItemSlots, FormSubmitError,
  BeforeFieldCommit,
} from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'
```
自定义表单控件可在 `setup` 中调用 `useFormErrorDescription()`，将返回的 `describe(existingIds)` 绑定到实际交互元素的 `aria-describedby`。它会保留已有描述，并在 FormItem 显示或清除错误时同步添加或移除错误 ID；控件不在 FormItem 内时仅保留已有描述。

分区的属性和插槽见 [Section 内容分区](llms/zh-CN/components/section.md)。

# Grid

CSS Grid 布局：列数、跨列、间距、折叠与后缀。24 栏 Flex 布局使用 Row / Col。

> **布局怎么选**
>
> - Grid + GridItem：适合表单分栏、卡片网格，需要统一列宽、跨列、响应式列数或折叠行与后缀时使用。
> - Row + Col：适合 24 栏 Flex 布局，需要水平/垂直对齐、控制换行、固定宽度与自适应宽度组合，或响应式排序时使用。Row 控制整行，Col 控制列宽、偏移和排序。
> - Space：适合按钮、标签、文字等简单排列，只需要间距、方向和对齐时使用；更自由的宽度分配可使用原生 Flex。

## 基础示例

### 列数、跨列与偏移

Example source: src/grid/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<template><div>
  <c-grid :cols="4" :col-gap="12" :row-gap="12"><c-grid-item v-for="i in 8" :key="i" class="cell">{{ i }}</c-grid-item></c-grid>
  <c-grid :cols="4" :col-gap="12" :row-gap="12"><c-grid-item :span="2" class="cell">span 2</c-grid-item><c-grid-item :offset="1" class="cell soft">offset 1</c-grid-item><c-grid-item :span="4" class="cell">span 4</c-grid-item></c-grid>
</div></template>

<style scoped>
.controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.cell { box-sizing: border-box; padding: 12px; min-width: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--c-color-primary); color: var(--c-color-white); text-align: center; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.soft { opacity: .7; }
</style>
```

## 布局与排列

| `col-gap` | 列间距（px） | 响应式列数、间距与跨列 |
| `row-gap` | 行间距（px） | 响应式列数、间距与跨列 |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

```vue
<template><div>
  <p>xs: 1 column · sm: 2 columns · md: 4 columns</p>
  <c-grid :cols="{ xs: 1, sm: 2, md: 4 }" :col-gap="{ xs: 8, md: 16 }" :row-gap="{ xs: 8, md: 16 }">
    <c-grid-item :span="{ xs: 1, md: 2 }" class="cell">Responsive span</c-grid-item><c-grid-item v-for="i in 6" :key="i" class="cell soft">{{ i }}</c-grid-item>
  </c-grid>
```

## 自定义与插槽

### 折叠行数与后缀插槽

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### 本组配置对照

| 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cols` | 每行列数，最少为 1 | 折叠行数与后缀插槽 |
| `col-gap` | 列间距（px） | 折叠行数与后缀插槽 |
| `row-gap` | 行间距（px） | 折叠行数与后缀插槽 |
| `collapsed` | 折叠超出的行 | 折叠行数与后缀插槽 |
| `collapsed-rows` | 折叠时保留行数，最少为 1 | 折叠行数与后缀插槽 |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

示例由父级保存 `collapsed` 和行数；More/Less 与开关修改同一状态。4列折叠1行时展示3项及后缀，2行时展示7项及后缀；展开后展示全部9项及后缀。后缀占一个网格位置，不是浮在内容之上的额外按钮。

Example source: src/grid/__demos__/collapse.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
const collapsed = ref(true)
const rows = ref(1)
</script>
<template><div>
  <div class="controls"><c-switch v-model="collapsed" aria-label="Collapsed" />Collapsed<c-radio-group v-model="rows"><c-radio :value="1">1 row</c-radio><c-radio :value="2">2 rows</c-radio></c-radio-group></div>
  <c-grid :cols="4" :col-gap="12" :row-gap="12" :collapsed="collapsed" :collapsed-rows="rows">
    <c-grid-item v-for="i in 9" :key="i" class="cell">{{ i }}</c-grid-item>
    <c-grid-item suffix v-slot="{ overflow }"><c-button block variant="outline" @click="collapsed = !collapsed">{{ overflow ? 'More' : 'Less' }}</c-button></c-grid-item>
  </c-grid>
</div></template>

<style scoped>
.controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.cell { box-sizing: border-box; padding: 12px; min-width: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--c-color-primary); color: var(--c-color-white); text-align: center; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.soft { opacity: .7; }
</style>
```

## 交互与控制

### 动态插入、删除与排序

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### 本组配置对照

| 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cols` | 每行列数，最少为 1 | 动态插入、删除与排序 |
| `col-gap` | 列间距（px） | 动态插入、删除与排序 |
| `row-gap` | 行间距（px） | 动态插入、删除与排序 |
| `collapsed` | 折叠超出的行 | 动态插入、删除与排序 |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

按钮只修改本例的数据数组；删除至空时禁用 Remove first，后缀显示 End。重新插入后恢复布局与删除能力。Grid 本身不提供新增/删除业务事件。

Example source: src/grid/__demos__/dynamic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
const items = ref([1, 2, 3, 4, 5])
let next = 6
</script>
<template><div>
  <div class="controls"><c-button @click="items.unshift(next++)">Insert first</c-button><c-button :disabled="!items.length" @click="items.shift()">Remove first</c-button><c-button @click="items.reverse()">Reverse</c-button></div>
  <c-grid :cols="3" :col-gap="12" :row-gap="12" collapsed><c-grid-item v-for="i in items" :key="i" class="cell">{{ i }}</c-grid-item><c-grid-item suffix v-slot="{ overflow }" class="cell soft">{{ overflow ? '…' : 'End' }}</c-grid-item></c-grid>
</div></template>

<style scoped>
.controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.cell { box-sizing: border-box; padding: 12px; min-width: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--c-color-primary); color: var(--c-color-white); text-align: center; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.soft { opacity: .7; }
</style>
```

## API

<!-- same-source-api:start -->

### Grid Props

| 属性 | 说明 | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| cols | 每行列数，最少为 1 | `number / ResponsiveValue` | `24` |
| row-gap | 行间距（px） | `number / ResponsiveValue` | `0` |
| col-gap | 列间距（px） | `number / ResponsiveValue` | `0` |
| collapsed | 折叠超出的行 | `boolean` | `false` |
| collapsed-rows | 折叠时保留行数，最少为 1 | `number` | `1` |

### Grid Events

| Event | Description |
| --- | --- |

### Grid Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | 布局内容 |

### Grid Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
<!-- same-source-api:end -->

### GridItem Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| span | 跨越格数 | number / ResponsiveValue | 1 |
| offset | 逻辑行内起点留空格数 | number / ResponsiveValue | 0 |
| suffix | 行末后缀 | boolean | false |

默认插槽参数 `{ overflow: boolean }` 表示父 Grid 是否因折叠隐藏了普通项，所有 GridItem（含后缀）读取同一个整体状态，并非当前项自身溢出；展开时为 false。SSR 和挂载前先显示全部项，挂载后再计算折叠，首屏可能出现布局变化。offset 从逻辑行内起点留空，RTL 自动镜像；span 表示内容跨列数，offset 另计入轨道预算。没有自定义事件或公开方法。

## 响应式与可访问性

断点基于浏览器视口：xs 为基础值，sm ≥576、md ≥768、lg ≥992、xl ≥1200、xxl ≥1600px；从最大匹配断点向下取已配置值。SSR 首屏使用 xs，挂载后响应视口；Grid 折叠和动态排序在挂载后计算。组件为布局容器，不增加键盘快捷键；内容语义及可聚焦元素由调用者提供。没有公开方法和专用主题 Token。

## 导入

Grid 仅包含 Grid.Item。Row、Col 是独立组件，请从库根入口或对应的 row/col 子入口导入；安装 Grid 不会注册 Row 或 Col。旧 Grid.Row/Grid.Col 以及 GridRowInstance/GridColInstance 不再提供。

## 数值和折叠预算

数值输入必须有限；保留既有有限数值的取整和归零规则：cols 向下取整且至少 1，collapsed-rows 至少 1 行，负间距和负 offset 归零，span 非正数隐藏。非有限或畸形输入按各属性默认值回退：cols=24、collapsed-rows=1、span=1，间距及 offset=0。响应式对象仅接受六个断点，保留有效字段；undefined 视为省略。开发环境使用统一的 Vue 属性校验提示。

折叠预算按实际 DOM 顺序计算，后缀可位于开头、中间或末尾，不会为计算而移动内容节点。后缀仍定位在所在行的逻辑末端，因此其后的普通项可能换行。普通项保留能容纳的连续前缀；所有后缀始终保留。若后缀自身已超出行数预算，保留后缀优先于限制总行数。视觉布局不改变 DOM、键盘或辅助技术阅读顺序。
## CSS Variables

<!-- component-css-variables:start -->

本组件未声明独立的公共 CSS 变量。请使用本页公开的配置与布局入口。

内部自定义属性与测量中间值属于实现细节，不作为业务定制 API。

<!-- component-css-variables:end -->

# Hover 悬停反馈

`v-hover` 通过鼠标进入和离开更新样式或通知回调；`HoverOverlay` 根据显式的悬停与聚焦状态绘制装饰遮层。两者可独立组合，遮层不接管点击和键盘语义。

## 基础示例

### 悬停与焦点

将鼠标移入按钮，观察悬停状态；再通过 Tab 聚焦，观察焦点状态。示例使用原生按钮语义，悬停指令自身只处理 mouseenter / mouseleave，键盘焦点由宿主事件传入。

Example source: src/hover/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { Hover, useHoverOverlay } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'
import '@cedar-design/ui-vue/hover/style'

const vHover = Hover
const { hovering, handleHovering } = useHoverOverlay()
const focusing = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-button v-hover="handleHovering" class="hover-example-target" @focus="focusing = true" @blur="focusing = false">
      将鼠标移入，或用 Tab 聚焦
      <c-hover-overlay :hovering="hovering" :focusing="focusing" />
    </c-button>
    <span role="status">悬停：{{ hovering ? '是' : '否' }}；焦点：{{ focusing ? '是' : '否' }}</span>
  </c-space>
</template>

<style scoped>
.hover-example-target { position: relative; }
</style>
```

## API

### 指令

| 用法 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `v-hover="callback"` | 鼠标进入和离开时通知 `(hovering: boolean) => void` |
| `v-hover="styleObject"` | 鼠标进入时应用样式，离开时恢复 |
| `v-hover:desktop` / `v-hover:mobile` | 按指令的端侧判断启用，不代表支持真实触屏悬停 |

### HoverOverlay Props

| 属性 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| hovering | boolean | false | 悬停装饰状态 |
| focusing | boolean | false | 焦点装饰状态 |

`useHoverOverlay()` 返回 `hovering` 与 `handleHovering`，可连接指令回调。遮层不提供声明事件、插槽或业务实例方法，不接管交互；遮层使用绝对定位，宿主需提供定位上下文；独立使用时引入 `@cedar-design/ui-vue/hover/style`。

对象样式只覆盖传入的属性，离开或停用时恢复这些属性原有的内联值和 `!important` 优先级；动态切换 desktop/mobile 参数会清理旧监听。

## CSS Variables

<!-- component-css-variables:start -->

通过以下变量定制组件外观。默认值随表中注明的主题或选择器条件变化；变量仅在对应的尺寸、变体和交互状态下生效。

<div class="token-reference-table" style="max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto;">

| 变量 | 默认值／条件 | 影响的样式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--c-hover-overlay-focusing-opacity` | `0.12` | `opacity` |
| `--c-hover-overlay-opacity` | `0.04` | `opacity` |
| `--c-hover-transition-duration` | `var(--c-sys-motion-duration-fast)` | `transition` |

</div>

将覆盖设置在组件实际根节点或弹层真实挂载祖先上。例如给该元素添加下列 class，再按需替换变量值：

```css
.component-theme {
  --c-hover-overlay-focusing-opacity: 0.12;
}
```

显式行内样式及直接写入同一 CSS 属性的 Props 优先于样式表默认值。Teleport 后，普通 CSS 变量按实际挂载位置继承；使用 ThemeProvider 时，请遵循其局部主题与弹层配置规则。局部定制请直接覆盖组件变量；仅修改后代的 system 变量不会重新计算从根继承的组件别名。内部变量不属于公共 API。

<!-- component-css-variables:end -->
