```vue
    <template #event="{ event }">
      <span>{{ event.title }}</span>
      <c-tag size="sm" :status="event.readonly ? 'neutral' : 'info'">
        {{ typeOf(event).label }} · {{ event.readonly ? "只读" : "可编辑" }}
      </c-tag>
    </template>

    <template
      #editor="{
        action,
        event,
        save,
        remove,
        close,
        readonly,
        pending,
        errorMessage,
      }"
    >
      <h3>{{ action === "create" ? "新增日程" : "编辑日程" }}</h3>
      <c-alert v-if="errorMessage" status="danger">
        {{ errorMessage }}
      </c-alert>
      <c-form
        :model="event"
        layout="vertical"
        @submit="prepareAndSave(event, save)"
      >
        <c-form-item label="日程类型">
          <c-select
            :model-value="typeOf(event).id"
            :disabled="readonly || pending"
            @update:model-value="applyType(event, $event)"
          >
            <c-option
              v-for="type in eventTypes"
              :key="type.id"
              :value="type.id"
            >
              {{ type.label }} · {{ type.readonly ? "默认只读" : "默认可编辑" }}
            </c-option>
          </c-select>
        </c-form-item>

        <div class="scheduler-type-preview" :style="previewStyle(event)">
          <strong>{{ typeOf(event).label }}</strong>
          <span>{{ typeOf(event).description }}</span>
        </div>

        <c-form-item label="标题">
          <c-input
            v-model="event.title"
            :disabled="readonly || pending"
            placeholder="请输入日程标题"
          />
        </c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="开始时间">
          <c-date
            :model-value="
              event.start == null ? undefined : schedulerDate(event.start)
            "
            :disabled="readonly || pending"
            show-time
            value-format="Date"
            @update:model-value="event.start = $event"
          />
        </c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="结束时间">
          <c-date
            :model-value="
              event.end == null ? undefined : schedulerDate(event.end)
            "
            :disabled="readonly || pending"
            show-time
            value-format="Date"
            @update:model-value="event.end = $event"
          />
        </c-form-item>
        <c-form-item>
          <c-checkbox
            :model-value="!event.readonly"
            :disabled="readonly || pending"
            @update:model-value="event.readonly = !$event"
          >
            创建后允许修改和拖拽
          </c-checkbox>
        </c-form-item>
        <c-space>
          <c-button :disabled="pending" @click="close">取消</c-button>
          <c-button
            v-if="action === 'edit' && !readonly"
            status="danger"
            :disabled="pending"
            @click="remove"
            >删除</c-button
          >
          <c-button
            v-if="!readonly"
            html-type="submit"
            status="primary"
            :loading="pending"
            >保存日程</c-button
          >
        </c-space>
      </c-form>
    </template>
  </c-scheduler>
  </c-loading>
  <c-collapse class="scheduler-mock-log">
    <c-collapse-item name="request" title="查看最近一次 Mock API 请求">
      <pre>{{ lastRequest || "尚未提交" }}</pre>
    </c-collapse-item>
  </c-collapse>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, ref } from "vue";
import { resources } from "./data";
import { cloneSchedulerEvent, schedulerDate } from "../core";
import type {
  SchedulerBeforeChange,
  SchedulerEvent,
  SchedulerEventBackgroundPattern,
} from "../index";

type EventType = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  description: string;
  title: string;
  color: string;
  backgroundColor: string;
  backgroundPattern: SchedulerEventBackgroundPattern;
  readonly: boolean;
};

const eventTypes: EventType[] = [
  {
    id: "work",
    label: "工作安排",
    description: "普通任务，可继续编辑和拖拽调整时间。",
    title: "工作安排",
    color: "#1677ff",
    backgroundColor: "#e6f4ff",
    backgroundPattern: "solid",
    readonly: false,
  },
  {
    id: "meeting",
    label: "会议",
    description: "用圆点背景区分协作和沟通类日程。",
    title: "会议",
    color: "#d48806",
    backgroundColor: "#fffbe6",
    backgroundPattern: "dots",
    readonly: false,
  },
  {
    id: "rest",
    label: "休息",
    description: "休息时段默认锁定，保存后不允许修改或拖拽。",
    title: "休息",
    color: "#00a854",
    backgroundColor: "#f0fff4",
    backgroundPattern: "diagonal-stripes",
    readonly: true,
  },
  {
    id: "blocked",
    label: "不可用时段",
    description: "用于停机、封场等占用，默认只读。",
    title: "不可用时段",
    color: "#722ed1",
    backgroundColor: "#f9f0ff",
    backgroundPattern: "crosshatch",
    readonly: true,
  },
];

const seedEvents: SchedulerEvent[] = [
  createEvent("work", "work-1", "需求评审", "09:00", "10:30"),
  createEvent("meeting", "meeting-1", "项目周会", "10:00", "11:30"),
  createEvent("rest", "rest-1", "张志强 休息", "13:00", "15:00"),
  createEvent("blocked", "blocked-1", "会议室维护", "15:30", "17:30"),
];
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([]);
const loading = ref(true);
const rejectSave = ref(false);
const requestStatus = ref("正在从 Mock API 加载…");
const lastRequest = ref("");
let mockDatabase = seedEvents.map(cloneSchedulerEvent);

const wait = (milliseconds: number) =>
  new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, milliseconds));
const mockApi = {
  async list() {
    await wait(300);
    return mockDatabase.map(cloneSchedulerEvent);
  },
  async save(next: SchedulerEvent[]) {
    await wait(500);
    if (rejectSave.value) throw new Error("Mock API：保存被拒绝");
    mockDatabase = next.map(cloneSchedulerEvent);
    return {
      revision: Date.now(),
      events: mockDatabase.map(cloneSchedulerEvent),
    };
  },
};

onMounted(async () => {
  events.value = await mockApi.list();
  loading.value = false;
  requestStatus.value = `已加载 ${events.value.length} 条日程`;
});

const saveToMockServer: SchedulerBeforeChange = async (context) => {
  lastRequest.value = JSON.stringify(
    {
      method: "PUT",
      url: "/api/scheduler/events",
      change: context.type,
      event: context.event,
      events: context.value,
    },
    null,
    2,
  );
  requestStatus.value = "正在提交 metadata 和日程数据…";
  try {
    const response = await mockApi.save(context.value);
    requestStatus.value = `保存成功 · revision ${response.revision}`;
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    requestStatus.value = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "保存失败";
    throw error;
  }
};

function createEvent(
  typeId: string,
  id: string,
  title: string,
  start: string,
  end: string,
): SchedulerEvent {
  const event: SchedulerEvent = {
    id,
    title,
    start: `2026-09-09T${start}:00`,
    end: `2026-09-09T${end}:00`,
    resourceIds: [],
  };
  applyType(event, typeId, false);
  return event;
}

function typeOf(event: SchedulerEvent): EventType {
  return (
    eventTypes.find((type) => type.id === event.metadata?.typeId) ??
    eventTypes[0]
  );
}

function applyType(event: SchedulerEvent, value: unknown, suggestTitle = true) {
  const previous = typeOf(event);
  const type = eventTypes.find((item) => item.id === value) ?? eventTypes[0];
  const replaceTitle =
    suggestTitle && (!event.title.trim() || event.title === previous.title);
  event.color = type.color;
  event.backgroundColor = type.backgroundColor;
  event.backgroundPattern = type.backgroundPattern;
  event.metadata = { ...event.metadata, typeId: type.id };
  event.readonly = type.readonly;
  if (replaceTitle) event.title = type.title;
}

function prepareAndSave(
  event: SchedulerEvent,
  save: (event?: SchedulerEvent) => void,
) {
  const type = typeOf(event);
  event.color ??= type.color;
  event.backgroundColor ??= type.backgroundColor;
  event.backgroundPattern ??= type.backgroundPattern;
  event.metadata = {
    ...event.metadata,
    typeId: type.id,
    clientRequestId: `demo-${Date.now()}`,
  };
  save(event);
}

function previewStyle(event: SchedulerEvent) {
  const color = event.color ?? "#1677ff";
  const background = event.backgroundColor ?? "#e6f4ff";
  const pattern = event.backgroundPattern;
  const images: Record<SchedulerEventBackgroundPattern, string> = {
    solid: `linear-gradient(${background}, ${background})`,
    "diagonal-stripes": `repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 0 8px, color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 18%, transparent) 8px 16px)`,
    dots: `radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 28%, transparent) 1.5px, transparent 1.5px)`,
    crosshatch: `repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 0 9px, color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 14%, transparent) 9px 11px), repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, transparent 0 9px, color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 14%, transparent) 9px 11px)`,
  };
  return {
    color,
    backgroundColor: background,
    backgroundImage: images[pattern ?? "solid"],
    backgroundSize: pattern === "dots" ? "10px 10px" : undefined,
    borderColor: color,
  };
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.scheduler-type-preview {
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

.scheduler-type-preview span {
  font-size: 12px;
  opacity: 0.75;
}

.scheduler-mock-log {
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.scheduler-mock-log pre {
  max-height: 260px;
  overflow: auto;
  padding: 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--c-color-fill-1);
  font-size: 12px;
}
</style>
```

### 自定义新建 / 编辑表单

`editor` 插槽替换内置 Drawer 的内容，`action` 区分 `create` / `edit`。`event` 是隔离草稿，可修改其字段；`save(event)` 提交完整日程，`save()` 提交当前自定义草稿。不得修改草稿 ID。二者都保留校验和 `before-change`，成功才自动关闭；取消不会写入数据。

`error` 是结构化 SchedulerError，`errorMessage` 是当前语言的显示文案，包含内置字段校验或保存失败。自定义内容负责显示错误并根据 `readonly` / `pending` 禁用控件。`save` 是触发提交的动作，不返回成功 Promise；需要等待结果请使用实例 `change()`。`remove()` 和 `duplicate()` 在新建模式下无效。

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/custom-editor.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-checkbox v-model="reject">模拟接口拒绝保存</c-checkbox>
  <p>保留内置抽屉，替换全部表单内容；可看到新建/编辑标识及校验、接口错误。</p>
  <c-scheduler
    v-model="events"
    default-date="2026-09-09"
    default-mode="day"
    :before-change="beforeChange"
  >
    <template
      #editor="{
        action,
        event,
        save,
        remove,
        close,
        readonly,
        pending,
        errorMessage,
      }"
    >
      <h3>{{ action === "create" ? "新增工作计划" : "修改工作计划" }}</h3>
      <c-alert v-if="errorMessage" status="danger">{{ errorMessage }}</c-alert>
      <c-form :model="event" layout="vertical" @submit="save(event)">
        <c-form-item label="计划标题">
          <c-input v-model="event.title" :disabled="readonly || pending" />
        </c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="开始时间">
          <c-date
            :model-value="event.start == null ? undefined : schedulerDate(event.start)"
            @update:model-value="event.start = $event"
            :show-time="!event.allDay"
            value-format="Date"
            :disabled="readonly || pending"
          />
        </c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="结束时间（不含）">
          <c-date
            :model-value="event.end == null ? undefined : schedulerDate(event.end)"
            @update:model-value="event.end = $event"
            :show-time="!event.allDay"
            value-format="Date"
            :disabled="readonly || pending"
          />
        </c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="验收说明">
          <c-textarea
            v-model="event.description"
            :disabled="readonly || pending"
          />
        </c-form-item>
        <c-space>
          <c-button :disabled="pending" @click="close">取消</c-button>
          <c-button
            v-if="action === 'edit' && !readonly"
            status="danger"
            :disabled="pending"
            @click="remove"
            >删除</c-button
          >
          <c-button
            v-if="!readonly"
            html-type="submit"
            status="primary"
            :loading="pending"
            >保存计划</c-button
          >
        </c-space>
      </c-form>
    </template>
  </c-scheduler>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import { schedulerDate } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue/scheduler/core";
import type { SchedulerEvent, SchedulerBeforeChange } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([
  {
    id: "plan",
    title: "交付验收",
    start: "2026-09-09T09:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-09T10:00:00",
    description: "确认验收清单",
  },
]);
const reject = ref(false);
const beforeChange: SchedulerBeforeChange = async () => {
  if (reject.value) throw new Error("模拟接口拒绝");
  return true;
};
</script>
```

### 完全自定义弹窗 / 页面

设置 `editable=false` 后，工具栏新增、空白格点击、卡片拖入和已有日程点击统一通过 `editor-request` 交给业务方。组件不打开内置 Drawer，也不自动保存。`request.event` 已带生成的 ID、日期/时间和资源；`source` 标明来源，`readonly` 用于只读详情。

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/external-editor.vue

```vue
<template>
  <p>
    关闭内置编辑器，统一接收工具栏、日期格、卡片拖入及已有日程请求，使用独立
    Dialog。取消不写入，保存失败保留表单。
  </p>
  <c-checkbox v-model="reject">下一次模拟接口提交失败</c-checkbox>
  <c-scheduler
    ref="scheduler"
    v-model="events"
    :editable="false"
    default-date="2026-09-09"
    default-mode="day"
    :before-change="beforeChange"
    @editor-request="openEditor"
    @change-error="showError"
  >
    <template #sidebar-extra="{ startDrag, cancelDrag, disabled }">
      <c-button
        :draggable="!disabled"
        :disabled="disabled"
        @dragstart="startDrag(card, $event)"
        @dragend="cancelDrag"
        >拖入：现场检查 · 60 分钟</c-button
      >
    </template>
  </c-scheduler>
  <c-dialog
    v-model:open="open"
    :title="request?.action === 'create' ? '业务新增窗口' : '业务详情窗口'"
    :footer="false"
    :closable="!saving"
    :overlay-closable="!saving"
    :esc-to-close="!saving"
  >
    <template v-if="draft">
      <p>请求来源：{{ request?.source }}；业务页面也可接收相同请求。</p>
      <c-alert v-if="errorMessage" status="danger">{{ errorMessage }}</c-alert>
      <c-form :model="draft" layout="vertical" @submit="submit()">
        <c-form-item label="任务名称"
          ><c-input
            v-model="draft.title"
            :disabled="request?.readonly || saving"
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="开始"
          ><c-date
            :model-value="draft.start == null ? undefined : schedulerDate(draft.start)"
            @update:model-value="draft.start = $event"
            :show-time="!draft.allDay"
            value-format="Date"
            :disabled="request?.readonly || saving"
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="结束（不含）"
          ><c-date
            :model-value="draft.end == null ? undefined : schedulerDate(draft.end)"
            @update:model-value="draft.end = $event"
            :show-time="!draft.allDay"
            value-format="Date"
            :disabled="request?.readonly || saving"
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="工作说明"
          ><c-textarea
            v-model="draft.description"
            :disabled="request?.readonly || saving"
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-space>
          <c-button :disabled="saving" @click="open = false">取消</c-button>
          <c-button
            v-if="request?.action === 'edit' && !request.readonly"
            status="danger"
            :disabled="saving"
            @click="submit(true)"
            >删除</c-button
          >
          <c-button
            v-if="!request?.readonly"
            status="primary"
            html-type="submit"
            :loading="saving"
            >确认保存</c-button
          >
        </c-space>
      </c-form>
    </template>
  </c-dialog>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import { cloneSchedulerEvent, schedulerDate } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue/scheduler/core";
import type {
  SchedulerInstance,
  SchedulerEvent,
  SchedulerEditorRequest,
  SchedulerEventTemplate,
  SchedulerBeforeChange,
} from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";
const scheduler = ref<SchedulerInstance>();
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([
  {
    id: "inspection",
    title: "设备例行检查",
    start: "2026-09-09T10:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-09T11:00:00",
  },
]);
const card: SchedulerEventTemplate = {
  title: "现场检查",
  duration: 60,
  description: "核对运行参数",
};
const request = ref<SchedulerEditorRequest>();
const draft = ref<SchedulerEvent>();
const open = ref(false);
const saving = ref(false);
const reject = ref(false);
const errorMessage = ref("");
let snapshot: string | undefined;
function openEditor(value: SchedulerEditorRequest) {
  if (open.value || saving.value) return;
  request.value = value;
  draft.value = cloneSchedulerEvent(value.event);
  snapshot = JSON.stringify(
    events.value.find((item) => item.id === value.event.id),
  );
  errorMessage.value = "";
  open.value = true;
}
const beforeChange: SchedulerBeforeChange = async () => {
  if (reject.value) {
    reject.value = false;
    throw new Error("模拟接口提交失败，请保留草稿直接重试");
  }
  return true;
};
function showError(error: unknown) {
  errorMessage.value = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "保存失败";
}
async function submit(remove = false) {
  if (
    !draft.value ||
    !request.value ||
    request.value.readonly ||
    saving.value ||
    !scheduler.value
  )
    return;
  if (
    draft.value.id !== request.value.event.id ||
    JSON.stringify(events.value.find((item) => item.id === draft.value!.id)) !==
      snapshot
  ) {
    errorMessage.value = "原日程已变化，请关闭并重新打开。";
    return;
  }
  saving.value = true;
  errorMessage.value = "";
  try {
    const success = await scheduler.value.change({
      type: remove
        ? "remove"
        : request.value.action === "create"
          ? "create"
          : "update",
      event: cloneSchedulerEvent(draft.value),
    });
    if (success) open.value = false;
    else if (!errorMessage.value)
      errorMessage.value = "保存被取消或当前不可提交，请重试。";
  } finally {
    saving.value = false;
  }
}
</script>
```

示例中的“下一次模拟接口提交失败”只拒绝一次保存或删除，随后自动复位；失败时 Dialog 保留草稿，保存可直接再次确认，删除可再次点击删除，无需关闭窗口操作外部开关。取消则丢弃未保存草稿。

业务方可以使用 Dialog、独立路由或其他表单。确认时调用 `change({ type: request.action === 'create' ? 'create' : 'update', event })`，等待返回 `true` 后关闭；返回 `false` 时保留表单，可监听 `change-error` 显示错误。删除已有日程使用 `type: 'remove'`。

只绑定 `editor-request` 来打开外部表单，不要再通过 `cell-click` / `event-click` 打开一次。内置编辑模式不触发 `editor-request`。工具栏和拖入不是格子点击，不触发 `cell-click`。

外部页面自己管理取消、重复打开、提交中禁止关闭、卸载后的响应和编辑快照/版本。示例拒绝覆盖已打开的窗口，并在提交前比对打开时的数据；Scheduler 的 `change()` 只检查提交过程中的并发变化，不代替业务页面打开期间的版本校验。真正跨路由的表单还需自行持久化草稿并对接服务端，不能在 Scheduler 卸载后继续调用旧实例。

### 多选、批量操作与撤销重做

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/batch-history.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >开启“多选”后点击日程卡片，可整批后移一天、添加资源或删除。共享日程在多个资源列中只计为一项；撤销和重做同样经过保存接口。</c-alert
    >
    <c-checkbox v-model="reject">模拟整批保存失败</c-checkbox>
    <c-scheduler
      v-model="events"
      v-model:selected-keys="selected"
      default-date="2026-09-09"
      default-mode="resource-timeline"
      :resources="resources"
      selectable
      history
      :before-transaction="persist"
    />
    <c-tag>{{ status }}</c-tag>
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { SchedulerBeforeTransaction } from "../props";
import { createEvents, resources } from "./data";
const events = ref(createEvents());
const selected = ref<string[]>([]);
const reject = ref(false);
const status = ref("尚未提交");
const persist: SchedulerBeforeTransaction = async (context) => {
  status.value = `正在提交 ${context.changes.length} 项变更…`;
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 350));
  if (reject.value) {
    status.value = "整批保存失败，日程和历史均保留";
    throw new Error("Demo rejected");
  }
  status.value = `已提交 ${context.changes.length} 项变更（${context.action === "undo" ? "撤销" : context.action === "redo" ? "重做" : "修改"}）`;
};
</script>
```

### 原子事务交换

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/atomic-swap.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >会议室禁止重叠。两条日程可以通过一次事务交换时间；整体校验最终结果，任一项失败都不会改变另一项。</c-alert
    >
    <c-button @click="swap">交换两个会议的时间</c-button>
    <c-scheduler
      ref="scheduler"
      v-model="events"
      default-date="2026-09-09"
      default-mode="resource-day"
      :resources="[{ id: 'room', label: '会议室 A' }]"
      :allow-overlap="false"
      history
    />
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { SchedulerEvent } from "../core";
import type { SchedulerInstance } from "../index";
const scheduler = ref<SchedulerInstance>();
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([
  {
    id: "a",
    title: "产品评审",
    start: "2026-09-09T09:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-09T10:00:00",
    resourceIds: ["room"],
  },
  {
    id: "b",
    title: "技术评审",
    start: "2026-09-09T10:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-09T11:00:00",
    resourceIds: ["room"],
  },
]);
async function swap() {
  const [a, b] = events.value;
  await scheduler.value?.transaction([
    { type: "move", event: { ...a, start: b.start, end: b.end } },
    { type: "move", event: { ...b, start: a.start, end: a.end } },
  ]);
}
</script>
```

### 批量与事务约定

| 属性                                  | 说明                                                        | 默认值 |
| ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| selectable                            | 展示多选模式开关；开启模式后点击卡片切换选中，暂停卡片拖拽  | false  |
| selected-keys | 受控选中日程 ID，支持 v-model:selected-keys；共享日程只计一次 | `undefined` |
| default-selected-keys | 非受控初始选中日程 ID；共享日程只计一次 | `[]` |
| history                               | 开启本地撤销/重做，展示工具栏                               | false  |
| history-limit                         | 最多保留历史条数，正整数                                    | 20     |
| before-transaction                    | 一次性校验或保存整笔事务；返回 false 取消，异常保留数据     | —      |

| 实例方法                                 | 说明                                                                |
| ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `transaction(changes): Promise<boolean>` | 原子提交多条 create/update/remove/move/resize；每个 ID 只能出现一次 |
| `undo(): Promise<boolean>`               | 撤销最近一次已接受变更，重新经过规则与保存钩子                      |
| `redo(): Promise<boolean>`               | 重做最近一次撤销                                                    |
| `canUndo` / `canRedo`                    | 当前是否允许撤销/重做                                               |

新增 `transaction(value, context)` 与 `transaction-error(error, context)` 事件；context 包含 `action`（change/undo/redo）、`changes`、`previousValue` 和 `value`。原单条 `change` / `change-error` 事件仅在事务含一条变更时触发，多条变更不会逐条触发这些事件。

**保存钩子：**通过 `before-transaction` 原子保存单条、批量、撤销和重做操作。仅配置 `before-change` 时只能处理单条操作，批量事务会返回 `transaction-hook-required`。服务端仍需使用数据库事务保证保存的一致性。

```ts
import type { SchedulerBeforeTransaction } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";
const beforeTransaction: SchedulerBeforeTransaction = async (context) => {
  // 在这里向业务后端提交整个 context.changes；失败抛错或返回 false。
  // 后端应对整批变更校验版本、权限和最终资源占用，再原子保存。
};
```

批量后移保留本地时分；包含未排期任务时整批拒绝，避免静默遗漏。添加资源为追加去重，不替换其他参与人。只读成员、禁用资源、工作时间和维护冲突均会阻止整批操作。

受控模式中，父组件接受对应 `update:model-value` 后才记录历史；若父组件不接受，撤销不可用。父组件接受的数据若与提案不同（例如服务端重写字段），视为外部更新并清空本地历史。其他外部数据更新也会清空历史，避免覆盖别人或后端的修改。规则变更不会清空历史，但撤销必须通过当前规则。关闭 history 清空历史，新的成功变更清空重做分支。历史只属于当前组件实例，不是多人协作版本历史。

### 拖选、吸附间隔与月历更多日程

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/interaction-completion.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >周视图空白处拖选创建，支持向上拖选；网格 60 分钟，指针吸附 15
      分钟，单击新建默认 45 分钟。月视图每天先显示 2
      条，可点击“更多日程”。</c-alert
    >
    <c-space
      ><c-button @click="mode = 'week'">拖选排期</c-button
      ><c-button @click="mode = 'month'">查看月历更多日程</c-button></c-space
    >
    <c-scheduler
      v-model="events"
      v-model:mode="mode"
      default-date="2026-09-22"
      :slot-duration="60"
      :snap-duration="15"
      :default-duration="45"
      :month-event-limit="2"
      drag-to-create
      history
    />
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { SchedulerEvent, SchedulerMode } from "../core";
const mode = ref<SchedulerMode>("week");
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>(
  Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, i) => ({
    id: `sample${i}`,
    title: `任务 ${i + 1}`,
    start: `2026-09-22T${String(i + 9).padStart(2, "0")}:00:00`,
    end: `2026-09-22T${String(i + 10).padStart(2, "0")}:00:00`,
  })),
);
</script>
```

`drag-to-create` 在日、周、资源日程的空白时段启用指针拖选，支持同一列内向前或向后选择。释放后打开创建表单；Escape、失焦或禁用取消。单击和键盘激活仍可创建日程。

触屏拖动日程、调整起止时间或拖选空白时段需要长按 350ms。长按生效前移动超过 8px 会取消排期手势，把操作留给页面滚动；鼠标仍保持 5px 移动阈值，无需等待。粗指针设备上的上下缩放热区扩大到至少 14px，视觉线条尺寸不变。

焦点位于日程、时间单元格、月视图日期或“还有 N 项”入口时，方向键会按屏幕中的上下左右位置移动到最近的可用日历控件。Enter/Space 沿用 Cedar Button 的原生激活行为；禁用项和不可见项会被跳过。导航只在日历内容区生效，不接管工具栏、编辑器及表单输入。关闭内置编辑器后焦点返回原触发控件；若该日程已删除或视图已变化，则定位到原位置附近的可用日历控件，最终回退到 Scheduler 容器。

`slot-duration` 控制网格分钟数，`snap-duration` 控制指针吸附，`default-duration` 控制单击新建时长，均省略时回退旧 `step`。例如 60 / 15 / 45 表示一小时格、15 分钟吸附、45 分钟默认任务。拖选使用选择区间；外部模板的 duration 优先。指针拖动时间线也按吸附间隔定位；吸附以当前单元格真实开始时间为锚点。

月视图默认每天直接显示 3 条日程，固定单元格高度；超出时显示“还有 N 项”。点击后使用 Cedar Popover 展示当天全部日程，选择其中一项可进入详情。`month-event-limit` 可调整直接展示数量；隐藏周末仍沿用真实日期。

### 依赖、里程碑与时间线缩放

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/advanced-planning.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >准备 → 执行 →
      验收里程碑。依赖连线在时间线中展示；把执行拖到准备完成前会被阻止。里程碑使用相同起止时间，不占用资源容量。缩放按钮以视口中心为锚点调整刻度宽度。</c-alert
    >
    <c-scheduler
      v-model="events"
      default-date="2026-09-22"
      default-mode="resource-timeline"
      default-scale="hour"
      :resources="resources"
      :dependencies="dependencies"
      show-resource-load
      history
    />
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { SchedulerEvent, SchedulerDependency } from "../core";
const resources = [{ id: "team", label: "执行团队", capacity: 1 }];
const dependencies: SchedulerDependency[] = [
  { id: "prepare-run", fromId: "prepare", toId: "run" },
  { id: "run-accept", fromId: "run", toId: "accept" },
];
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([
  {
    id: "prepare",
    title: "准备",
    start: "2026-09-22T09:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-22T10:00:00",
    resourceIds: ["team"],
  },
  {
    id: "run",
    title: "执行",
    start: "2026-09-22T10:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-22T12:00:00",
    resourceIds: ["team"],
  },
  {
    id: "accept",
    title: "验收里程碑",
    start: "2026-09-22T12:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-22T12:00:00",
    milestone: true,
    resourceIds: ["team"],
  },
]);
</script>
```

`dependencies` 为 `{id, fromId, toId, type?, lag?}[]`，支持 finish-to-start（默认）、start-to-start、finish-to-finish、start-to-finish，lag 为实际经过分钟数，可为负。纯函数 `getSchedulerDependencyIssues` 返回无效配置、缺失端点、循环和时间顺序问题；提交使用最终事务状态校验，失败返回 dependency 错误。尚未排期的端点不检查时间顺序。删除事件前需先移除相关依赖。

资源时间线为当前已挂载的两端绘制依赖连线；虚拟列表中一端不在视口时不绘制。此功能不会自动重排其他任务。`milestone: true` 表示定时零时长里程碑，必须 start=end，不支持全天或未排期；以 ◆ 显示，不占容量，可移动而不能拉伸。

`zoom/default-zoom/update:zoom` 控制 0.5–4 倍时间线缩放，工具栏提供放大缩小；以当前视口中心的时间为锚调整横向位置。`show-date-header` 默认开启日期分组表头。资源名称在横向滚动时固定。

## 异步加载与保存

### 异步目录、分页与 ID 回显

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### 本组配置对照

| 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default-mode` | 非受控默认视图 | 异步目录、分页与 ID 回显、按范围远程加载、异步保存 |
| `resources` | 当前可见资源行/列及本地选项，不要求全量目录 | 异步目录、分页与 ID 回显、异步保存 |
| `before-change` | 返回 false 取消；异步拦截、保存接口 | 异步目录、分页与 ID 回显、异步保存 |
| `default-date` | 初始定位日期 | 异步目录、分页与 ID 回显、异步保存 |
| `resource-label` | 资源字段名称，如设备、会议室 | 异步目录、分页与 ID 回显 |
| `request-resources` | 按关键词和游标查询候选资源 | 异步目录、分页与 ID 回显 |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

示例可切换设备接口和人员接口。仅提供当前 4 条可见资源，而已有日程关联第 12 条，通过 `resolve-resources` 单独回显。打开资源下拉框后远程搜索、滚动或点击加载更多；搜索结果不会添加资源视图的行/列。可模拟搜索与回显失败，查看 ID 保留及重试。

示例状态文案按当前请求更新：回显或搜索失败后，成功重试会清除旧失败提示；切换设备/人员接口会重置示例反馈。失败和重试都不会将资源显示名称写进日程，关联仍只存稳定 ID。

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/async-resources.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" align="stretch" wrap>
    <c-form-item layout="vertical" hide-label>
      <c-select
        v-model="kind"
        :options="[
          { value: 'device', label: '设备接口' },
          { value: 'person', label: '人员接口' },
        ]"
      />
    </c-form-item>
    <c-button @click="failNextSearch = true">下次搜索模拟失败</c-button>
    <c-button @click="retryHydration">模拟回显失败并重新加载</c-button>
    <c-button @click="useNextPage">切换可见资源页</c-button>
  </c-space>
  <p>
    当前仅提供 {{ visibleResources.length }} 条可见资源。已有日程关联第 12
    条，不在本页，仍通过 ID 接口回显名称。进入编辑器，搜索“12”或滚动加载更多。
  </p>
  <p role="status">{{ feedback }}</p>
  <c-scheduler
    :key="`${kind}-${revision}`"
    v-model="events"
    :resources="visibleResources"
    :resource-label="kind === 'device' ? '设备' : '人员'"
    :request-resources="requestResources"
    :resolve-resources="resolveResources"
    :before-change="beforeChange"
    default-mode="agenda"
    default-date="2026-09-09"
    @resource-error="resourceError"
  />
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onScopeDispose, ref, watch } from "vue";
import type {
  SchedulerEvent,
  SchedulerRequestResources,
  SchedulerResolveResources,
  SchedulerBeforeChange,
  SchedulerResourceErrorContext,
} from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";

const kind = ref<"device" | "person">("device");
// 业务接口字段在接入层适配，Scheduler 始终只认识 id / label。
const devices = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, index) => ({
  deviceId: `device-${index + 1}`,
  deviceName: `实验设备 ${index + 1}`,
}));
const people = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, index) => ({
  userId: `person-${index + 1}`,
  displayName: `工程师 ${index + 1}`,
}));
const directory = computed(() =>
  kind.value === "device"
    ? devices.map((item) => ({ id: item.deviceId, label: item.deviceName }))
    : people.map((item) => ({ id: item.userId, label: item.displayName })),
);
const page = ref(0);
const revision = ref(0);
const visibleResources = computed(() =>
  directory.value.slice(page.value * 4, page.value * 4 + 4),
);
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([]);
const feedback = ref("打开详情查看名称回显，或在资源下拉框搜索。");
const failNextSearch = ref(false);
const failNextResolve = ref(false);
const failedOperation = ref<"search" | "resolve">();
watch(
  kind,
  () => {
    failedOperation.value = undefined;
    feedback.value = "打开详情查看名称回显，或在资源下拉框搜索。";
    page.value = 0;
    events.value = [
      {
        id: `${kind.value}-job`,
        title: "已有排期：关联不在本页的资源",
        start: "2026-09-09T09:00:00",
        end: "2026-09-09T10:00:00",
        resourceIds: [`${kind.value}-12`],
      },
    ];
  },
  { immediate: true, flush: "sync" },
);

const lifetime = new AbortController();
onScopeDispose(() => lifetime.abort());
// 模拟接口延时；真实接入时直接 fetch(url, { signal })。
function delay(signal: AbortSignal) {
  return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    if (signal.aborted) {
      reject(new Error("Aborted"));
      return;
    }
    const abort = () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      signal.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
      reject(new Error("Aborted"));
    };
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      signal.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
      resolve();
    }, 500);
    signal.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });
  });
}
const requestResources: SchedulerRequestResources = async ({
  query,
  cursor,
  signal,
}) => {
  const data = directory.value;
  const fail = failNextSearch.value;
  failNextSearch.value = false;
  await delay(signal);
  if (fail) throw new Error("模拟搜索网络错误");
  const matches = data.filter(
    (item) => item.label.includes(query) || item.id.includes(query),
  );
  const offset = Number(cursor ?? 0);
  if (failedOperation.value === "search") {
    failedOperation.value = undefined;
    feedback.value = "搜索重试成功，可继续选择资源。";
  }
  return {
    items: matches.slice(offset, offset + 4),
    nextCursor: offset + 4 < matches.length ? String(offset + 4) : undefined,
  };
};
const resolveResources: SchedulerResolveResources = async (ids, { signal }) => {
  const data = directory.value;
  const fail = failNextResolve.value;
  failNextResolve.value = false;
  await delay(signal);
  if (fail) throw new Error("模拟回显网络错误");
  if (failedOperation.value === "resolve") {
    failedOperation.value = undefined;
    feedback.value = "资源名称回显成功，关联 ID 保持不变。";
  }
  return data.filter((item) => ids.includes(item.id));
};
const beforeChange: SchedulerBeforeChange = async ({ event, type }) => {
  const data = directory.value;
  await delay(lifetime.signal);
  // 演示服务端校验；生产环境还应验证权限、版本和全量时段冲突。
  if (
    type !== "remove" &&
    event.resourceIds?.some((id) => !data.some((item) => item.id === id))
  )
    throw new Error("资源不存在");
  feedback.value = "模拟接口保存成功，日程只保存 resourceIds，不保存显示名称。";
};
function resourceError(
  _error: unknown,
  context: SchedulerResourceErrorContext,
) {
  failedOperation.value = context.type;
  feedback.value =
    context.type === "resolve"
      ? "回显失败：ID 仍保留，点击日程内的重试按钮。"
      : "搜索失败：可在下拉框内重试。";
}
function retryHydration() {
  failNextResolve.value = true;
  revision.value++;
}
function useNextPage() {
  page.value = (page.value + 1) % 6;
}
</script>
```

日程只保存 `resourceIds`；`id` 是稳定标识，`label` 是显示名称。业务层把 `userId/displayName`、`deviceId/deviceName` 等接口字段映射为 `{ id, label }`。不要把名称当 ID，也不要为了回显把全量目录放进 `resources`。

| 数据入口          | 职责                                                                |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| resources         | 当前资源视图的行/列及本地候选项，可以是部分目录；同 ID 时优先于缓存 |
| request-resources | 远程搜索与游标分页，返回候选项，不修改可见行/列                     |
| resolve-resources | 根据已有 ID 批量加载名称，不依赖当前搜索页                          |
| before-change     | 对接服务端有效性、权限、全量冲突与保存校验                          |

```ts
import type {
  SchedulerRequestResources,
  SchedulerResolveResources,
} from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";

const requestResources: SchedulerRequestResources = async ({
  query,
  cursor,
  signal,
}) => {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ query });
  if (cursor !== undefined) params.set("cursor", cursor);
  const response = await fetch(`/api/devices?${params}`, { signal });
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error("设备查询失败");
  const page = await response.json();
  return {
    items: page.items.map((item) => ({
      id: String(item.deviceId),
      label: item.deviceName,
    })),
    nextCursor: page.nextCursor, // 没有下一页时省略；游标使用非空字符串
  };
};

const resolveResources: SchedulerResolveResources = async (ids, { signal }) => {
  const response = await fetch("/api/devices/by-ids", {
    method: "POST",
    signal,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ ids }),
  });
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error("设备回显失败");
  const items = await response.json();
  return items.map((item) => ({
    id: String(item.deviceId),
    label: item.deviceName,
  }));
};
```

同一实例缓存回显结果，并合并请求中的重复 ID；不在实例之间共用数据。搜索更换关键词会取消旧请求，即使接口未响应取消信号也忽略过期结果。切换 `resolve-resources` 回调会清空回显缓存；切换租户/目录建议给 Scheduler 设置不同 `key`，隔离搜索结果、缓存和编辑草稿。

回显查不到或失败时保留原 ID 并用 ID 显示，不会清空日程关联或禁止保存。失败触发 `resource-error`；可通过提示按钮或重新打开选择器重试。远程请求只影响资源控件的加载状态，不锁住整个日程。

当前未加载的资源不等于无效资源。已知 `disabled` 的资源不能新增分配，已有关联可保留/移除；保存期间新增分配的资源变为禁用会阻止保存，但目录翻页、补全名称不会使保存过期。`allow-overlap=false` 仅检查已加载日程，全量冲突和权限必须由服务端校验。

### 按范围远程加载

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/remote-events.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >翻页按可见范围请求；返回已访问日期命中 30
      秒缓存。可模拟失败后重试，也可连续切换日期，验证慢响应不会覆盖最新页面。</c-alert
    >
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="refresh()">刷新 / 重试</c-button>
      <c-button @click="jump(1)">下一天</c-button>
      <c-button @click="jump(-1)">上一天</c-button>
      <c-checkbox v-model="fail">模拟加载失败</c-checkbox>
      <c-checkbox v-model="outOfOrder">模拟乱序响应</c-checkbox>
    </c-space>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-tag>请求 {{ requests }} 次</c-tag>
      <c-tag>{{
        loading
          ? "加载中"
          : error
            ? "加载失败，请重试"
            : `已加载 ${events.length} 项`
      }}</c-tag>
      <c-tag>{{ status }}</c-tag>
    </c-space>
    <c-scheduler
      v-model="events"
      v-model:date="date"
      default-mode="day"
      :readonly="loading || !!error"
      :before-transaction="persist"
      @range-change="range = $event"
    />
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import { useSchedulerDataSource } from "../use-data-source";
import {
  applySchedulerTransaction,
  cloneSchedulerEvent,
  isSchedulerEventInRange,
  schedulerDate,
} from "../core";
import type { SchedulerDate, SchedulerEvent, SchedulerRange } from "../core";
import type { SchedulerBeforeTransaction } from "../props";
const date = ref<SchedulerDate>("2026-09-09");
const range = ref<SchedulerRange>();
const fail = ref(false);
const outOfOrder = ref(false);
const requests = ref(0);
const status = ref("编辑日程会保存到模拟服务端");
let database: SchedulerEvent[] = Array.from({ length: 90 }, (_, index) => ({
  id: `remote-${index}`,
  title: `远程计划 ${index + 1}`,
  start: new Date(2026, 7, 15 + index, 9),
  end: new Date(2026, 7, 15 + index, 10),
}));
const { events, loading, error, refresh } = useSchedulerDataSource({
  range,
  requestEvents: async (query) => {
    const sequence = ++requests.value;
    const shouldFail = fail.value;
    const ignoreAbort = outOfOrder.value;
    const result = database
      .filter((event) => isSchedulerEventInRange(event, query))
      .map(cloneSchedulerEvent);
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      const abort = () => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        reject(new Error("Aborted"));
      };
      const timer = setTimeout(
        () => {
          query.signal.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
          resolve();
        },
        ignoreAbort ? (sequence % 2 ? 1800 : 200) : 450,
      );
      if (!ignoreAbort)
        query.signal.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });
    });
    if (shouldFail) throw new Error("模拟接口失败");
    return result;
  },
});
function jump(offset: number) {
  const next = schedulerDate(date.value);
  next.setDate(next.getDate() + offset);
  date.value = next;
}
const persist: SchedulerBeforeTransaction = async (context) => {
  // Send the delta to the backend, never replace the full database with a loaded window.
  database = applySchedulerTransaction(database, context.changes);
  status.value = `已保存 ${context.changes.length} 项变更；查询缓存随 v-model 更新失效`;
};
</script>
```

`useSchedulerDataSource` 独立负责加载，不改变 Scheduler 的 `v-model` 数据所有权。将 `range-change` 写入范围 ref，将返回的 `events` 绑定到组件。需要避免在加载中或失败后编辑时，由业务设置 `readonly="loading || !!error"`；整块占位可在外层使用 Loading。

```ts
import { ref } from "vue";
import { useSchedulerDataSource } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";
import type { SchedulerRange } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";

const range = ref<SchedulerRange>();
const { events, loading, error, refresh } = useSchedulerDataSource({
  range,
  requestEvents: async ({ start, end, resourceIds, signal }) => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({
      start: start.toISOString(),
      end: end.toISOString(),
      resourceIds: resourceIds.join(","),
    });
    const response = await fetch(`/api/events?${params}`, { signal });
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error("加载失败");
    return response.json();
  },
});
```

| 选项            | 说明                                                                                                  |
| --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| requestEvents   | 查询函数或其 ref，接收 start、end、resourceIds、AbortSignal，返回日程数组或 Promise；切换函数清空缓存 |
| range           | 范围、ref 或 getter；undefined 暂停并清空当前数据                                                     |
| resourceIds     | 可选数组、ref 或 getter；去重排序后作为查询条件，空数组表示不限资源                                   |
| enabled         | 可选 boolean、ref 或 getter，默认 true；false 取消加载并清空当前数据                                  |
| cacheTime       | 缓存有效毫秒数，默认 30000，0 禁用                                                                    |
| maxCacheEntries | LRU 缓存条数上限，默认 20，0 禁用                                                                     |

返回 `events`（可写 ref）、`loading`、`error`、`loadedRange`（最后成功发布的范围）、`refresh()`（绕过当前缓存并返回成功与否）、`cancel()`（保留已发布数据，终止当前请求）、`invalidate()`（仅清空全部缓存）。在组件 setup 或 effectScope 中调用；SSR 不自动请求。

范围为 `[start, end)`：接口应返回与范围相交的完整日程，不截断跨日事件，不返回仅第一页。资源筛选条件由业务同步传入；组件内部资源筛选不会自动改变加载器条件。未排期任务可由业务接口额外包含在返回数组中。

切换范围会清空旧窗口并取消旧请求，即使接口忽略 AbortSignal，过期响应也不会覆盖最新结果。失败通过 `error` 暴露，点击刷新重试。查询结果会整体校验，重复 ID 或无效日程不会部分发布。缓存以精确范围和资源条件区分；通过 `v-model` 替换或响应式原位编辑会取消在途加载并清空缓存。Date 的原生 set 方法不会触发 Vue 响应式，请替换日期值。

加载器不执行保存。继续使用 `before-transaction` 向服务端提交 `context.changes`；不要将当前窗口的 `context.value` 当作全库替换。全局冲突、权限及原子保存由服务端校验。切换窗口属于外部数据更新，会使组件本地撤销历史失效。

### 异步保存

before-change 返回 false 取消，抛错或拒绝 Promise 会触发 change-error 并保留原数据。期间组件禁止重复变更。如果外部数据或权限变化，旧提案失效。服务端仍需原子校验权限、版本和资源冲突。

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/async-change.vue

```vue
<template>
  <section class="scheduler-async-demo">
    <c-space direction="column" block>
      <c-space>
        <c-checkbox v-model="reject">下一次模拟保存失败</c-checkbox>
        <c-checkbox v-model="accept">父组件接受更新</c-checkbox>
        <c-button @click="reset">重置日程</c-button>
      </c-space>
      <p>
        本地模拟 600ms
        保存；失败开关在一次失败后自动复位，可直接重试。取消或父组件拒绝提案不改变已保存值。
      </p>
      <c-scheduler
        :model-value="events"
        default-date="2026-09-09"
        default-mode="resource-day"
        :resources="resources"
        :before-change="beforeChange"
        @update:model-value="update"
        @change="outcome = accept ? '父组件已接受' : '父组件未接受提案'"
        @change-error="outcome = '保存失败，原值不变'"
      />
      <p role="status">{{ outcome }}；活动请求：{{ pendingCount }}</p>
      <ul aria-label="异步已提交日程">
        <li v-for="event in events" :key="event.id" :data-demo-event="event.id">
          {{ event.title }}：{{ event.start ?? "未排期" }} →
          {{ event.end ?? "未排期" }}；资源：{{ event.resourceIds?.join(",") }}
        </li>
      </ul>
    </c-space>
  </section>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref } from "vue";
import type { SchedulerBeforeChange } from "../props";
import type { SchedulerEvent } from "../core";
import { createEvents, resources } from "./data";
const events = ref(createEvents());
const reject = ref(false);
const accept = ref(true);
const outcome = ref("尚未操作");
const pendingCount = ref(0);
const pending = new Map<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>, () => void>();
const beforeChange: SchedulerBeforeChange = () =>
  new Promise<boolean>((resolve, rejectRequest) => {
    const fail = reject.value;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      pending.delete(timer);
      pendingCount.value = pending.size;
      if (fail) {
        reject.value = false;
        rejectRequest(new Error("模拟接口失败"));
      } else resolve(true);
    }, 600);
    pending.set(timer, () => resolve(false));
    pendingCount.value = pending.size;
  });
function update(value: SchedulerEvent[]) {
  if (accept.value) events.value = value;
}
function cancelPending() {
  pending.forEach((cancel, timer) => {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    cancel();
  });
  pending.clear();
  pendingCount.value = 0;
}
function reset() {
  cancelPending();
  events.value = createEvents();
  outcome.value = "已重置";
}
onBeforeUnmount(cancelPending);
onDeactivated(cancelPending);
</script>
```

示例只使用本地 600ms 模拟保存。“下一次模拟保存失败”仅失败一次后自动复位，可在保留草稿的编辑器中直接重试。“父组件接受更新”关闭后，验证通过仍只是提案，下方模型明细和卡片保持已保存值；取消编辑也不写入。卸载、停用或重置清理示例请求计时器。

## 业务组合与集成

### 设备排期与工单

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### 本组配置对照

| 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `resources` | 当前可见资源行/列及本地选项，不要求全量目录 | 设备排期与工单、出勤详情、打卡与关单、任务日历组合工作台 |
| `default-mode` | 非受控默认视图 | 设备排期与工单、外部日历、模拟协同、ICS 与打印、出勤详情、打卡与关单 |
| `default-date` | 初始定位日期 | 设备排期与工单、外部日历、模拟协同、ICS 与打印、出勤详情、打卡与关单 |
| `editable` | 启用内置编辑器；false 通过 editor-request 接管 | 出勤详情、打卡与关单、任务日历组合工作台 |
| `start-hour` | 时间网格起始小时，0–23 | 出勤详情、打卡与关单、任务日历组合工作台 |
| `end-hour` | 时间网格结束小时，必须大于起始，最多 24 | 出勤详情、打卡与关单、任务日历组合工作台 |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

相同资源 API 用于设备，无人员字段依赖。示例包括工单拖入、双设备联合占用、全天维护、只读日程及本地重叠校验。`resource-label` 自定义显示名称，不改变存储字段。

### 外部日历、模拟协同、ICS 与打印

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/calendar-integration.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >模拟服务端持有版本号：编辑保存延迟
      300ms，期间模拟远端更新会触发过期保护。导入/导出使用真实 ICS
      文本；打印生成独立文档，不打印整页组件文档。</c-alert
    >
    <c-space
      ><c-button @click="remote">模拟远端更新</c-button
      ><c-button @click="exportIcs">导出 ICS 文本</c-button
      ><c-button @click="importIcs">导入 ICS 文本</c-button
      ><c-button @click="print">打印日程</c-button
      ><c-tag>版本 {{ revision }}</c-tag></c-space
    >
    <c-alert v-if="error" status="danger">{{ error }}</c-alert>
    <c-textarea v-model="ical" placeholder="ICS 文本" :rows="4" />
    <c-scheduler
      v-model="events"
      default-date="2026-09-22"
      default-mode="week"
      :before-transaction="save"
      history
    />
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, onBeforeUnmount } from "vue";
import {
  createSchedulerMemoryProvider,
  exportSchedulerICalendar,
  importSchedulerICalendar,
  createSchedulerPrintHtml,
} from "../adapters";
import type { SchedulerEvent, SchedulerTransactionContext } from "../core";
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([
  {
    id: "meeting",
    title: "团队会议",
    start: "2026-09-22T09:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-22T10:00:00",
  },
]);
const source = createSchedulerMemoryProvider(events.value),
  revision = ref(0),
  ical = ref(""),
  error = ref("");
const stop = source.subscribe!((snapshot, origin) => {
  if (origin === "editor") return;
  revision.value = snapshot.revision;
  events.value = snapshot.events;
});
onBeforeUnmount(stop);
async function save(context: SchedulerTransactionContext) {
  const expected = revision.value;
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
  const next = await source.commit(context.changes, expected, "editor");
  revision.value = next.revision;
}
async function remote() {
  try {
    await source.commit(
      [
        {
          type: "update",
          event: {
            ...events.value[0],
            title: `远端更新 ${revision.value + 1}`,
          },
        },
      ],
      revision.value,
      "remote",
    );
  } catch (cause) {
    error.value = String(cause);
  }
}
function exportIcs() {
  try {
    ical.value = exportSchedulerICalendar(events.value, {
      stamp: new Date(),
      name: "Cedar demo",
    });
    error.value = "";
  } catch (cause) {
    error.value = String(cause);
  }
}
async function importIcs() {
  try {
    const parsed = importSchedulerICalendar(ical.value, {
      timeZone: "Asia/Shanghai",
    });
    if (parsed.series.length)
      throw new Error("含重复系列，请先通过 RRULE 适配器展开");
    const existing = new Set(events.value.map((event) => event.id));
    await source.commit(
      parsed.events.map((event) => ({
        type: existing.has(event.id) ? "update" : "create",
        event,
      })),
      revision.value,
      "import",
    );
    error.value = "";
  } catch (cause) {
    error.value = String(cause);
  }
}
function print() {
  const page = window.open("", "_blank");
  if (!page) return;
  page.document.open();
  page.document.write(
    createSchedulerPrintHtml(events.value, { title: "团队日程" }),
  );
  page.document.close();
  page.focus();
  page.print();
}
</script>
```

`SchedulerCalendarProvider` 定义 load(range, signal)、commit(changes, expectedRevision, origin?) 与可选 subscribe。`createSchedulerMemoryProvider` 为离线示例实现：校验递增版本、发布分离快照、可注销订阅。真实服务需实现认证、持久化、权限与完整业务校验。示例用 origin 忽略自己的回声，外部更新仍触发 Scheduler 的过期保护；内部事务用本地单调版本检测等待期间数据变化。

`exportSchedulerICalendar(events, {stamp, name?})` 导出 UTC 定时事件和 DATE 全天事件，正确转义文本并按 UTF-8 75 字节折行；未排期事件明确拒绝。`importSchedulerICalendar(text, {timeZone?, disambiguation?})` 返回普通 events 与 RRULE 种子 series；要求 UID/DTSTART/DTEND。支持 UTC/IANA TZID/指定时区的浮动时间。全天 RRULE、自定义 VTIMEZONE、RECURRENCE-ID、RDATE/EXDATE/EXRULE、DURATION 及重复 UID 会明确拒绝，交由专用提供方适配，避免导入后语义丢失。

`createSchedulerPrintHtml(events, options?)` 返回独立可打印 HTML，含完整转义、重复表头及跨页设置。调用方决定打开、保存或打印；示例的打印按钮只打印此文档。

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/task-calendar-details.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-alert>
    点击日程先查看业务摘要，再进入高级详情。完整出勤单、任务与打卡记录由页面按

    :show-sidebar="false"
    @editor-request="activate"
  >
    <template #event="{ event }">
      <EventSummaryPopover
        :open="previewId === event.id"
        :title="event.title"
        @update:open="!$event && (previewId = undefined)"
        @click-outside="previewId = undefined"

        <span :class="{ 'completed-event': event.readonly }">

            </c-space>
            <strong>{{ timeRange(event) }}</strong>
            <span>
              {{ orderOf(event)!.tasks.length }} 项任务 ·
              {{ totalMinutes(orderOf(event)!) }} 分钟 · 1 人
            </span>
            <span>设备：{{ deviceLabels(orderOf(event)!) }}</span>
            <span>最近打卡：{{ latestPunch(orderOf(event)!) }}</span>
            <c-space>
              <c-button status="primary" @click.stop="openDetails(event)">
                高级详情
              </c-button>
              <c-button @click.stop="previewId = undefined">关闭</c-button>
            </c-space>
          </c-space>
        </template>
      </EventSummaryPopover>
    </template>
  </c-scheduler>

  <c-dialog v-model:open="detailsOpen" title="出勤单高级详情" :footer="false">
    <template v-if="activeOrder">
      <c-space direction="column" block>
        <c-space>
          <c-tag>{{ statusLabel(activeOrder) }}</c-tag>
          <c-tag>{{ activeOrder.source }}</c-tag>
        </c-space>
        <p>执行人：{{ resourceLabel(activeOrder.personId) }} · 人数：1</p>
        <p>
          计划时间：{{ displayTime(activeOrder.plannedStart) }} –
          {{ displayTime(activeOrder.plannedEnd) }}
        </p>
        <p v-if="activeOrder.actualStart">
          实际时间：{{ displayTime(activeOrder.actualStart) }} –
          {{ displayTime(activeOrder.actualEnd) }}
        </p>
        <c-divider />
        <strong>任务与工单</strong>
        <div v-for="task in activeOrder.tasks" :key="task.id">
          <c-link :href="`#work-order-${task.id}`">{{ task.title }}</c-link>
          · 技能 {{ skillLabel(task.skill) }} · {{ task.standardMinutes }} 分钟
        </div>
        <p>总标准工时：{{ totalMinutes(activeOrder) }} 分钟</p>
        <c-divider />
        <strong>打卡记录</strong>
        <div v-for="record in activeOrder.punchRecords" :key="record.id">
          {{ resourceLabel(record.deviceId) }}：
          {{ displayTime(record.checkedInAt) }} –
          {{ displayTime(record.checkedOutAt) }}
        </div>
        <c-empty
          v-if="!activeOrder.punchRecords.length"
          description="暂无打卡记录"
        />
        <c-space>
          <c-button @click="detailsOpen = false">关闭</c-button>
          <c-button
            v-if="
              activeOrder.status !== 'closed' && activeOrder.kind !== 'rest'
            "
            status="primary"
            @click="closeOrder(activeOrder)"
          >
            按实际打卡时间关单
          </c-button>
        </c-space>
      </c-space>
    </template>
  </c-dialog>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { formatDemoDateTime } from "../../__demos__/locale";
import { computed, ref } from "vue";
import type {
  SchedulerEditorRequest,
  SchedulerEvent,
  SchedulerResource,
} from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";
import EventSummaryPopover from "./event-summary-popover.vue";
import {
  toTaskCalendarEvent,
  type TaskCalendarOrder,
} from "./task-calendar-model";

const resources: SchedulerResource[] = [
  { id: "person-li", label: "李卫东" },
  { id: "person-zhang", label: "张志强" },
  { id: "device-a", label: "月检站 A" },
  { id: "device-c", label: "预警处理台 C" },
];
const orders = ref<TaskCalendarOrder[]>([
  {
    id: "detail-101",
    kind: "work",
    status: "review",
    source: "设备待办",
    personId: "person-li",
    plannedStart: "2026-09-09T09:00:00",
    plannedEnd: "2026-09-09T11:00:00",
    tasks: [
      {
        id: "WO-301",
        title: "月检与运行参数复核",
        deviceId: "device-a",
        skill: "inspection",
        standardMinutes: 120,
      },
    ],
    punchRecords: [
      {
        id: "punch-1",
        deviceId: "device-a",
        checkedInAt: "2026-09-09T09:12:00",
        checkedOutAt: "2026-09-09T10:48:00",
      },
    ],
    color: "#1677ff",
  },
  {
    id: "detail-102",
    kind: "work",
    status: "closed",
    source: "站长负责范围",
    personId: "person-zhang",
    plannedStart: "2026-09-09T13:00:00",
    plannedEnd: "2026-09-09T14:00:00",
    actualStart: "2026-09-09T13:08:00",
    actualEnd: "2026-09-09T13:52:00",
    tasks: [
      {
        id: "WO-302",
        title: "预警处理",
        deviceId: "device-c",
        skill: "warning",
        standardMinutes: 60,
      },
    ],
    punchRecords: [
      {
        id: "punch-2",
        deviceId: "device-c",
        checkedInAt: "2026-09-09T13:08:00",
        checkedOutAt: "2026-09-09T13:52:00",
      },
    ],
    color: "#86909c",
  },
  {
    id: "detail-rest",
    kind: "rest",
    status: "planned",
    source: "个人安排",
    personId: "person-li",
    plannedStart: "2026-09-09T12:00:00",
    plannedEnd: "2026-09-09T13:00:00",
    tasks: [],
    punchRecords: [],
    color: "#00a854",
  },
]);
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>(orders.value.map(toTaskCalendarEvent));
const previewId = ref<string>();
const activeOrderId = ref<string>();
const detailsOpen = ref(false);
const activeOrder = computed(() =>
  orders.value.find((order) => order.id === activeOrderId.value),
);

function activate(request: SchedulerEditorRequest) {
  if (request.action !== "edit") return;
  previewId.value = request.event.id;
  activeOrderId.value = businessId(request.event);
}
function openDetails(event: SchedulerEvent) {
  activeOrderId.value = businessId(event);
  previewId.value = undefined;
  detailsOpen.value = true;
}
function closeOrder(order: TaskCalendarOrder) {
  const punches = order.punchRecords;
  const first = punches[0]?.checkedInAt;
  const last = punches.at(-1)?.checkedOutAt;
  if (!first || !last) return;
  orders.value = orders.value.map((item) =>
    item.id === order.id
      ? { ...item, status: "closed", actualStart: first, actualEnd: last }
      : item,
  );
  events.value = orders.value.map(toTaskCalendarEvent);
}
function businessId(event: SchedulerEvent) {
  return String(event.metadata?.attendanceOrderId ?? event.id);
}
function orderOf(event: SchedulerEvent) {
  return orders.value.find((order) => order.id === businessId(event));
}
function totalMinutes(order: TaskCalendarOrder) {
  return order.tasks.reduce((total, task) => total + task.standardMinutes, 0);
}
function deviceLabels(order: TaskCalendarOrder) {
  return (
    [...new Set(order.tasks.map((task) => resourceLabel(task.deviceId)))].join(
      "、",
    ) || "无"
  );
}
function personLabel(event: SchedulerEvent) {
  return resourceLabel(orderOf(event)?.personId);
}
function resourceLabel(id?: string) {
  return resources.find((resource) => resource.id === id)?.label ?? "未知";
}
function skillLabel(skill: string) {
  return { inspection: "巡检", warning: "预警处理" }[skill] ?? skill;
}
function statusLabel(order: TaskCalendarOrder) {
  if (order.kind === "rest") return "休息";
  return {
    planned: "计划中",
    active: "执行中",
    review: "待关单",
    closed: "已完成",
  }[order.status];
}
function latestPunch(order: TaskCalendarOrder) {
  const record = order.punchRecords.at(-1);
  return record
    ? `${displayTime(record.checkedInAt)} – ${displayTime(record.checkedOutAt)}`
    : "暂无";
}
function timeRange(event: SchedulerEvent) {
  return `${displayTime(event.start)} – ${displayTime(event.end)}`;
}
function displayTime(value?: string | number | Date) {
  return value == null
    ? "未记录"
    : formatDemoDateTime(new Date(value), {
        month: "numeric",
        day: "numeric",
        hour: "2-digit",
        minute: "2-digit",
        hour12: false,
      });
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.completed-event {
  opacity: 0.55;
}
</style>
```

点击日程先打开 Popover 摘要，再通过“高级详情”查看工单、任务技能、人员、设备、标准工时、来源和打卡记录。页面用 `metadata.attendanceOrderId` 查询完整业务对象；关单后保留业务对象中的计划时间，只把 Scheduler Event 映射为实际打卡时间和只读外观。完成、休息和来源都是 Demo 业务配置。
