```vue
            </div>
          </section>
          <section class="pending-panel" aria-label="待分配任务">
            <strong
              >待分配任务 <c-tag>{{ pending.length }}</c-tag></strong
            >
            <div class="panel-scroll">
              <c-tree
                :data="pendingTree"
                :checked-values="pendingKeys"
                :expanded-values="expandedPending"
                checkable
                only-check-leaf
                block-node
                :selectable="false"
                :disabled="disabled"
                @update:expanded-values="expandedPending = $event"
                @check="checkPending"
              >
                <template #label="node">
                  <div
                    v-if="node.taskId"
                    class="pending-task"
                    :class="deadlineClass(task(node.taskId))"
                    :draggable="!disabled"
                    @dragstart="beginPending(node.taskId, startDrag, $event)"
                    @dragend="
                      cancelDrag();
                      endDrag();
                    "
                  >
                    <strong>{{ task(node.taskId)?.title }}</strong>
                    <span>{{
                      resource(task(node.taskId)?.deviceId)?.label
                    }}</span>
                    <span>{{ deadlineText(task(node.taskId)) }}</span>
                    <span
                      >{{ task(node.taskId)?.skill }} /
                      {{ task(node.taskId)?.people }} 人 /
                      {{ task(node.taskId)?.minutes }} 分钟</span
                    >
                    <small>{{ task(node.taskId)?.source }}</small>
                  </div>
                  <span v-else>{{ node.label }}</span>
                </template>
              </c-tree>
              <c-empty
                v-if="!pendingTree.length"
                description="暂无待分配任务"
              />
            </div>
          </section>
        </div>
      </template>
      <template #resource-header="{ date: day }">
        {{ formatDemoDate(day, { weekday: "short" }) }}
        {{ day.getDate() }}
      </template>
      <template #column-background="{ date: day }">
        <div
          v-if="dragDeadline && schedulerDateKey(day) > dragDeadline"
          class="deadline-mask"
          aria-label="晚于任务截止日期"
        />
      </template>
      <template #event="{ event }">
        <div
          class="task-card"
          :data-order-id="event.metadata?.orderId"
          :data-edge="event.metadata?.edge"
          :class="{
            linked: activeOrder === event.metadata?.orderId,
            closed: event.metadata?.closed,
            rest: event.metadata?.kind === 'rest',
          }"
          @mouseenter="hoverOrder = String(event.metadata?.orderId ?? '')"
          @mouseleave="hoverOrder = ''"
          @dragover="allowMerge($event, event)"
          @drop="dropMerge($event, event)"
        >
          <strong>{{ event.title }}</strong>
          <span v-if="event.metadata?.kind !== 'rest'">{{
            event.metadata?.counterpart
          }}</span>
          <span v-if="!event.allDay"
            >{{ time(event.start) }}–{{ time(event.end) }}</span
          >
        </div>
      </template>
    </c-scheduler>
  </div>
  <c-alert
    v-if="notice"
    :status="noticeError ? 'danger' : 'warning'"
    class="workbench-notice"
    role="status"
    >{{ notice }}</c-alert
  >
  <c-space wrap class="workbench-test-controls">
    <span>联调演示</span>
    <c-select
      v-model="role"
      :options="roles"
      :disabled="saving"
      style="width: 170px"
    />
    <c-checkbox v-model="rejectSave" :disabled="saving"
      >模拟保存失败</c-checkbox
    >
    <c-checkbox v-model="conflict" :disabled="saving">模拟版本冲突</c-checkbox>
    <c-button :disabled="saving" @click="reload">重新加载</c-button>
    <c-popover trigger="click" title="最近提交的业务 DTO" placement="top">
      <c-button>提交数据</c-button>
      <template #content>
        <pre class="payload">{{ lastPayload || "尚未提交" }}</pre>
      </template>
    </c-popover>
  </c-space>
  <c-dialog
    v-model:open="editorOpen"
    :title="
      draft?.kind === 'rest'
        ? '休息安排'
        : draft?.version
          ? '出勤单详情'
          : '创建出勤单'
    "
    :footer="false"
    :closable="!saving"
    :overlay-closable="!saving"
    :esc-to-close="!saving"
    @update:open="onEditorVisibility"
  >
    <template v-if="draft">
      <c-alert v-if="editorError" status="danger">{{ editorError }}</c-alert>
      <template v-if="draft.kind === 'rest'">
        <p>{{ resource(draft.personId)?.label }}</p>
        <p>{{ format(draft.start) }} – {{ format(draft.end) }}</p>
        <c-button @click="closeEditor">关闭</c-button>
      </template>
      <c-form v-else :model="draft" layout="vertical" @submit="saveDraft()">
        <c-space
          ><c-tag>{{ statuses[draft.status] }}</c-tag
          ><span>{{ draft.id }}</span></c-space
        >
        <c-form-item label="执行人"
          ><c-select
            v-model="draft.personId"
            :options="personOptions"
            :disabled="readOnly || saving"
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="开始"
          ><c-date
            :model-value="new Date(draft.start)"
            value-format="Date"
            :show-time="!draft.allDay"
            :disabled="readOnly || saving"
            @update:model-value="setStart"
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-form-item v-if="draft.allDay" label="结束日期（不含）"
          ><c-date
            :model-value="new Date(draft.end)"
            value-format="Date"
            :disabled="readOnly || saving"
            @update:model-value="setAllDayEnd"
        /></c-form-item>
        <p v-else>计划结束：{{ format(calculatedEnd) }}</p>
        <c-form-item label="任务">
          <div class="detail-task-list">
            <div
              v-for="(entry, index) in draftTasks"
              :key="entry.id"
              class="detail-task"
              :data-task-id="entry.id"
            >
              <WorkbenchPunches
                :data="data"
                :task="entry"
                :start="taskStart(index)"
              />
              <div>
                <c-tag>{{ entry.source }}</c-tag> ·
                {{ resource(entry.deviceId)?.label }}
              </div>
              <c-button variant="text" @click="workOrderTask = entry"
                >工单详情</c-button
              >
              <c-button
                v-if="!readOnly"
                variant="text"
                :disabled="saving"
                @click="removeDraftTask(entry.id)"
                >移出任务</c-button
              >
            </div>
            <c-select
              v-if="!readOnly"
              v-model="addTaskId"
              :options="availableTaskOptions"
              placeholder="选择同设备待办任务"
              :disabled="saving"
              @update:model-value="addTask"
            />
            <c-button
              v-if="!readOnly"
              :disabled="saving || !selectedTasks.length"
              @click="addSelected"
              >加入已勾选任务（{{ selectedTasks.length }}）</c-button
            >
          </div>
        </c-form-item>
        <template v-if="draft.status === 'closed'">
          <p v-for="record in linkedPunches" :key="record.id">
            实际：{{ format(record.start) }} – {{ format(record.end) }}
          </p>
        </template>
        <template v-if="closing && !readOnly">
          <c-divider />
          <c-form-item label="关联打卡">
            <div class="detail-task-list">
              <c-checkbox
                v-for="record in eligiblePunches"
                :key="record.id"
                :model-value="draft.punchIds.includes(record.id)"
                :disabled="saving"
                @update:model-value="togglePunch(record.id, $event)"
                >{{ format(record.start) }} – {{ time(record.end) }}</c-checkbox
              >
              <c-empty
                v-if="!eligiblePunches.length"
                description="暂无匹配打卡，可手动补录"
              />
            </div>
          </c-form-item>
          <c-checkbox v-model="manualPunch" :disabled="saving"
            >手动补录打卡</c-checkbox
          >
          <c-form-item v-if="manualPunch" label="登录"
            ><c-date
              v-model="punchStart"
              value-format="Date"
              show-time
              :disabled="saving"
          /></c-form-item>
          <c-form-item v-if="manualPunch" label="注销"
            ><c-date
              v-model="punchEnd"
              value-format="Date"
              show-time
              :disabled="saving"
          /></c-form-item>
        </template>
        <c-space wrap>
          <c-button
            v-if="!readOnly"
            html-type="submit"
            status="primary"
            :loading="saving"
            >{{ closing ? "确认关单" : "保存" }}</c-button
          >
          <c-button
            v-if="!readOnly && draft.version && !closing"
            :disabled="saving || !draft.taskIds.length"
            @click="closing = true"
            >关联打卡并关单</c-button
          >
          <c-button
            v-if="!readOnly && draft.version"
            status="danger"
            :disabled="saving"
            @click="saveDraft(true)"
            >删除出勤单</c-button
          >
          <c-button :disabled="saving" @click="closeEditor">{{
            readOnly ? "关闭" : "取消"
          }}</c-button>
        </c-space>
      </c-form>
    </template>
  </c-dialog>
  <c-dialog
    :open="!!workOrderTask"
    title="工单详情"
    :footer="false"
    @update:open="!$event && (workOrderTask = undefined)"
  >
    <template v-if="workOrderTask"
      ><h3>{{ workOrderTask.id }} · {{ workOrderTask.title }}</h3>
      <p>{{ resource(workOrderTask.deviceId)?.label }}</p>
      <p>
        {{ workOrderTask.skill }} / {{ workOrderTask.people }} 人 /
        {{ workOrderTask.minutes }} 分钟
      </p>
      <p>
        来源：{{ workOrderTask.source }}；截止：{{ workOrderTask.deadline }}
      </p></template
    >
  </c-dialog>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import {
  formatDemoTime,
  formatDemoDateTime,
  formatDemoDate,
} from "../../__demos__/locale";
import {
  computed,
  nextTick,
  onBeforeUnmount,
  onMounted,
  ref,
  watch,
} from "vue";
import type {
  SchedulerEvent,
  SchedulerEventTemplate,
  SchedulerEditorRequest,
  SchedulerChangeContext,
} from "../index";
import { schedulerDateKey } from "../core";
import type { TreeNodeData } from "../../tree";
import WorkbenchPunches from "./workbench-punches.vue";
import {
  createWorkbenchApi,
  createWorkbenchMock,
  copyData,
  moveWorkbenchOrder,
  orderEnd,
  orderTasks,
  pendingWorkbenchTasks,
  projectWorkbench,
  remainingDays,
  weekLabel,
  workbenchLayout,
  type WorkbenchOrder,
  type WorkbenchTask,
  type WorkbenchPunch,
  type SaveResult,
} from "./workbench-model";

const today = new Date();
const api = createWorkbenchApi(createWorkbenchMock(today));
const data = ref(api.load());
const date = ref(new Date(today));
const role = ref<"dispatcher" | "viewer">("dispatcher");
const roles = [
  { value: "dispatcher", label: "调度员（可编辑）" },
  { value: "viewer", label: "查看者（只读）" },
];
const statuses = {
  planned: "待出发",
  active: "进行中",
  submit: "待提交",
  review: "待审核",
  closed: "已完成",
};
const rejectSave = ref(false),
  conflict = ref(false),
  saving = ref(false),
  navigationOpen = ref(false),
  datePickerOpen = ref(false);
const query = ref(""),
  recent = ref<string[]>(["li", "station-a"]),
  selected = ref<string[]>(["me"]);
const selectedTasks = ref<string[]>([]),
  draggingTasks = ref<string[]>([]),
  dragDeadline = ref<string>();
const notice = ref(""),
  noticeError = ref(false),
  editorError = ref(""),
  lastPayload = ref("");
const editorOpen = ref(false),
  draft = ref<WorkbenchOrder>(),
  hoverOrder = ref("");
const closing = ref(false),
  manualPunch = ref(false),
  punchStart = ref<Date>(),
  punchEnd = ref<Date>();
const addTaskId = ref<string>(),
  workOrderTask = ref<WorkbenchTask>();
const host = ref<HTMLElement>();
const scheduler = ref();
let opener: HTMLElement | undefined;
let sequence = 0;
let staged: (() => SaveResult) | undefined;
const events = computed(() => projectWorkbench(data.value, selected.value));
const pending = computed(() => pendingWorkbenchTasks(data.value, today));
const resource = (id: unknown) =>
  data.value.resources.find((item) => item.id === id);
const task = (id: unknown) => data.value.tasks.find((item) => item.id === id);
const draftTasks = computed(() =>
  draft.value ? orderTasks(draft.value, data.value) : [],
);
const calculatedEnd = computed(() =>
  draft.value ? orderEnd(draft.value.start, draftTasks.value) : "",
);
const readOnly = computed(
  () =>
    role.value === "viewer" ||
    draft.value?.kind === "rest" ||
    draft.value?.status === "closed",
);
const activeOrder = computed(() =>
  editorOpen.value ? draft.value?.id : hoverOrder.value,
);
const personOptions = computed(() =>
  data.value.resources
    .filter((r) => r.dimensionId === "person")
    .map((r) => ({ value: r.id, label: r.label })),
);
const availableTaskOptions = computed(() =>
  pending.value
    .filter(
      (entry) =>
        !draft.value?.taskIds.includes(entry.id) &&
        (!draftTasks.value.length ||
          entry.deviceId === draftTasks.value[0].deviceId),
    )
    .map((entry) => ({
      value: entry.id,
      label: `${entry.title} · ${resource(entry.deviceId)?.label}`,
    })),
);
const eligiblePunches = computed(() =>
  data.value.punches.filter(
    (record) =>
      record.personId === draft.value?.personId &&
      record.deviceId === draftTasks.value[0]?.deviceId,
  ),
);
const linkedPunches = computed(() =>
  data.value.punches.filter((record) =>
    draft.value?.punchIds.includes(record.id),
  ),
);
const preview = computed<SchedulerEvent | undefined>(() =>
  editorOpen.value && draft.value?.version === 0
    ? {
        id: "workbench-draft",
        title:
          draftTasks.value.map((entry) => entry.title).join("、") || "新出勤单",
        start: draft.value.start,
        end: draft.value.allDay
          ? draft.value.end
          : draft.value.taskIds.length
            ? calculatedEnd.value
            : new Date(+new Date(draft.value.start) + 3600000).toISOString(),
        allDay: draft.value.allDay,
        color: resource(draft.value.personId)?.color,
        backgroundColor: resource(draft.value.personId)?.background,
      }
    : undefined,
);

interface Node extends TreeNodeData {
  resourceId?: string;
  taskId?: string;
  children?: Node[];
}
const group = (key: string, title: string, ids: string[]): Node => ({
  value: key,
  label: title,
  children: ids.map((id) => ({
    value: `${key}/${id}`,
    label: resource(id)?.label,
    resourceId: id,
  })),
});
const sourceTree = computed<Node[]>(() => [
  ...(query.value.trim()
    ? [
        group(
          "search",
          "搜索结果",
          data.value.resources
            .filter((r) =>
              `${r.label} ${r.account ?? ""}`
                .toLowerCase()
                .includes(query.value.trim().toLowerCase()),
            )
            .map((r) => r.id),
        ),
      ]
    : []),
  group("self", "自己", ["me"]),
  group("stations", "我的站", ["station-a", "station-b"]),
  group("favorites", "收藏", ["station-a", "station-c"]),
  group("recent", "最近使用", recent.value),
]);
const expandedSources = ref<Array<string | number>>([
  "self",
  "stations",
  "favorites",
  "recent",
  "search",
]);
const sourceKeys = computed(() =>
  sourceTree.value
    .flatMap((node) => node.children ?? [])
    .filter((node) => selected.value.includes(node.resourceId!))
    .map((node) => node.value!),
);
function checkSources(
  _keys: Array<string | number>,
  context: { checked?: boolean; node?: Node },
) {
  if (saving.value || !context.node) return;
  const ids = context.node.resourceId
    ? [context.node.resourceId]
    : (context.node.children ?? []).map((node) => node.resourceId!);
  selected.value = context.checked
    ? [...new Set([...selected.value, ...ids])]
    : selected.value.filter((id) => !ids.includes(id));
  if (context.checked)
    recent.value = [...new Set([...ids, ...recent.value])].slice(0, 12);
}
function toggleResource(id: string) {
  selected.value = selected.value.includes(id)
    ? selected.value.filter((value) => value !== id)
    : [...selected.value, id];
  recent.value = [...new Set([id, ...recent.value])].slice(0, 12);
}
const pendingTree = computed<Node[]>(() =>
  selected.value.flatMap((id) => {
    const owner = resource(id);
    const ids =
      owner?.dimensionId === "device"
        ? [id]
        : data.value.resources
            .filter((r) => r.managers?.includes(id))
            .map((r) => r.id);
    const tasks = pending.value.filter((entry) => ids.includes(entry.deviceId));
    return tasks.length
      ? [
          {
            value: `pending/${id}`,
            label: owner?.label,
            children: tasks.map((entry) => ({
              value: `pending/${id}/${entry.id}`,
              label: entry.title,
              taskId: entry.id,
            })),
          },
        ]
      : [];
  }),
);
const expandedPending = ref<Array<string | number>>(
  data.value.resources.map((r) => `pending/${r.id}`),
);
const pendingKeys = computed(() =>
  pendingTree.value
    .flatMap((node) => node.children ?? [])
    .filter((node) => selectedTasks.value.includes(node.taskId!))
    .map((node) => node.value!),
);
function checkPending(
  _keys: Array<string | number>,
  context: { checked?: boolean; node?: Node },
) {
  if (!context.node) return;
  const ids = context.node.taskId
    ? [context.node.taskId]
    : (context.node.children ?? []).map((node) => node.taskId!);
  const next = context.checked
    ? [...new Set([...selectedTasks.value, ...ids])]
    : selectedTasks.value.filter((id) => !ids.includes(id));
  if (new Set(next.map((id) => task(id)?.deviceId)).size > 1)
    return showNotice("请勾选同一设备的任务", true);
  selectedTasks.value = next;
}
const deadlineClass = (entry?: WorkbenchTask) => ({
  overdue: entry && remainingDays(entry, today) < 0,
  urgent:
    entry &&
    remainingDays(entry, today) >= 0 &&
    remainingDays(entry, today) <= 3,
});
const deadlineText = (entry?: WorkbenchTask) => {
  if (!entry) return "";
  const days = remainingDays(entry, today);
  return days < 0
    ? `逾期 ${-days} 天`
    : days === 0
      ? "今天截止"
      : `剩 ${days} 天`;
};
function beginPending(
  id: string,
  startDrag: (template: SchedulerEventTemplate, event: DragEvent) => void,
  event: DragEvent,
) {
  const ids = selectedTasks.value.includes(id)
    ? [...selectedTasks.value]
    : [id];
  draggingTasks.value = ids;
  dragDeadline.value = ids
    .map((key) => task(key)?.deadline ?? "")
    .filter(Boolean)
    .sort()[0];
  startDrag(
    {
      title: ids.map((key) => task(key)?.title).join("、"),
      duration: ids.reduce((sum, key) => sum + (task(key)?.minutes ?? 0), 0),
      metadata: { taskIds: ids },
    },
    event,
  );
}
function captureDrag(event: PointerEvent) {
  const node = (event.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLElement>(
    "[data-order-id]",
  );
  const order = data.value.orders.find(
    (item) => item.id === node?.dataset.orderId,
  );
  if (
    order &&
    order.kind === "work" &&
    order.status !== "closed" &&
    role.value !== "viewer"
  )
    dragDeadline.value = orderTasks(order, data.value)
      .map((entry) => entry.deadline)
      .sort()[0];
}
function endDrag() {
  dragDeadline.value = undefined;
  draggingTasks.value = [];
}
function allowMerge(event: DragEvent, target: SchedulerEvent) {
  if (
    draggingTasks.value.length &&
    !target.readonly &&
    !saving.value &&
    role.value !== "viewer"
  )
    event.preventDefault();
}
async function dropMerge(event: DragEvent, target: SchedulerEvent) {
  if (!draggingTasks.value.length) return;
  event.preventDefault();
  event.stopPropagation();
  const ids = [...draggingTasks.value];
  endDrag();
  const current = data.value.orders.find(
    (order) => order.id === target.metadata?.orderId,
  );
  if (!current || target.readonly || saving.value || role.value === "viewer")
    return showNotice("当前记录不可合并", true);
  const next = copyData(current);
  next.taskIds = [...new Set([...next.taskIds, ...ids])];
  if (!next.allDay)
    next.end = orderEnd(next.start, orderTasks(next, data.value));
  await persist(next);
}
function openEditor(request: SchedulerEditorRequest) {
  editorError.value = "";
  closing.value = false;
  manualPunch.value = false;
  addTaskId.value = undefined;
  opener =
    document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement
      ? document.activeElement
      : undefined;
  if (request.action === "edit") {
    const order = data.value.orders.find(
      (item) => item.id === request.event.metadata?.orderId,
    );
    if (!order) return;
    draft.value = copyData(order);
  } else {
    const templateIds = request.event.metadata?.taskIds;
    const ids = Array.isArray(templateIds)
      ? templateIds.filter((id): id is string => typeof id === "string")
      : [...selectedTasks.value];
    const start = new Date(request.event.start ?? date.value);
    if (request.source === "toolbar") start.setHours(9, 0, 0, 0);
    else if (request.source === "cell") start.setMinutes(0, 0, 0);
    draft.value = {
      id: `ATT-${Date.now()}-${++sequence}`,
      version: 0,
      personId:
        selected.value.find((id) => resource(id)?.dimensionId === "person") ??
        "me",
      taskIds: ids,
      start: start.toISOString(),
      end: request.event.allDay
        ? new Date(request.event.end!).toISOString()
        : orderEnd(
            start.toISOString(),
            ids.map(task).filter((entry): entry is WorkbenchTask => !!entry),
          ),
      allDay: request.event.allDay,
      kind: "work",
      status: "planned",
      punchIds: [],
    };
  }
  punchStart.value = new Date(draft.value.start);
  punchEnd.value = new Date(draft.value.end);
  editorOpen.value = true;
  endDrag();
}
function setStart(value: Date | undefined) {
  if (draft.value && value && Number.isFinite(+value))
    draft.value.start = value.toISOString();
}
function setAllDayEnd(value: Date | undefined) {
  if (draft.value && value && Number.isFinite(+value))
    draft.value.end = value.toISOString();
}
function addTask(id: string) {
  if (draft.value && id)
    draft.value.taskIds = [...new Set([...draft.value.taskIds, id])];
  addTaskId.value = undefined;
}
function addSelected() {
  if (!draft.value) return;
  const ids = [...new Set([...draft.value.taskIds, ...selectedTasks.value])];
  if (new Set(ids.map((id) => task(id)?.deviceId)).size > 1) {
    editorError.value = "一张出勤单只能安排同一设备的任务";
    return;
  }
  draft.value.taskIds = ids;
}
function removeDraftTask(id: string) {
  if (draft.value)
    draft.value.taskIds = draft.value.taskIds.filter((value) => value !== id);
}
function taskStart(index: number) {
  return draft.value
    ? orderEnd(draft.value.start, draftTasks.value.slice(0, index))
    : "";
}
function togglePunch(id: string, checked: boolean) {
  if (draft.value)
    draft.value.punchIds = checked
      ? [...new Set([...draft.value.punchIds, id])]
      : draft.value.punchIds.filter((key) => key !== id);
}
function options() {
  const value = {
    role: role.value,
    fail: rejectSave.value,
    conflict: conflict.value,
  };
  conflict.value = false;
  return value;
}
function accept(result: SaveResult) {
  data.value = result.data;
  selectedTasks.value = selectedTasks.value.filter((id) =>
    pending.value.some((entry) => entry.id === id),
  );
  showNotice(result.warnings.join("；") || "已保存", false);
}
async function persist(
  value: WorkbenchOrder,
  remove = false,
  manual?: WorkbenchPunch,
) {
  saving.value = true;
  editorError.value = "";
  lastPayload.value = JSON.stringify(
    {
      operation: remove ? "remove" : "save",
      order: value,
      manualPunch: manual,
    },
    null,
    2,
  );
  try {
    accept(await api.save(value, options(), remove, manual));
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    editorError.value = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "保存失败";
    showNotice(editorError.value, true);
    return false;
  } finally {
    saving.value = false;
  }
}
async function saveDraft(remove = false) {
  if (!draft.value || saving.value || readOnly.value) return;
  const value = copyData(draft.value);
  const dissolve = !!value.version && !value.taskIds.length;
  if (!value.allDay && value.taskIds.length)
    value.end = orderEnd(value.start, orderTasks(value, data.value));
  let manual: WorkbenchPunch | undefined;
  if (closing.value && !remove && !dissolve) {
    value.status = "closed";
    if (manualPunch.value) {
      if (
        !punchStart.value ||
        !punchEnd.value ||
        !Number.isFinite(+punchStart.value) ||
        !Number.isFinite(+punchEnd.value)
      ) {
        editorError.value = "请填写登录和注销时间";
        return;
      }
      manual = {
        id: `punch-${Date.now()}-${++sequence}`,
        personId: value.personId,
        deviceId: draftTasks.value[0]?.deviceId ?? "",
        start: punchStart.value.toISOString(),
        end: punchEnd.value.toISOString(),
      };
      value.punchIds = [...value.punchIds, manual.id];
    }
  }
  if (await persist(value, remove || dissolve, manual)) closeEditor();
}
async function prepareMove(context: SchedulerChangeContext) {
  if (!context.previous || context.type !== "move")
    throw new Error("请在出勤单详情中修改");
  if (context.event.allDay !== context.previous.allDay)
    throw new Error("请在详情中调整全天安排");
  const next = moveWorkbenchOrder(data.value, context.event, context.previous);
  lastPayload.value = JSON.stringify(
    { operation: "move", order: next },
    null,
    2,
  );
  staged = await api.prepare(next, options());
  return true;
}
function finishMove() {
  try {
    if (staged) accept(staged());
  } catch (error) {
    moveError(error);
  } finally {
    staged = undefined;
    endDrag();
  }
}
function moveError(error: unknown) {
  staged = undefined;
  showNotice(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "保存失败", true);
  endDrag();
}
function showNotice(message: string, error: boolean) {
  notice.value = message;
  noticeError.value = error;
}
function reload() {
  data.value = api.load();
  if (draft.value?.version)
    draft.value = copyData(
      data.value.orders.find((item) => item.id === draft.value?.id) ??
        draft.value,
    );
  editorError.value = "";
  showNotice("已重新加载", false);
}
async function onEditorVisibility(open: boolean) {
  if (open) return;
  hoverOrder.value = "";
  await nextTick();
  if (opener?.isConnected) opener.focus({ preventScroll: true });
}
function closeEditor() {
  editorOpen.value = false;
  void onEditorVisibility(false);
}
async function chooseDate(value: Date | undefined) {
  if (value && Number.isFinite(+value)) date.value = value;
  datePickerOpen.value = false;
}
async function goToday() {
  date.value = new Date();
  await nextTick();
  const container =
    host.value?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".c-scheduler__main");
  const heading = [
    ...(host.value?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
      "[data-scheduler-heading-date]",
    ) ?? []),
  ].find(
    (element) =>
      schedulerDateKey(element.dataset.schedulerHeadingDate!) ===
      schedulerDateKey(new Date()),
  );
  const cell = host.value?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
    ".c-scheduler__time-cell",
  );
  if (container && cell) {
    container.scrollTop = (cell.getBoundingClientRect().height || 36) * 7;
    if (heading) container.scrollLeft = Math.max(0, heading.offsetLeft - 64);
  }
}
const time = (value: SchedulerEvent["start"]) =>
  value == null
    ? ""
    : formatDemoTime(new Date(value), {
        hour: "2-digit",
        minute: "2-digit",
        hour12: false,
      });
const format = (value: string) =>
  formatDemoDateTime(new Date(value), {
    month: "numeric",
    day: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    hour12: false,
  });
const cancelWithEscape = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  if (event.key === "Escape") endDrag();
};
onMounted(() => {
  window.addEventListener("pointerup", endDrag);
  window.addEventListener("pointercancel", endDrag);
  window.addEventListener("blur", endDrag);
  window.addEventListener("keydown", cancelWithEscape);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  window.removeEventListener("pointerup", endDrag);
  window.removeEventListener("pointercancel", endDrag);
  window.removeEventListener("blur", endDrag);
  window.removeEventListener("keydown", cancelWithEscape);
});
watch(query, () => {
  if (!expandedSources.value.includes("search"))
    expandedSources.value.push("search");
});
</script>
```

[打开宽屏工作台](llms/zh-CN/examples/task-calendar.md)。所有日期以打开页面时的本周一和今天动态生成，包含本周/下周、逾期/临期、已关闭记录与工作日轮休。

工作台将出勤单、任务、打卡保存为独立业务 DTO，再通过 `workbench-model.ts` 投影为 SchedulerEvent：一个任务一块，同单连续任务共享 `layoutGroupId`；同时勾选人员与设备时，各生成稳定视图 ID，点击/悬停关联高亮。跨天与全天单按出勤单投影到全天区。对象色、闭单白蒙版、休息斜纹和边框都由 Demo 映射，不添加组件业务状态。

人员/设备与待办分别使用 Cedar Tree，来源搜索固定在顶部。父节点勾选由 Tree 提供，重复资源条目的选中状态由资源 ID 同步；站点快捷按钮支持再次反选。待办按设备或选中人员负责的站点聚合，逾期优先、截止日期较早优先。待办可拖空白建单、拖到已有可编辑任务块合并，也可在详情中加入已勾选任务。一次打包限制同一设备。移出任务在保存后回池，最后一项移出后解散出勤单；取消或保存失败均不修改已保存数据。

详情支持按标准工时计算计划结束、查看工单、任务 hover/focus 显示该设备打卡并定位最近记录、关联已有打卡或手动补录后关单。已关闭、休息和查看者都不可编辑。时间重叠、每日超过 8 小时及超截止日只提示；技能、数据完整性、权限和版本冲突拒绝保存。拖动期间的截止日背景通过 `column-background` 插槽显示，空白仍允许落入。

保存使用独立内存 Mock API，`重新加载` 读取该 API 当前数据，刷新浏览器会重建 Mock。`提交数据` 可查看真实提交给 Mock 的业务 DTO，未把视图投影数组当成后端主表。移动通过 `before-change` 异步准备、`change` 成功后版本比较并提交，取消或过期手势不写入服务端；表单直接调用同一业务 API。保存失败保留草稿和勾选。生产接入只替换 API，不需要修改 Scheduler。

交互取舍：详情统一用 Dialog；全天表单允许填写日期范围；任务级实际打卡时间尚无独立来源时，闭单后的任务块按标准工时比例分布在整单真实打卡区间，详情保留原始记录。原生拖放合并的目标为任务卡片内容区，键盘操作使用“加入已勾选任务”；不向核心增加出勤单 drop-target 协议。

## 阅读方向

继承页面、局部容器或 ConfigProvider 的 `dir`，可沿用文档导航的 LTR/RTL 按钮实时切换。月/周/资源列和横向时间轴从阅读起点排列；纵向时间仍从上向下。切换方向保留日期、日程数据、选择和横向阅读距离，并取消正在进行的拖动或拉伸。

小时级资源时间线支持日程移动和开始/结束两端拉伸，遵守 `snapDuration`、只读状态、里程碑和日程的 `resizable` 限制。时间轴缩放保留可视时间区域中心的日期；资源标签固定在阅读起点，虚拟行与表头同步滚动。

默认重叠布局使用逻辑起点；自定义 `eventLayout` 返回的 `left` 保持屏幕物理左侧语义，由调用方按业务需要提供几何位置。日期、时区、依赖关系和资源顺序不会因 RTL 而反转。

## 使用说明

### 异步操作反馈

before-* 等待期间显示加载反馈并标记 aria-busy；拒绝或失败后恢复，重复提交不再启动同一操作。普通事件返回的 Promise 不参与加载。
### 配置说明

所有变量集中于 `style/token.less`，支持亮暗主题覆盖。

| selected-keys | 受控选中日程 ID，支持 v-model:selected-keys；共享日程只计一次 | string[] | `undefined` |
| default-selected-keys | 非受控初始选中日程 ID；共享日程只计一次 | string[] | `[]` |
| history | 对已接受的变更启用撤销与重做 | boolean | false |
| history-limit | 历史记录数量，正整数；无效值回退 20 | number | 20 |
| before-transaction | 事务保存守卫，设置后替代 before-change | SchedulerBeforeTransaction / SchedulerBeforeTransaction[] | — |
| working-hours | 每周工作时间；省略不限制，空数组禁止定时日程 | SchedulerWorkingHours[] | — |
| date-working-hours | 按日期覆盖工作时间 | SchedulerDateWorkingHours[] | [] |
| disabled-ranges | 禁用时间区间，可限定资源 | SchedulerDisabledRange[] | [] |
| scale | 受控资源时间线刻度，支持 v-model:scale | `'hour' \| 'day'` | `undefined` |
| default-scale | 非受控资源时间线初始刻度 | `'hour' \| 'day'` | `'day'` |
| virtual-list-props | 配置后启用资源时间线虚拟滚动 | SchedulerVirtualListProps | — |
| resource-group-dimensions | 按维度顺序交叉分组，至少两个不同维度 | string[] | [] |
| resource-group-by | 资源到稳定分组键的映射 | (resource: SchedulerResource) => string | — |
| expanded-keys | 受控展开分组键，支持 v-model:expanded-keys；省略时默认全部展开 | string[] | `undefined` |
| default-expanded-keys | 非受控初始展开分组键；省略时默认全部展开 | string[] | `undefined` |

mode 为 `day | week | month | agenda | resource-day | resource-timeline`。agenda 与资源时间线按周导航。超出时间网格小时范围的日程仍可在月/议程/时间线查看。

model-value 受控时，组件只提出新值，由父组件接受后更新界面；不会在接口失败后先移动再回滚。组件不修改输入数组或对象。before-change 得到分离副本，修改副本不会修改提交值。

### Scheduler Events

| 事件                     | 说明                                                             | 参数                                 |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| update:model-value       | 提出新主值                                                       | SchedulerEvent[]                     |
| update:resourceFilters   | 维度组合筛选变更，受控时等待父组件接受                           | SchedulerResourceFilters             |
| update:resourceDimension | 资源行/列展示维度变更                                            | string                               |
| update:mode              | 视图切换                                                         | SchedulerMode                        |
| update:zoom              | 时间线缩放值变化                                                 | number                               |
| rule-warning             | 提案通过时的提醒型规则问题                                       | SchedulerError[]                     |
| update:date              | 定位日期变更                                                     | Date                                 |
| change                   | 校验和钩子完成；受控时表示已提出通过的值                         | value, SchedulerChangeContext        |
| change-error             | 校验、冲突、保存或过期提案错误                                   | error, SchedulerChange               |
| event-click              | 激活日程（传出副本）；叠放重叠项同样通过单击或 Enter，多选不触发 | SchedulerEvent                       |
| cell-click               | 点击空白时段                                                     | SchedulerCell                        |
| range-change             | 首次与实际可见日期范围变化                                       | SchedulerRange                       |
| resource-error           | 资源搜索或回显失败，不修改日程数据                               | error, SchedulerResourceErrorContext |
| editor-request           | 仅 editable=false：请求外部新建或查看/编辑                       | SchedulerEditorRequest               |
| update:selectedKeys | 选中日程 ID 变更 | string[] |
| update:scale | 时间线刻度变更 | 'hour' / 'day' |
| update:expandedKeys | 分组展开键变更 | string[] |
| transaction | 单项或批量事务通过后提出新值 | SchedulerEvent[], SchedulerTransactionContext |
| transaction-error | 事务失败，保留原始原因 | unknown, SchedulerTransactionContext |

### Scheduler Slots

| 插槽              | 参数                                             | 说明                                                                                                               |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| event             | { event }                                        | 日程按钮内容                                                                                                       |
| sidebar           | { startDrag, cancelDrag, disabled, unscheduled } | 替换整个侧栏；适合业务资源树与待排任务池，show-sidebar=false 时不显示                                              |
| sidebar-extra     | { startDrag, cancelDrag, disabled }              | 默认侧栏顶部自定义内容；startDrag(template: SchedulerEventTemplate, event: DragEvent)，show-sidebar=false 时不显示 |
| resource-header   | { resource?, resources?, date }                  | 资源标题或日期标题                                                                                                 |
| toolbar           | { date, mode, navigate, create }                 | 替换工具栏；navigate(-1/1) 切换范围，create() 走工具栏新增流程                                                     |
| column-background | { date, resource? }                              | 日/周/资源日程列背景，不接管指针；用于业务软提示、热力背景等                                                       |
| toolbar-extra     | { date, mode }                                   | 工具栏扩展                                                                                                         |
| editor            | SchedulerEditorSlotProps                         | 自定义抽屉内容：action、event、error、errorMessage、save、remove、duplicate、close、readonly、pending                         |
| empty             | —                                                | 空状态                                                                                                             |

### Scheduler Methods

| 方法                               | 说明                                                           |
| ---------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `change(change): Promise<boolean>` | 执行 create/update/remove/move/resize，复用全部校验与钩子      |
| duplicateEvent(id: string)         | 打开独立复制草稿或发出自定义创建请求，返回 boolean，不自动保存 |
| goToDate(date: Date)               | 定位日期；遵循受控模型                                         |
| `transaction(changes): Promise<boolean>` | 执行批量事务，应用同一套规则与事务守卫 |
| `undo(): Promise<boolean>` / `redo(): Promise<boolean>` | 撤销 / 重做已接受的历史，仍经过事务守卫 |
| `canUndo` / `canRedo` | 只读状态，表示当前是否可撤销 / 重做 |

## Types

```ts
import type {
  SchedulerProps,
  SchedulerInstance,
  SchedulerMode,
  SchedulerEvent,
  SchedulerResource,
  SchedulerChange,
  SchedulerChangeContext,
  SchedulerBeforeChange,
  SchedulerBeforeTransaction,
  SchedulerTransactionContext,
  SchedulerEventTemplate,
  SchedulerRequestResources,
  SchedulerResolveResources,
  SchedulerResourcePage,
  SchedulerResourceQuery,
  SchedulerResourceErrorContext,
  SchedulerEditorRequest,
  SchedulerEditorAction,
  SchedulerEditorSlotProps,
} from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";

interface SchedulerEvent {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  start?: Date | string | number;
  end?: Date | string | number;
  allDay?: boolean;
  resourceIds?: string[];
  resourceDetails?: Record<string, { units?: number; role?: string }>;
  milestone?: boolean;
  layoutGroupId?: string;
  description?: string;
  color?: string;
  accentColor?: string;
  backgroundColor?: string;
  backgroundPattern?: "solid" | "diagonal-stripes" | "dots" | "crosshatch";
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
  readonly?: boolean;
  resizable?: boolean; // false 禁用时间网格拉伸，仍可移动/查看
}
type SchedulerEventTemplate = Pick<
  SchedulerEvent,
  | "title"
  | "description"
  | "color"
  | "accentColor"
  | "backgroundColor"
  | "backgroundPattern"
  | "metadata"
  | "resourceIds"
> & {
  duration?: number; // 正数分钟，默认 default-duration 或 step
};
interface SchedulerResource {
  id: string;
  dimensionId?: string;
  label: string;
  color?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  capacity?: number; // 非负安全整数，省略不限制并发日程数
}
interface SchedulerResourceQuery {
  dimensionId?: string;
  query: string;
  cursor?: string;
  signal: AbortSignal;
}
interface SchedulerResourcePage {
  items: SchedulerResource[];
  nextCursor?: string;
}
type SchedulerRequestResources = (
  query: SchedulerResourceQuery,
) => SchedulerResourcePage | Promise<SchedulerResourcePage>;
type SchedulerResolveResources = (
  ids: string[],
  context: { signal: AbortSignal },
) => SchedulerResource[] | Promise<SchedulerResource[]>;
type SchedulerResourceErrorContext =
  | { type: "search"; query: string; cursor?: string; dimensionId?: string }
  | { type: "resolve"; ids: string[] };

type SchedulerEditorAction = "create" | "edit";
type SchedulerEditorRequest = { event: SchedulerEvent; readonly: boolean } & (
  | { action: "create"; source: "toolbar" | "cell" | "drop" | "duplicate" }
  | { action: "edit"; source: "event" }
);
interface SchedulerEditorSlotProps {
  action: SchedulerEditorAction;
  event: SchedulerEvent;
  error?: SchedulerError;
  errorMessage?: string;
  readonly: boolean;
  pending: boolean;
  save: (event?: SchedulerEvent) => void;
  remove: () => void;
  duplicate: () => void;
  close: () => void;
}
```

每条日程 id 必须唯一。start/end 同时省略表示未排期；否则 end 必须晚于 start；定时 milestone 例外，要求 start=end。所有区间为 `[start, end)`，前后相邻不冲突。allDay 为 true 时使用 `YYYY-MM-DD` 字符串，end 是不包含的结束日期（一天事项如 9 月 9 日至 9 月 10 日）。

当前按运行环境本地时区显示，定时日程建议传 ISO 时间点；没有任意 IANA 显示时区的承诺。跨时区 RRULE、ICS 与版本同步从独立 adapters 入口提供，真实外部账号连接需业务实现；虚拟资源行通过 virtual-list-props 配置。本地历史撤销与按范围远程加载见上方示例。指针拖拽支持移动与拉伸，Escape 取消；键盘与触屏也可通过编辑表单完成排期/分配修改。资源选项的 disabled 禁止新增分配与拖入，已存在的关联可保留或移除。


`before-transaction` 优先于 `before-change`，单项或批量事务只执行事务守卫；仅配置 `before-change` 时批量事务会以 `transaction-hook-required` 拒绝，避免部分保存。守卫数组按顺序执行，返回 false 取消，void 允许。等待结束后会重新检查数据和规则；过期提案不会提交。`change-error` 和 `transaction-error` 的第一个参数保留原始 cause（`unknown`），编辑器展示使用归一化的 `SchedulerError`。受控模式中，历史只记录父组件接受的变更；普通事件返回的 Promise 不参与事务。

`useSchedulerDataSource` 从根入口导出，接受 `requestEvents`、范围、资源 ID、`enabled`、缓存时长和容量；返回 `events`、`loading`、`error`、`loadedRange`、`refresh`、`cancel`、`invalidate`。它是独立数据源，`loading` 是返回的状态而不是 Scheduler 属性；请求使用 AbortSignal，并丢弃过期结果。

## 独立核心

可通过 `@cedar-design/ui-vue/scheduler/core` 使用不依赖 Vue 或 DOM 的日程计算工具：

```ts
import {
  applySchedulerChange,
  getSchedulerConflicts,
  layoutSchedulerEvents,
} from "@cedar-design/ui-vue/scheduler/core";
```

其余日期与时间线工具也从该入口导出。核心提供计算与不可变变更，不承担网络、权限认证或数据库事务。

# Scrollbar

## 基础示例

### 基础用法

滚动条组件基本用法。scrollbar 的默认插槽需要唯一的子元素。

Example source: src/scrollbar/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-scrollbar style="height: 200px; overflow: auto">
    <div style="height: 2000px; width: 2000px; background-color: var(--c-color-primary-light-1)">Content</div>
  </c-scrollbar>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
</script>
```

## 外观与状态

### 滚动条类型

设置 `type` 属性改变滚动条类型，`track` 类型会显示滚动条轨道。

Example source: src/scrollbar/__demos__/type.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-scrollbar type="track" style="height: 200px; overflow: auto">
    <div style="height: 2000px; width: 2000px; background-color: var(--color-primary-light-4)">Content</div>
  </c-scrollbar>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
</script>
```

### 视口与轨道

原生属性、style 和 tabindex 等应用到内层滚动视口；outer-style/outer-class 应用到外层容器。外层可以比内层更宽，轨道仍沿内层视口定位并按同一长度计算滑块比例，不延伸到外层空白。track 模式在视口外预留轨道空间，embed 模式覆盖视口边缘；双轴交角和动态轴切换会重新测量，保留内容节点与原生滚动位置。轨道粗细读取现有 --c-scrollbar-track-size 的实际 CSS 尺寸，主题变化后重新计算。

```vue
<c-scrollbar
  outer-style="width: 100%"
  style="width: 300px; max-width: 100%; height: 200px; overflow: auto"
  tabindex="0"
  role="region"
  aria-label="可滚动示例"
>
  <div style="width: 900px; height: 600px">Content</div>
</c-scrollbar>
```

## 生命周期与边界

### Thumb drag lifecycle / 滑块拖动生命周期

拖动期间改变方向或滑块尺寸会结束当前拖动；只替换内容相同的 data 对象不会中断。setOffset 将偏移限制在有效范围内，拖动期间调用不会覆盖正在进行的拖动。非鼠标主键不启动操作，轨道点击按一个滑块长度步进。

Example source: src/scrollbar/__demos__/thumb-lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("scrollbarThumbLifecycleInline");

import { ref } from "vue";
const active = ref(true);
const mounted = ref(true);
const scrolls = ref(0);
</script>
<template>
  <div>
    <c-button @click="active = !active">{{ inlineCopy.activate }}</c-button>
    <c-button @click="mounted = !mounted">{{ inlineCopy.mount }}</c-button>
    <c-button @mouseenter="active = false">{{
      inlineCopy.hoverWhileDraggingToDeactivate
    }}</c-button>
    <p>
      {{ inlineCopy.scrollNotifications }} {{ scrolls }}. Drag a thumb, release,
      open context menu or blur the window; later movement must not replay.
      Fresh activation requires a fresh press.
    </p>
    <KeepAlive v-if="mounted">
      <c-scrollbar
        v-if="active"
        style="height: 160px; width: 260px; overflow: auto"
        @scroll="scrolls++"
      >
        <div style="height: 800px; width: 700px">
          {{ inlineCopy.dragTheHorizontalVerticalThumb }}
        </div>
      </c-scrollbar>
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Scrollbar consumer lifecycle / 滚动条消费者生命周期

scrollTo(0,0)／单轴0是合法坐标，不用真值判断；恢复零位置也同步thumb，不保留上次偏移。水平滚动按横向可滚动范围计算。零／无效视口用有限、非负thumb数据，不显示该零尺寸轴；正常最小thumb20px与track15px布局策略不变。禁用／隐藏轴的旧thumb命令无效，但禁用条不等于禁止内容或公开原生滚动。对象选项直接透传、不模拟JS动画；公开方法签名／样式变量不变。

Example source: src/scrollbar/__demos__/lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("scrollbarLifecycleInline");

import { ref } from "vue";
import type { ScrollbarInstance } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";
const active = ref(true);
const mounted = ref(true);
const bar = ref<ScrollbarInstance>();
let retained: ScrollbarInstance | undefined;
function remember() {
  retained = bar.value;
}
function scrollRetained() {
  retained?.scrollTo(100, 100);
}
</script>
<template>
  <div>
    <c-button @click="remember">{{ inlineCopy.rememberHandle }}</c-button>
    <c-button @click="active = !active">{{ inlineCopy.activate }}</c-button>
    <c-button @click="mounted = !mounted">{{ inlineCopy.mount }}</c-button>
    <c-button @click="scrollRetained">{{ inlineCopy.retainedScroll }}</c-button>
    <c-button @click="bar?.scrollTo(0, 0)">{{ inlineCopy.origin }}</c-button>
    <p>
      Remember the handle, deactivate or unmount, then call it. It must be
      inert. Activate for fresh commands; zero coordinates must work.
    </p>
    <KeepAlive v-if="mounted">
      <c-scrollbar
        v-if="active"
        ref="bar"
        style="height: 160px; width: 260px; overflow: auto"
      >
        <div style="height: 800px; width: 700px">
          {{ inlineCopy.scrollableContent }}
        </div>
      </c-scrollbar>
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
</template>
```

## API

### Scrollbar Props

| 参数名 | 描述 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| type | 轨道显示方式 | `'track' \| 'embed'` | `'embed'` |
| outer-class | 外层类名，支持字符串、布尔类名对象及数组 | `ClassName` | `undefined` |
| outer-style | Vue 样式值，包括 CSS 字符串、对象、数组和条件 false | `StyleValue` | `undefined` |

三个属性均可省略。hide、disable-horizontal、disable-vertical 是内部组合开关，不属于公开 ScrollbarProps。隐藏装饰轴不禁止原生内容滚动或公开滚动方法。

### Scrollbar Events

| 事件名 | 描述 | 参数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| scroll | 内层视口原生滚动通知，保留原始 Event；不等待监听器 Promise | `event: Event` |

### Scrollbar Slots

| 插槽名 | 描述 | 参数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | 滚动内容；提供一个根元素供内容尺寸观察 | — |

### Scrollbar Methods

| 方法名 | 描述 | 参数 | 返回值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| scrollTo | 支持坐标或原生选项；省略数字坐标时按 0 处理 | `options?: number \| ScrollToOptions, y?: number` | `void` |
| scrollTop | 设置原生纵向位置，0 有效 | `top: number` | `void` |
| scrollLeft | 设置原生横向位置，0 和原生 RTL 负值有效 | `left: number` | `void` |

对象选项透传原生 Element.scrollTo，可使用 left、top 和 behavior。动画及取消遵循浏览器规则，组件不增加 JS 动画或完成 Promise。停用或卸载后，保留的实例命令不执行滚动。

## Types

```ts
import Scrollbar from '@cedar-design/ui-vue/scrollbar'
import type { ScrollbarProps, ScrollbarInstance } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'
import type { ScrollbarProps as SubScrollbarProps } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue/scrollbar'
const options: ScrollbarProps = {
  outerClass: ['messages', { active: true }],
  outerStyle: [{ maxWidth: '100%' }, false],
  onScroll: (event: Event) => console.info(event.target),
}
```

### 焦点与阅读方向

id、dir、tabindex、role、aria-label 和普通 class/style 传到内层视口。需要键盘滚动时为视口提供 tabindex=0 和可读名称，聚焦后使用浏览器原生方向键或翻页键。交互内容保留各自的焦点和按键行为。

横向公开坐标采用浏览器的原生 scrollLeft，不转换为统一正数。RTL 中 Chromium 可出现负值；将原生坐标传给 scrollLeft/scrollTo 即可，视觉滑块与原生坐标同步。不要把滑块内部偏移当作公开滚动坐标。

## CSS Variables

<!-- component-css-variables:start -->

通过以下变量定制组件外观。默认值随表中注明的主题或选择器条件变化；变量仅在对应的尺寸、变体和交互状态下生效。

<div class="token-reference-table" style="max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto;">

| 变量 | 默认值／条件 | 影响的样式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--c-scrollbar-thumb-bar-bg-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-border-default)` | `background-color` |
| `--c-scrollbar-thumb-bar-bg-color-hover` | `var(--c-sys-color-border-strong)` | `background-color` |
| `--c-scrollbar-thumb-bar-border-radius` | `6px` | `border-radius` |
| `--c-scrollbar-thumb-bar-size` | `9px` | `height`, `margin`, `width` |
| `--c-scrollbar-track-bg-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-surface-muted)` | `background-color` |
| `--c-scrollbar-track-border-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-border-subtle)` | `border-bottom`, `border-left`, `border-right`, `border-top` |
| `--c-scrollbar-track-border-size` | `1px` | `border-bottom`, `border-left`, `border-right`, `border-top`, `margin`, `right` |
| `--c-scrollbar-track-size` | `15px` | `height`, `margin`, `width` |

</div>

将覆盖设置在组件实际根节点或弹层真实挂载祖先上。例如给该元素添加下列 class，再按需替换变量值：

```css
.component-theme {
  --c-scrollbar-thumb-bar-bg-color: var(--c-sys-color-border-default);
}
```

显式行内样式及直接写入同一 CSS 属性的 Props 优先于样式表默认值。Teleport 后，普通 CSS 变量按实际挂载位置继承；使用 ThemeProvider 时，请遵循其局部主题与弹层配置规则。局部定制请直接覆盖组件变量；仅修改后代的 system 变量不会重新计算从根继承的组件别名。内部变量不属于公共 API。

# Search

搜索组件，支持基础搜索、按钮搜索、字段搜索和受控的最近搜索记录。组件内部不持久化搜索历史；开发者可以根据 `search` 事件返回的 `recentSearches` 自行缓存到本地、服务端或状态管理中，再通过 `recent-searches` 回传给组件。

先看关键词与提交，再看字段模型，最后接入受控历史和自定义展示。组件不发业务请求，外部在 search 事件中处理异步任务并控制 loading。

`empty-value` 指定当前组件已有清空动作的输出；省略时采用该组件默认返回。具体类型以组件 API 为准。它不改变 empty-values 的识别规则，也不改变 Form reset 的初始值。

## 基础示例

### 基础用法

输入关键词后按 Enter 提交；本例只展示一个关键词和提交结果。字段模型与历史记录在后续独立案例中说明。

Example source: src/search/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import type { SearchResult } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'
const keyword = ref('')
const submitted = ref('')
function onSearch(result: SearchResult) { submitted.value = result.modelValue }
</script>
<template>
  <c-search v-model="keyword" placeholder="输入关键词后按 Enter" @search="onSearch" />
  <p role="status">已提交：{{ submitted || '尚未搜索' }}</p>
</template>
```

### 带下拉字段选择

Example source: src/search/__demos__/with-fields.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-search
      v-model="keyword"
      v-model:model-field="modelField"
      v-model:model="model"
      :style="inputStyle"
      :fields="fields"
      :recent-searches="recentSearches"
      :select-style="{ minWidth: '140px' }"
      default-field="name"
      placeholder="请输入搜索内容"
      search-button
      @change="handleChange"
      @search="handleSearch"
    />
    <c-button @click="resetModel">Reset Model</c-button>
    <div>最近提交：{{ latestChange || "-" }}</div>
    <pre v-if="latestResult">{{ JSON.stringify(latestResult, null, 2) }}</pre>
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { SearchResult, SearchField } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";

const inputStyle = { width: "420px" };
const keyword = ref("");
const modelField = ref("name");
const model = ref<Record<string, unknown>>({});
const recentSearches = ref<string[]>(["设备 A", "设备 B", "设备 C"]);
const latestChange = ref("");
const latestResult = ref<SearchResult>();

const fields: SearchField[] = [
  {
    value: "id",
    label: "设备 ID",
    placeholder: "请输入设备 ID",
  },
  {
    value: "name",
    label: "设备名称",
    placeholder: "请输入设备名称",
  },
  {
    value: "desc",
    label: "设备描述",
    placeholder: "请输入设备描述",
  },
];

function handleSearch(data: SearchResult) {
  recentSearches.value = data.recentSearches;
  latestResult.value = data;
}

function handleChange(value: string) {
  latestChange.value = value;
}

function resetModel() {
  model.value = {};
  keyword.value = "";
}
</script>
```

### 本地缓存搜索历史

Example source: src/search/__demos__/local-storage.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-search
      v-model="keyword"
      :style="inputStyle"
      placeholder="业务侧使用 localStorage 保存搜索历史"
      :recent-searches="recentSearches"
      @search="handleSearch"
    />
    <c-button @click="clearRecentSearches">Clear History</c-button>
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { SearchResult } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";

const inputStyle = { width: "360px" };
const storageKey = "__cedar_search_history__";

const keyword = ref("");
const recentSearches = ref<string[]>(loadRecentSearches());

function loadRecentSearches() {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storageKey) || "[]");
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function saveRecentSearches(list: string[]) {
  localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(list));
  recentSearches.value = list;
}

function handleSearch(data: SearchResult) {
  saveRecentSearches(data.recentSearches);
}

function clearRecentSearches() {
  saveRecentSearches([]);
}
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import type { SearchResult } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'

const keyword = ref('')
const popup = ref(false)
const history = ref(['项目 A', '设备 B'])
const lastAction = ref('尚未搜索')
function recordSearch(result: SearchResult) {
  history.value = result.recentSearches
  lastAction.value = result.modelValue ?? ''

function recordAction(result: SearchResult) {
  lastAction.value = result.modelValue ?? ''
}
</script>

      v-model="keyword"
```

### 受控字段模型

Example source: src/search/__demos__/controlled-fields.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import type { SearchResult } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'

const field = ref('name')
const model = ref<Record<string, unknown>>({ name: '设备 A', tenant: 'demo' })
const accepted = ref(true)
const history = ref(['设备 A', '42'])
const result = ref<SearchResult>()
const fields = [
  { value: 'name', label: '设备名称', placeholder: '输入名称' },
  { value: 'id', label: '设备 ID', placeholder: '输入 ID' },
]
function updateModel(proposal: Record<string, unknown>) {
  if (accepted.value) model.value = proposal
}
function updateField(proposal: string) {
  if (accepted.value) field.value = proposal
}
function search(next: SearchResult) {
  result.value = next
  history.value = next.recentSearches
}
</script>
<template>
  <div class="search-demo">
    <c-checkbox v-model="accepted">接受输入与清空（关闭后父级拒绝更新）</c-checkbox>
    <c-search
      :model="model"
      :model-field="field"
      :fields="fields"
      :recent-searches="history"
      edit-mode="direct"
      search-button
      button-text="搜索"
      clearable
      @update:model="updateModel"
      @update:model-field="updateField"
      @search="search"
    />
    <c-button variant="text" @click="model = { name: '外部替换', tenant: 'demo' }">外部替换模型</c-button>
    <div>已接受模型：{{ model }}</div>
    <p v-if="!accepted" role="status">父级正在拒绝输入和清空；打开上方开关后恢复。</p>
    <pre v-if="result">{{ JSON.stringify(result, null, 2) }}</pre>
  </div>
</template>
<style scoped>
.search-demo {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  max-width: 100%;
}
.search-demo pre {
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>
```

### 共享字段加载

`loading-mode="line"` 使用 FieldDecorator 的共享加载线；默认模式保留本组件已有的加载展示。加载状态本身不隐式设置 disabled 或 readonly。

### 原生表单与弹层身份

活动关键词输入独占配置的 id；外侧参照和关闭后缓存的输入使用不同内部 id，并退出辅助技术和 Tab 顺序。可见 label 关联对应输入，ariaLabel 优先于标签文案；字段选择器提供字段选择语义，关键词输入使用独立名称。

原生 FormData 始终由外侧参照输入提供一份 name/value；弹层编辑器即时更新同一模型，不重复提交 name。需要弹层参与 HTML 必填等约束校验时，请给 form 设置 id，并用 inputAttrs.form 显式关联。关闭时编辑器释放表单校验归属，缓存输入不会拦截后续提交。

popup 中输入即时更新 v-model；cancel 结束历史界面，业务负责取消自己的请求。非空 recent-searches 才会打开历史界面，切换为阅读模式会释放历史状态。loading 由业务控制，编辑仍可用，重复搜索被阻止；普通 search/change 通知返回的 Promise 不控制等待。

Example source: src/search/__demos__/native-form.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("searchNativeFormInline");

import { ref, useId } from "vue";

const uid = useId();
const formId = "native-search-form-" + uid;
const inputId = "native-search-query-" + uid;
const helpId = "native-search-help-" + uid;
const form = ref();
const query = ref("report");
const waiting = ref(false);
const loadingMode = ref("default");
const searchEvents = ref(0);
const submitted = ref([]);
function submit() {
  if (waiting.value || !form.value) return;
  submitted.value = [
    ...new form.value.ownerDocument.defaultView.FormData(form.value).entries(),
  ];
}
</script>
<template>
  <section>
    <p>{{ inlineCopy.editInHistoryThenSubmit }}</p>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button html-type="button" @click="waiting = !waiting">{{
        inlineCopy.toggleWaiting
      }}</c-button>
      <c-button
        html-type="button"
        @click="loadingMode = loadingMode === 'default' ? 'line' : 'default'"
        >{{ inlineCopy.toggleLoadingLayout }}</c-button
      >
    </c-space>
    <form :id="formId" ref="form" @submit.prevent="submit">
      <c-search
        v-model="query"
        :label="inlineCopy.keywords"
        edit-mode="popup"
        :recent-searches="['report', 'invoice']"
        :loading="waiting"
        :loading-mode="loadingMode"
        :input-attrs="{
          id: inputId,
          name: 'keyword',
          form: formId,
          required: true,
          'aria-describedby': helpId,
        }"
        @search="searchEvents++"
      />
      <p :id="helpId">{{ inlineCopy.editsUpdateImmediatelyNativeRequired }}</p>
      <c-button html-type="submit" :disabled="waiting">{{
        inlineCopy.captureNativeForm
      }}</c-button>
    </form>
    <p>{{ inlineCopy.readingPreview }}</p>
    <c-search
      :model-value="query"
      read-pretty
      :loading="waiting"
      :loading-mode="loadingMode"
    />
    <pre class="native-search-results" role="status">{{
      JSON.stringify({ submitted, searchEvents, query, waiting, loadingMode })
    }}</pre>
  </section>
</template>
<style scoped>
.native-search-results {
  max-width: 100%;
  overflow-x: auto;
}
</style>
```

## API

### 空值识别与阅读空文案

`empty-values` 用于空值识别，`empty-value` 保留原清空输出；`empty-text` 仅在 `read-pretty` 空内容下展示，默认 `'-'`，字段 > FormItem > Form，自定义 read 插槽优先。显式配置 empty-values 后，内置 required 接入该策略，自定义校验仍收到原值。详见[统一说明](llms/zh-CN/guide/empty-values.md)。

| 参数 | 类型 | 缺省与范围 |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | 字段 > FormItem > Form > 组件族默认；完整覆盖，不合并 |
| empty-text | string | 字段 > FormItem > Form > '-'；显式 '' 有效 |

以上是字段展示层 API；纯面板不因此新增阅读模式。Form 与 FormItem 提供继承配置。empty-value 的现有类型与默认输出仍按该组件原 API 执行。

### Search Events

| 事件名 | 说明 | 回调参数 |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `update:modelValue` | 关键词更新时触发 | `value: string \| null` |
| `update:modelField` | 字段更新时触发 | `field: string` |
| `update:model` | 字段表单更新时触发 | `model: Record<string, unknown>` |
| `input` | 输入期间触发 | `value: string, event: Event` |
| `change` | 失焦、Enter 提交或切换字段时触发 | `value: string \| null, event: Event` |
| `clear` | 清除时触发 | `event: Event` |
| `search` | 点击图标/按钮、按 Enter 或选择历史时触发 | `result: SearchResult, event: Event` |
| `focus` | 聚焦时触发 | `event: FocusEvent` |
| `blur` | 失焦时触发 | `event: FocusEvent` |
| `cancel` | 点击移动端取消按钮时触发 | `event: Event` |

### Search Slots

| 名称 | 说明 | 参数 |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------ | ----------- |
| `prefix` | 输入框前缀；提供后将替换默认搜索图标 | `-` |
| `suffix` | 输入框后缀 | `-` |
| `clear-icon` | 清除图标 | `{ clear: (event?: Event) => void }` |
| `button-default` | 公共搜索按钮内容 | `-` |
| `button-icon` | 公共搜索按钮图标 | `-` |
| `label` | 标签内容；外层 label 关联关键词输入 | `-` |
| `action` | 操作按钮内容 | `-` |
| `read` | 自定义阅读内容 | `{ value: string \| null, text: string }` |

### Search Methods

| 方法名 | 说明 | 参数 | 返回值 |
| ------- | ---- | ---- | ------ |
| `focus` | 聚焦 | `-` | `-` |
| `blur` | 失焦 | `-` | `-` |

## Types

### SearchField

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------ | -------- |
| `label` | 标签内容；外层 label 关联关键词输入 | _string_ |
| `value` | 字段值 | _string_ |
| `placeholder` | 字段占位符，优先于 Search 的 `placeholder` | _string_ |

### SearchResult

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 |
| ---------------- | -------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `modelField` | 搜索字段 | _string \| undefined_ |
| `modelValue` | 原始搜索关键词 | `string \| null` |
| `model` | 字段表单对象 | _Record<string, unknown> \| undefined_ |
| `recentSearches` | 下一份搜索历史 | _string[]_ |

输入事件约定：编辑时先 `input`、再 `update:modelValue`；失焦提交仅在值变化时触发 `change`。清空依次触发 `clear → input → update:modelValue → change`，各一次，同时只更新一次搜索字段模型，不自动执行搜索。

输入事件先于模型更新。Enter 会等待 Input 提交及受控模型回填后生成搜索结果；父级拒绝 trim 提议时，搜索仍使用实际受控值。清空按 clear → input → update:modelValue → change 通知，不自动执行搜索。

## 受控模型协议

值优先级为 `modelValue` > `model[当前字段]` > 非受控 `defaultValue`。传入 `model` 且存在当前字段时，缺失/null 字段显示空字符串；同时绑定多个模型时，应在父级保持它们一致。`modelField` 优先于 `defaultField` 和第一项字段；受控值不会被内部强制覆盖。

`model` **不会被原地修改**。每次逻辑更新发出一份 `update:model` 新对象，清空已声明的其他字段、保留未声明属性；请使用 `v-model:model` 或显式接受提议。字段切换只产生一次 `update:modelField → update:modelValue → update:model → change`。父级可拒绝提议，Enter、按钮、历史项搜索均等待一轮更新后读取实际接受的字段、关键词和模型。

历史不按输入过滤，也不内部持久化；`search` 返回的新历史统一 trim、去空、去重并截取最大数量。空关键词不添加记录，非有限/负数最大数量按 0 处理。清空不执行搜索；取消提议空字符串并发出 cancel/change，不提交搜索。

输入编辑发出 `input → update:modelValue`；提交值变化时才发出 `change`。清空为 `clear → input → update:modelValue → change`，仅一次。只读、禁用、loading 会阻止搜索/取消/历史/字段操作；禁用和只读可继承 Form / FormItem / InputGroup。失活或卸载会取消未完成的异步搜索。

### 平台差异

两端默认 edit-mode=direct；Cedar 默认 shape=square，Maple 默认 shape=round。Cedar 保留外侧 InputGroup，Maple 使用移动搜索条布局和触控间距。Input 支持五种尺寸，外层条密度通过 Search 的 CSS 变量控制。

### 公开类型

`SearchEditMode`、`SearchProps`, `SearchEmits`, `SearchSlots`, `SearchExpose`, `SearchField`, `SearchResult`.

### Input 属性透传

inputAttrs 的原生 name、form、ARIA 和数据属性按编辑器归属传递；autocomplete 沿用 Input 的 off 策略。组件管理 id、name、tabindex、aria-hidden 和等待状态，保证活动输入和缓存输入不争用原生身份。

# Section 内容分区

将标题、说明、操作和正文组织为一个分区。适合详情页、抽屉和卡片内部。表单外的分区间距由父布局控制。放入 Form 后，分区自动跨整行并处理字段间距；父表单采用 inline 布局时，组内字段横排且允许换行。

## 基础示例

### 普通分区

默认使用 plain，可直接放入已有容器。

Example source: src/section/__demos__/plain.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-section :title="copy.permissions" :description="copy.scope">
    <dl>
      <dt>{{ copy.admin }}</dt>
      <dd>{{ copy.manage }}</dd>
      <dt>{{ copy.member }}</dt>
      <dd>{{ copy.update }}</dd>
    </dl>
  </c-section>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale } from '../../__demos__/locale'

const copy = useDemoLocale('section')
</script>
```

### 带线分区

line 在标题后绘制装饰线，操作放入 extra 插槽。

Example source: src/section/__demos__/line.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-section :title="copy.history" variant="line">
    <template #extra>
      <c-button :aria-expanded="expanded" @click="expanded = !expanded">
        {{ expanded ? copy.latest : copy.all }}
      </c-button>
    </template>
    <ul>
      <li>{{ copy.exportRelease }}</li>
      <li v-if="expanded">{{ copy.memberRelease }}</li>
    </ul>
  </c-section>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { useDemoLocale } from '../../__demos__/locale'

const copy = useDemoLocale('section')

const expanded = ref(false)
</script>
```

## API

### Section Props

| 属性 | 说明 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| id | 分区锚点 | 自动生成 |
| title | 标题文本 | 空 |
| description | 标题下方的说明 | 空 |
| variant | 外观，可选 plain、line、card | 表单内 line，其他场景 plain |
| heading-level | 标题层级，取值 1 至 6 | 表单内 3，其他场景 2 |
| show-marker | 显示标题色条 | 表单内开启 |
| show-end-divider | 在 plain 和 line 分区末尾绘制结束线 | false |

### Section Slots

默认插槽承载正文。title 和 description 插槽优先于同名属性。extra 插槽承载操作。

# Segmented 分段控制器

用于在少数互斥选项之间快速切换。

`model-value` 为受控值：交互只提出更新，父级拒绝时原生选中状态和外观均恢复。`default-value` 只用于初始化；未提供两者时不默认选择首项。普通 `change` 仅通知，不等待返回的 Promise。

模型仅支持 string / number；undefined 表示非受控，null 不属于公开模型类型。

未设置的 disabled、readonly、size 依次继承 FormItem、Form；size 再继承 ConfigProvider，最终回退 md。显式 false 可覆盖继承状态。只读保留键盘焦点并阻止改值；FormItem 的错误状态通过 aria-invalid 反馈，错误消息关联到单选组，并与已有 aria-describedby 合并；不新增面板或加载属性。

## 基础示例

### 基础用法

Example source: src/segmented/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-segmented v-model="value" :options="['Daily', 'Weekly', 'Monthly']" />
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('Daily')
</script>
```

## 外观与状态

### 分段尺寸与禁用状态

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### 本组配置对照

| 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | 尺寸 | 分段尺寸与禁用状态 |
| `options` | 选项列表 | 分段尺寸与禁用状态 |
| `disabled` | 禁用 | 分段尺寸与禁用状态 |
| `default-value` | 非受控默认值 | 分段尺寸与禁用状态 |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

比较不同尺寸的密度与禁用选项的行为；受控值和块级布局保持独立。

Example source: src/segmented/__demos__/appearance-state-comparison.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
```

## 交互与控制

### 受控

Example source: src/segmented/__demos__/controlled.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-segmented :model-value="value" :options="options" @change="onChange" />
    <div>当前值：{{ value }}</div>
  </c-space>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('a')
const options = [
  { label: '选项 A', value: 'a' },
  { label: '选项 B', value: 'b' },
  { label: '选项 C', value: 'c', disabled: true },
]

const onChange = (next) => {
  value.value = next
}
</script>
```

## 可访问性

- 根节点使用 `role="radiogroup"`，选项为原生 `radio`，支持键盘切换。
- 可通过 `name` 绑定表单字段名。
- 未设置 name 时使用支持 SSR 的稳定实例标识；不同实例保持独立原生单选组。
- 整体禁用时设置 `aria-disabled`。

## API

### Segmented Props

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| model-value | 当前值 支持 `v-model`。 | `string \| number` | `—` |
| default-value | 非受控默认值 | `string \| number` | — |
| options | 选项列表，支持只读数组 | `ReadonlyArray<string \| number \| SegmentedOption>` | `[]` |
| size | 尺寸；未设置时继承表单和全局配置，最终回退 md | `xs \| sm \| md \| lg \| xl` | `undefined` |
| disabled | 禁用；未设置时继承表单，显式 false 可覆盖 | `boolean` | `undefined` |
| readonly | 只读；未设置时继承表单，显式 false 可覆盖 | `boolean` | `undefined` |
| block | 撑满父宽度 | `boolean` | `false` |
| orientation | 分段选项的横纵排列，默认 horizontal；不表示文字阅读方向 | `horizontal \| vertical` | `horizontal` |
| name | 原生 name | `string` | — |

### Segmented Events

| 事件名 | 说明 | 参数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| change | 值变化 | `(value, event)` |
| update:model-value | v-model | `(value)` |

### Segmented Slots

| 插槽名 | 说明 | 参数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| label | 自定义选项内容 | `{ data: SegmentedOption }` |

## Types

### SegmentedOption

| 字段 | 说明 | 类型 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| label | 文案；省略时显示 value | `string \| () => VNodeChild` |
| value | 值 | `string \| number` |
| disabled | 禁用该项 | `boolean` |

数值 1 和字符串 "1" 是不同选项；同类型相同 value 重复出现时保留首项。label 插槽优先于选项 label；自定义图标内容仍需提供可访问名称。业务元数据仅通过插槽 data 传递，不自动透传为原生属性。

实例未增加 focus、blur 或 select 方法；本组件只负责互斥选择，不提供关联内容面板。

## CSS Variables

<!-- component-css-variables:start -->

通过以下变量定制组件外观。默认值随表中注明的主题或选择器条件变化；变量仅在对应的尺寸、变体和交互状态下生效。

| `--c-segmented-border-radius` | `var(--c-border-radius-md)` | `border-radius` |
| `--c-segmented-font-size-lg` | `var(--c-font-size-body-3)` | `font-size` |
| `--c-segmented-font-size-md` | `var(--c-font-size-body-3)` | `font-size` |
| `--c-segmented-font-size-sm` | `var(--c-font-size-body-1)` | `font-size` |
| `--c-segmented-font-size-xl` | `var(--c-font-size-title-1)` | `font-size` |
| `--c-segmented-font-size-xs` | `var(--c-font-size-body-1)` | `font-size` |

| `--c-segmented-height-sm` | `var(--c-size-7)` | `min-height` |
| `--c-segmented-height-xl` | `var(--c-size-10)` | `min-height` |
| `--c-segmented-height-xs` | `var(--c-size-6)` | `min-height` |
| `--c-segmented-item-bg-hover` | `var(--c-sys-color-state-hover)` | `background` |
| `--c-segmented-item-bg-selected` | `var(--c-sys-color-surface-default)` | `background` |
| `--c-segmented-item-border-radius` | `calc(var(--c-segmented-border-radius) - 1px)` | `border-radius` |
| `--c-segmented-item-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-secondary)` | `color` |
| `--c-segmented-item-color-hover` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-primary)` | `color` |
| `--c-segmented-item-color-selected` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-primary)` | `color` |
| `--c-segmented-item-disabled-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-disabled)` | `color` |
| `--c-segmented-item-font-weight-selected` | `500` | `font-weight` |
| `--c-segmented-item-padding-lg` | `0 14px` | `padding` |
| `--c-segmented-item-padding-md` | `0 var(--c-spacing-6)` | `padding` |
| `--c-segmented-item-padding-sm` | `0 var(--c-spacing-5)` | `padding` |
| `--c-segmented-item-padding-xl` | `0 var(--c-spacing-7)` | `padding` |
| `--c-segmented-item-padding-xs` | `0 var(--c-spacing-4)` | `padding` |
| `--c-segmented-label-gap` | `var(--c-spacing-2)` | `gap` |
| `--c-segmented-padding` | `var(--c-border-width-3)` | `padding` |
| `--c-segmented-shadow-selected` | `0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)` | `box-shadow` |

</div>

将覆盖设置在组件实际根节点或弹层真实挂载祖先上。例如给该元素添加下列 class，再按需替换变量值：

```css
.component-theme {
  --c-segmented-border-radius: var(--c-border-radius-md);
}
```

显式行内样式及直接写入同一 CSS 属性的 Props 优先于样式表默认值。Teleport 后，普通 CSS 变量按实际挂载位置继承；使用 ThemeProvider 时，请遵循其局部主题与弹层配置规则。局部定制请直接覆盖组件变量；仅修改后代的 system 变量不会重新计算从根继承的组件别名。内部变量不属于公共 API。

# Select

多选时，`inline` 下拉只显示选项；已选内容、单项移除和清空由输入框承担。确认式编辑面板保留“已选／清空”，选择为草稿，确认后提交。

当用户需要从一组同类数据中选择一个或多个时，可以使用下拉选择器，点击后选择对应项。

## 阅读方向

选择框继承来源 `dir`；独立使用时默认按阅读起点对齐，在 FormItem 内继续继承其 content-align。显式 left/right 保持物理对齐；标签保持业务数组顺序，空搜索时 Backspace 删除最后一个可关闭值。下拉与选择面板携带来源方向，自定义 popup-container 不覆盖该方向。

## 基础示例

### 基础用法

点击展开选项，选中后回填并收起；清除后可重新选择。本例只演示单选。

Example source: src/select/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-select v-model="value" :style="{ width: '240px' }" placeholder="Please select ..." aria-label="基础单选示例" clearable>
      <c-option>Beijing</c-option>
      <c-option>Shanghai</c-option>
      <c-option>Guangzhou</c-option>
      <c-option disabled>Disabled</c-option>
    </c-select>
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts">
import { defineComponent, ref } from 'vue'
export default defineComponent({
  setup() {
    const value = ref('Shanghai')
    return {
      value,
    }
  },
})
</script>
```

## 外观与状态

### 外观配置对比

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### 本组配置对照

| 配置          | 作用                                                | 相关示例                       |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| `options`     | 原始值、对象、分组均支持；三种展示使用同一数据源    | 外观配置对比、表单控件尺寸对照 |
| `clearable`   | 允许清除，保留禁用的已选项                          | 外观配置对比、表单控件尺寸对照 |
| `size`        | 完整支持 xs、sm、md、lg、xl，未设置时继承分组与表单 | 表单控件尺寸对照               |
| `variant`     | filled、outline、standard；未设置时继承 InputGroup  | 表单控件尺寸对照               |
| `placeholder` | 占位文本                                            | 表单控件尺寸对照               |
| `multiple`    | 多选；默认启用搜索                                  | 表单控件尺寸对照               |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

选择一个对比维度后，同屏展示它的全部可选值；其余配置和内容保持一致。可切换其他配置检查组合效果；输入类预览共享一个值。

<details>
<summary>配置说明与使用限制</summary>

#### 变体

设置`variant="outline"`开启变体模式，常用于沉浸式使用。

#### 选择框大小

支持 xs、sm、md、lg、xl 五档尺寸。未设置时依次继承 InputGroup、FormItem、ConfigProvider，最终默认 md。

#### 外观组合

适用于选项数据明确的单选输入。调整变体、尺寸，用相同数据观察变化。内容保持一致，便于比较不同设置的实际效果。

</details>

Example source: src/select/__demos__/appearance-lab.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { useDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const demoCopy = useDemoLocale("comparison");
import { reactive as __demoReactive } from "vue";
import { ref } from "vue";
const value = ref("design");
const options = [
  { label: "研发", value: "dev" },
  { label: "设计", value: "design" },
  { label: "运营", value: "ops", disabled: true },
];
const __demoAppearance = __demoReactive({ variant: "filled", size: "md" });

import { computed as demoComputed, ref as demoRef } from "vue";
const demoCompareFields = [
  { name: "variant", values: ["filled", "outline", "standard"] },
  { name: "size", values: ["xs", "sm", "md", "lg", "xl"] },
];
const demoCompareAxis = demoRef("variant");
const demoComparedOptions = demoComputed(
  () =>
    demoCompareFields.find((field) => field.name === demoCompareAxis.value)
      ?.values ?? [],
);
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <c-form layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="variant">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['variant']"
          aria-label="variant"
          :options="[
            { label: 'filled', value: 'filled' },
            { label: 'outline', value: 'outline' },
            { label: 'standard', value: 'standard' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="size">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['size']"
          aria-label="size"
          :options="[
            { label: 'xs', value: 'xs' },
            { label: 'sm', value: 'sm' },
            { label: 'md', value: 'md' },
            { label: 'lg', value: 'lg' },
            { label: 'xl', value: 'xl' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p class="demo-config-comparison-hint">{{ demoCopy.hint }}</p>
    <c-radio-group
      v-model="demoCompareAxis"
      :aria-label="demoCopy.configuration"
      :options="
        demoCompareFields.map((field) => ({
          label: field.name,
          value: field.name,
        }))
      "
    />
    <div class="demo-config-comparison">
      <section v-for="sample in demoComparedOptions" :key="String(sample)">
        <p>
          <code>{{ demoCompareAxis }}={{ sample }}</code>
        </p>
        <c-select
          v-model="value"
          :options="options"
          clearable
          v-bind="{ ...__demoAppearance, [demoCompareAxis]: sample }"
        ></c-select>
      </section>
    </div>
  </c-space>
</template>

<style scoped>
.demo-config-comparison {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 220px), 1fr));
  gap: 20px;
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
}
.demo-config-comparison > section {
  min-width: 0;
}
.demo-config-comparison p {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
```

### 表单控件尺寸对照

切换五档 size 和三种字段变体，比较 Input、Button、Select、日期时间及其他单行表单控件的高度。Button 在这里固定使用 outline。DatePicker/TimePicker 是面板，此处使用带输入框的 Date/Time 字段。示例同时展示有值、可清空、标签删除与长标签多选；Select/Cascader 设置 tag-nowrap 时保持同档高度，长标签文字省略、删除图标保留；标签行可横向滚动，清空按钮和箭头固定在外侧。被省略的标签正文支持悬停、键盘聚焦或点按查看完整文字，点外部或按 Esc 关闭，不改变选中值。可清空后恢复选中值重复比较。多行文本和允许换行的多选内容按内容撑高。

Example source: src/field-decorator/__demos__/control-sizes.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("fieldDecoratorControlSizesInline");

import { ref } from "vue";
const sizes = ["xs", "sm", "md", "lg", "xl"] as const;
const variants = ["outline", "filled", "standard"] as const;
const size = ref<(typeof sizes)[number]>("md");
const variant = ref<(typeof variants)[number]>("outline");
const options = [
  { value: "beijing", label: "Beijing" },
  { value: "shanghai", label: "Shanghai" },
];
const cascaderOptions = [{ value: "china", label: "China", children: options }];

const inputValue = ref("Beijing");
const selectValue = ref("beijing");
const cascaderValue = ref("beijing");
const selectMultiple = ref(["beijing", "shanghai"]);
const cascaderMultiple = ref(["beijing", "shanghai"]);
const selectOverflow = ref(["long", "beijing", "shanghai"]);
const cascaderOverflow = ref(["long", "beijing", "shanghai"]);
const selectedOptions = [
  ...options,
  {
    value: "long",
    label:
      "A very long selected option label for overflow comparison — full text preview keeps the selected value unchanged.",
  },
];
const selectedCascaderOptions = [
  { value: "china", label: "China", children: selectedOptions },
];
function resetSelections() {
  inputValue.value = "Beijing";
  selectValue.value = "beijing";
  cascaderValue.value = "beijing";
  selectMultiple.value = ["beijing", "shanghai"];
  cascaderMultiple.value = ["beijing", "shanghai"];
  selectOverflow.value = ["long", "beijing", "shanghai"];
  cascaderOverflow.value = ["long", "beijing", "shanghai"];
}
</script>
<template>
  <section
    aria-label="Form control size comparison"
    class="control-size-comparison"
  >
    <c-space wrap :size="12">
      <c-radio-group v-model="size" aria-label="Comparison size">
        <c-radio v-for="item in sizes" :key="item" :value="item">{{
          item
        }}</c-radio>
      </c-radio-group>
      <c-radio-group v-model="variant" aria-label="Comparison variant">
        <c-radio v-for="item in variants" :key="item" :value="item">{{
          item
        }}</c-radio>
      </c-radio-group>
    </c-space>
    <div class="control-size-comparison__grid">
      <div data-control="Input">
        <p>Input</p>
        <c-input :size="size" :variant="variant" placeholder="Input" />
      </div>
      <div data-control="Button">
        <p>Button</p>
        <c-button :size="size" variant="outline">Button</c-button>
      </div>
      <div data-control="Select">
        <p>Select</p>
        <c-select
          :size="size"
          :variant="variant"
          :options="options"
          placeholder="Select"
        />
      </div>
      <div data-control="Date">
        <p>Date</p>
        <c-date :size="size" :variant="variant" placeholder="Date" />
      </div>
      <div data-control="Time">
        <p>Time</p>
        <c-time :size="size" :variant="variant" placeholder="Time" />
      </div>
      <div data-control="InputNumber">
        <p>InputNumber</p>
        <c-input-number :size="size" :variant="variant" placeholder="Number" />
      </div>
      <div data-control="AutoComplete">
        <p>AutoComplete</p>
        <c-auto-complete
          :size="size"
          :variant="variant"
          :options="options"
          placeholder="AutoComplete"
        />
      </div>
      <div data-control="Cascader">
        <p>Cascader</p>
        <c-cascader
          :size="size"
          :variant="variant"
          :options="cascaderOptions"
          placeholder="Cascader"
        />
      </div>
      <div data-control="DateRange">
        <p>DateRange</p>
        <c-date-range
          :size="size"
          :variant="variant"
          :placeholder="['Start', 'End']"
        />
      </div>
      <div data-control="TimeRange">
        <p>TimeRange</p>
        <c-time-range
          :size="size"
          :variant="variant"
          :placeholder="['Start', 'End']"
        />
      </div>
    </div>

    <section
      aria-label="Selected control size comparison"
      class="control-size-comparison__states"
    >
      <c-space wrap align="center" :size="12">
        <span>Selected / Clearable / Multiple — 有值、可清空与多选不换行</span>
        <span>{{ inlineCopy.hoverOrFocusTruncatedText }}</span>
        <c-button size="sm" variant="outline" @click="resetSelections">{{
          inlineCopy.reset
        }}</c-button>
      </c-space>
      <div class="control-size-comparison__grid">
        <div data-control="InputValue">
          <p>Input · clearable</p>
          <c-input
            v-model="inputValue"
            :size="size"
            :variant="variant"
            clearable
            placeholder="Input value"
          />
        </div>
        <div data-control="ButtonReference">
          <p>Button · reference</p>
          <c-button :size="size" variant="outline">Button</c-button>
        </div>
        <div data-control="SelectValue">
          <p>Select · clearable</p>
          <c-select
            v-model="selectValue"
            :size="size"
            :variant="variant"
            :options="selectedOptions"
            clearable
            placeholder="Select value"
          />
        </div>
        <div data-control="CascaderValue">
          <p>Cascader · clearable</p>
          <c-cascader
            v-model="cascaderValue"
            :size="size"
            :variant="variant"
```
